{{Version|2.0.5}} The '''Clancraft Forum''', formerly named as '''Minechat Blogs''' and '''RBlog''', is one of the central elements of The Broken Script's ARG in the ''2.0 Update''. It contains various posts and conversations from a variety of differnet [[players]] on the Clan Server, providing a variety of information about both them, the Clan Server itself, as well as [[spectrum_11]]. == How to Find == There are several means to find the domain for the Clancraft Forums. === Blacklisted Ruins === The domain can be found from three randomly generated [[Structures#overworld_open|structures]], each containing its own piece. ==== overworld_open ==== This structure appears to be a piece of the Blacklisted base, with multiple signs between [[RANKorous_123]] and [[xoxDairyQueen]] shown on the second floor. name.missing can be found in a large portion of this upper layer as well. On the lower level, a single chest can be found next to the pillar of crafting tables. In it contains 26 name.nulls, all surrounding a book & quill with the line "local" ==== overworld_web ==== This structure is a small shop-like build, featuring 2 chests and 3 signs. On one of the signs reads the word "host" ==== overworld_enter ==== This structure appears to be the other piece of Blacklisted's base, sharing the same build style and furnace array as the structure listed above. Following the cobblestone staircase to the second layer leads to a sign with the line ":2018" Combining all pieces of the domain will result in the domain '''localhost:2018'''. === xXram2dieXx Joins === Upon [[xXram2dieXx]] joining a world, a message will be sent in chat, with the word "web" obfuscated. Local g w a e m b e hosted on port [2018] Instead of it reading as the normal "Local game hosted on port [2018]", as a game opened to LAN would display, the text above could be read as "Local web hosted on port [2018]". This is in reference to '''http://localhost:[port]''', where the port is shown in the brackets, which provides the proper domain '''http://localhost:2018''' == Accessing the Forums == Entering into any '''localhost:2018''' link does seemingly nothing, prompting that there is a problem loading page. To properly access the '''Clancraft Forums''', The Broken Script must be actively running, even if just on the title screen. === Links === Many of the non-thread links do not work on the Main Page. Clancraft Forums, Login/Sign up, Contact, Blogs, News, and Home all lead to the Main Page === Rules === The Rules page is the only link that will work asides from any forum thread. It leads to a list of rules regarding posting on the Forum.
'''Site Rules''' '''BY USING THIS SITE, YOU AGREE TO FOLLOWING THE RULES. IF CAUGHT BREAKING THESE RULES, THE DIAMOND TEAM CAN ACT IN ANY WAY THEY DEEM FIT:''' 1. Please respect the forum's user-base and its mod-team: We as a community do not condone any form of harassment or discrimination here at all: racism, homophobia, sexism, death threats, stalking etc. If you believe a user is breaching the conditions of this rule, please report it to one of the staff so we can deal with it appropriately. 2. Quality of posts here do matter: Please do not spam the forums for the sake of gaining reputation or getting your post noticed; it will result in a seven day mute. This includes: begging for certain mods to be added to the server, spam content, unnecessary pings towards staff and low effort posts that are clearly rep-fishing. 3. No advertisement of any kind: Do not use your posts to advertise any sort of product that can be bought, off-site social media and other related content that could potentially scam your fellow user. 4. Report anything that seems suspicious, malicious or strange: Make sure you report anything to the moderation team that seems to be against the rules. We as a team have a responsibility to keep you all safe and content, so you reporting any issues you come across does heavily help with that. 5. Do not engage in illegal activity: The forum’s servers are based in the Netherlands, so Netherlands law should be followed at all times regarding what you post. 6. No sexual-content: Under no circumstances will you post anything that is mildly NSFW or explicitly so. If you do, it will result in a permanent ban from the forum which is unappealable. We have a community consisting of both children and adults, so in order to keep everyone safe, it is an outright ban on such content. 7. No purposeful flaming or trolling: We understand that our community likes to indulge in some casual banter, but please do not go out of your way to cause arguments or instigate trolling campaigns towards others. 8. Do not join the site if you are under 13: We completely get that Minecraft is a game for everyone, however, we wish to keep those who are too young to understand forum culture safe. If you are caught bypassing this rule, you will be banned from the site. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- WARNINGS, MUTES AND BANS: When a rule is broken, it will be up to the moderator or administrator issuing the punishment what exactly you will get. In most cases, you will get a warning via a comment beneath the post that has violated our rules explaining what you have done and a polite request to not do it again. If you continue to break the rules, however, we will issue a mute (duration can vary) and then eventually a ban. If you wish to appeal, please contact one of the staff members directly. SUPPORT: Any questions regarding our rules should be directed towards the forum team, we will try our best to get back to you quickly.
=== Shutdown Notice === On the left side of the main page is a notice for all Clancraft Forum users.
You've probably noticed by now. Unfortunately, the forum will be shutting down on July 22nd. As the owner has been on hiatus, there is nobody to pay for the provider. The server, however, will remain unaffected, because it has already been paid for another year. The forum itself is not dead. We'll just have to wait until the owner comes back and things will go right back to how they were before.
Oddly enough, this differs from what [[MikePlaysMinecra]] writes in his shutdown notice post, as he states that the Clancraft Forums will be shut down on June 22nd. == Media == Clancraft Forums Main v2.0.0.png|2.0.0 Clancraft Forums Main v2.0.1.png|2.0.1 Clancraft Forums Main v2.0.2.png|2.0.2 Clancraft Forums Main v2.0.3.png|2.0.3 Clancraft Forums Main v2.0.4.png|2.0.4 Clancraft Forums Main v2.0.4-hotfix.png|2.0.4-Hotfix Clancraft Forums Main v2.0.5.png|2.0.5 == Notes == * The actual names of the [[#Blacklisted Ruins|Blacklisted structures]], if followed in the same order as the Clancraft Forum domain, reads "Open web enter", which followed by the domain, gives the instructions on how to access the Forum properly * It is not a requirement to encounter [[#xXram2dieXx Joins|xXram2dieXx]] for the Clancraft Forums to be locally hosted; rather it is a clue to find the domain without a direct guide or foreknowledge.

{{Stub|Missing Roam information}} {{Entity infobox |title=Fractured |image= {{GalleryHelper |Fractured.png¦Current¦Fractured |FracturedOld.png¦Old¦Old Man Fractured }} |Nicknames=Jimmy |Role= |Type=[[Entities#Void Creatures|Void Creature]] |Affiliations=[[Void]] |HP= }} Fractured is a extremely large entity that can only be encountered in the [[Moon]] dimension. He is the first boss in the mod, and his defeat is required to challenge [[Integrity]]. == Appearance == Fractured is a massive, deformed void creature made from a chaotic mass of void tendrils, with many spikes across its head and body. It stands on four limbs and has four claws on the front of its body, similar to that of a praying mantis. Notably, it stands out from other void creatures due to the large number of loose tendrils all over its body, with what seem like bright red accents or bulbs of sorts. A corrupted command block sits embedded in the center of its chest. == Behaviour == === Progression === Fractured does not immediately spawn naturally when you arrive on the moon. First, the player must locate the structure the_tower on the [[Moon]] dimension and right-click an [[A Flower]] placed at its peak. Upon doing so, Fractured will emerge from the ground. Once summoned, Fractured will begin roaming the [[Moon]]. the_tower.png|'''The Tower''' isometric view The Tower.webp|The Tower's distant view A Flower.webp|The Tower's rooftop === Boss Fight === By shooting at either Fractured's head or chest, the Player will initiate his boss fight. His healthbar will appear, alongside 30 [[Sub Anomaly 2]]s near his location. Fractured will be unable to be damaged by the Player through traditional means. Instead, the Player must exploit [[Sub Anomaly 2]]'s attraction to light and lure them into attacking Fractured. This can be done using either Spectral arrows, or arrows from a bow enchanted with Flame, into Fractured's head or chest. Each time Fractured is damaged, a short cooldown will occur, indicated by the eyes in the healthbar vanishing. [[File:Fractured Healthbar.png]] The eyes will reappear once the cooldown is over, signalling that the Fractured can be targetted again. [[File:Fractured Healthbar Eyes.gif]] ==== Attacks ==== Fractured can perform various attacks during it's fight. * '''Stomp''' — Fractured lifts a massive foot and slams the ground, dealing area-of-effect damage. * '''Slam''' — Fractured slams the player with its front claws, dealing melee damage. * '''Rock Toss''' — Fractured pulls a moon-rock from its chest and hurls it at the player. * '''Leg Stomp''' — each of Fractured's four legs independently seeks the nearest player and stomps toward them. === Defeat === After Fractured has been swarmed 6 times, it flees into the ground and drops the [[Corrupted Command Block]] embedded in its chest, required to start the [[Integrity]] bossfight. == Notes == * "Jimmy" is a joke/placeholder name used for Fractured during 2.0's development, as the developers didn't want to reveal its actual name. It has since become Fractured's joke/alternate name in the community (as well as in the mod files). * Though Void Creatures canonically lack gender identities or a biological sex, Fractured is referred to with he/him pronouns by the developers. * Fractured's legs used to have hitboxes, but they were eventually scrapped and replaced with geckolib bone tracking and triggers. * Fractured is responsible for the Moon's corruption. * The design of Fractured's eyes is inspired by Bennie2007's OC, which features butterfly eyes. == Media == |-|Gallery= Fractured Jimmy.png|Fractured. pages.title: Frequently Asked Questions
pages.extract:
Welcome to The Broken Script's Frequently Asked Questions page. Here, you'll find everything you need to know to get the mod working, what to do if it breaks, and find general information about what's inside the mod itself. = The Broken Script FAQ = == 📥 Installation & Setup == === How to install The Broken Script? === Use [https://modrinth.com/mod/the-broken-script/versions Modrinth]. === What is the best version of Broken Script to play? === [[File:Pomogite.png|thumb]] The answer will be up to you. You '''''must''''' download [https://tbsarchive.org/archive/ the community patch] if you are determined to play on version 1.20.1 even though mod development has ceased for this version. If you do want to play the newest version, [https://modrinth.com/mod/the-broken-script/versions use the official sources.] === Why is TBS not loading? === TBS requires several dependencies, which include [https://modrinth.com/mod/kotlin-for-forge Kotlin for Forge], [https://modrinth.com/mod/fzzy-config Fzzy Config], and [https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib Geckolib]. Make sure you have all three mods installed. === I still get errors when launching the game.=== [[File:Read.png|thumb|Read carefully.]] Read the text of the error carefully. If you see the word Geckolib — most likely, you have not installed it. Or maybe you're trying to run the 1.20.1 mod on 1.21.1 NeoForge. === Why is the mod now being developed with Neoforge? === [[File:Rip 1.20.1.png|thumb|RIP]] [https://discord.com/channels/1346186348251316346/1346187030941536356/1355928151955476732 According to the developers], Neoforge makes it easier to develop the mod. Since Neoforge is available starting with the 1.21.1 version of Minecraft, current mod builds are accordingly only available on this version. '''No, the latest builds will not run on Forge.''' == ⚙️ Configuration & Commands == === How do I customise the mod for myself? === Customisation of the mod is available via config (while in game, pause the game, click on the mods' menu, locate The Broken Script). === Why can't I use commands in my world? === Commands are disabled by default due to the influence of [[Integrity]] on the world. They can be re-enabled in the 1.21.1 version of The Broken Script using in-game config settings (enable cheats). === How to turn off the VHS filter? The black bars on the screen? '/removevhs' no longer works. === It can be disabled using config settings. === How do I remove the old cave generation? === The data pack ''“Nostalgia Helper Worldgen”'' returns the old cave generation system. Switch it off before creating the world. === What shaders can I use? === [https://modrinth.com/user/Recko Recko's shaders] are approved by the mod developers. This doesn't mean that other shaders are incompatible with the mod, but those that modify the moon are definitely not recommended for use. == 🧩 Gameplay Mechanics & Features == === Will The Broken Script crash my game? === Yes. Game crashes are a core gameplay mechanic of The Broken Script and are caused by the [[Entities]]. In the 1.20.1 version of The Broken Script, the command /TBS_config can be used to control certain events like game crashes. The 1.21.1 version, however, includes 'Fzzy Config' as a dependency, which allows for much finer control of the mod. You can access this by clicking on the 'Mods' button in the pause or main menu, selecting 'The Broken Script' and clicking 'Config' in the bottom-left of the menu. === Can I lose my world? === Yes. The [[Entities]] are capable of banning you from your world. It is however toggleable with an option. To reverse a ban (eg in older versions), delete the 'entities' folder in your Minecraft profile directory. Please note this will delete all entities in the world, including pets, villagers, and mobs. Villagers will not respawn. === Why is the moon purple? / Why is there no moon in the sky? Is it broken? === The moon was broken in the old builds. It is fixed in the latest version of The Broken Script. We strongly advise you to update the mod to [https://modrinth.com/mod/the-broken-script/versions the latest version]. === The sun/moon don't move, day/night don't end, what do I do? === Stopped time is an intended feature caused by a certain [[Random_Events#Set_doDaylightCycle|random event]]. It is not permanent and can be reversed by either that event happening again or using /gamerule doDaylightCycle true. === Why can't I use /TBS_Config? === The reason you can't use /TBS_Config is because you don't have cheats enabled. See the devmode section above. === Are there any faces inside the mod? === That would be a custom edit of the mod made by Swayle (or other YouTubers). No, these black figures with faces are not separate secret entities, but edited [[r2]], and no, the original mod does not feature any ‘scary’ PNG faces. No, [[discordinvite:nullnullnullnull|the official Discord server]] '''does not''' offer a custom texture pack that includes those faces. === Is The Broken Script safe for my PC? === All versions of The Broken Script published on Modrinth are safe for your computer and will not harm it in any way. === Is TBS compatible with multiplayer? === Yes, starting from the version 1.10.0 it is officially compatible. == 🔨 Troubleshooting == === I am having TPS issues / My game is lagging as if I am playing on the actual server === Verify whether you are using the 1.9.4 version of the mod or not. This build is notorious for its severe bug, which results in uncontrollable [[Circuit]] spawnings, which in turn cause significant TPS issues. === Why does my UI look weird? === Either you need to switch from English (US) to English (UK) or open Resource Packs and put mod resources over the default package. Follow the convention of 'colour, favourite, behaviour'. === Why do I see a notification when I launch the game that Sodium and The Broken Script are incompatible? === Sodium can indeed cause texture problems, but this happens to a minority of people. We suggest ignoring this warning and continue playing the game. But in case you notice broken textures, Sodium will have to be uninstalled. === Blocks are not rendering / I'm having issues with textures, what should I do? === Try removing Sodium from your modpack. Note: this kind of problem seems to happen in newer GPUs that have explicit support for Vulkan, and not OpenGL, which Minecraft uses. Try looking for a driver update that adds support to OpenGL for your card. If you don't have one, remove sodium. === I'm using CurseForge to play the game and when I add The Broken Script to my mods' folder, it shows up in the launcher in some cryptic way. === Ignore it. == 🌒 Entities & Lore Interactions == === When will things begin? === Null should join within the first night, but it might take you a few nights in your world before you start seeing more entities and for the game to ramp up. If you want to interact with Null, visit his [[Null|page]] to know more about his interactions. === What's the reputation system? How do you increase/decrease it? === Main article: [[Reputation]] The reputation system is a hidden statistic that changes based on how you interact with [[entities]]. In general, surviving/avoiding entities can give reputation, while triggering entities can decrease it. === Where is The Broken End? === [[The Broken End]] is tied to the [[The Moon|Moon]] phases. === I encountered a Chicken in the caves. Was that Circuit? === No, it was one of the entities that failed to spawn properly and ended up spawning a Chicken. It is harmless. (RedstoneWizard08 has also stated that it is a joke in which a Chicken Jockey is supposed to spawn, but only a Chicken spawns because Circuit is pausing mob spawning. It is a reference to the famous quote from A Minecraft Movie, where Steve says, “Chicken Jockey!”) === How can I encounter Integrity? === [[Integrity]] is currently optional and only in the final parts of the mod, he will not appear during normal gameplay. === Null left the game before even appearing in the world in the first place / Null left the game, what does it mean? === That is one of the random events. This event is considered to mean nothing special (at this point). Despite the notification that Null is out of the game, he is still present in the world. ---- = spectrum_11 FAQ = == 📦 What is spectrum_11? == === What is spectrum_11 and do I need to download it? === [[Spectrum_11]] is a hidden mod found when opening The Broken Script's .jar file as an archive, and is located in the 'Consciousness' directory. It is technically separate from The Broken Script. In some versions it is not present due to wendigodrip forgetting to add it. You can find versions of it in the [https://discordapp.com/channels/1338851039490867222/1345847859194368160 mod archive]. == 💻 System Impact == === Why is my game/computer lagging so much? === If you are playing with spectrum_11 present, it can open multiple instances of Windows PowerShell or Linux shell, potentially interfering with system performance and crashing your machine. === Why does my text font look so messed up? === This is a feature of spectrum_11. It intentionally modifies the in-game font display. === Is spectrum_11 safe? === It is not malware and will not damage your system files, but it can execute PowerShell commands to adjust system volume, shut down your computer, and affect OS-level settings. These behaviours are not part of The Broken Script itself. '''Do not play with spectrum_11 unless you are prepared for the consequences.''' = Wiki = === Why this wiki? === [[File:WendigodripConfirmation.png|frame|center|Endorsed!]] === Can the information in this wiki be trusted? === Short answer — yes. All information provided in this wiki should be very accurate, as the staff is always patrolling edits and verifying new information with already known facts, the content present in the mod, and statements by '''wendigodrip''', the creator of the mod.
{{Wiki navbox}}

pages.title: Funny Setting
pages.extract: {{Stub|documentation needed}} == Configuration == == Events == === Bad Sun === For some reason, this event can only naturally take place with funny setting on. This is likely due to the fact that this event is a reference to the game ''Voices of the Void''. === CollinLock === === Chat Responses === Main article: [[Chat Reponses]] Insult Null — send a message that is exactly one of "Fuck you", "Asshole", "Ass hole", "Fucker", "Piece of shit", "Asshat", "Fuck ass", "Bitch", "Bitch ass" or "Ass hat" — always costs you reputation, but what follows next depends on the setting. With the funny setting on, Null answers with a flat ":(" and settles for that, and nothing else happens. With it off, usually a [[Nothingiswatching]] Chase is summoned somewhere on the surface within about 26 blocks of you. == Entities == === Faraway === Main article: [[Faraway]] With the funny setting enabled, Faraway has two additional rare outcomes (each with approximately a 0.5% chance on top of the base trigger): * '''Baby''' — Faraway appears in a child-sized model. Audio and screen overlay use the very_serious/baby.png image. * '''Fard''' — Faraway emits 50 FARDAWAY_PARTICLE particles on despawn, with the very_serious/fardaway.png screen overlay. Baby.png|very_serious/baby.png Fardaway.png|very_serious/fardaway.png baby_disappear.ogg|Baby variant despawn sound fardaway.ogg|Fard variant despawn sound === Circuit === === The Broken End === === r2 === == Boss Fights == === Integrity Phase 1 === With funny setting enabled, Integrinty's voice becames high and glitchy, nothing else changes. At the end of the phase after the Chords are killed. A gif will be put on screen with Integrity saying "DOMAIN EXPANSION." File:DOMAIN EXPANSION.mp4|"DOMAIN EXPANSION." === Integrity Phase 2 === == Miscellaneous == === Torch God === With funny setting on, placing a torch starts a count of every torch and wall torch in the 33×9×33 block area centred on the spot where it was placed. If that count lands on exactly 100, the Torch God is summoned: a loud torch_god_spawn.ogg sounds across the area, and after a {{Tooltip|four-second|80 ticks}} delay the flames begin to move. The god takes the torches one at a time, a little more than every ten ticks. Each torch is consumed with a flash of fire charge and the block beneath it is left as plain air, and in its place a flying flame rises and drifts toward the nearest player within 32 blocks. A flame that reaches its target, within three blocks, deals 4 points of fire damage before it vanishes; a flame that runs into any block is snuffed out on the spot. Because the trigger needs the count to be exactly 100, building a few torches too many will simply leave the god asleep. === Backrooms === Main article: [[Backrooms]] [[File:Backrooms.png|thumb|The Backrooms]] The '''Backrooms''' is a liminal space, accessible at chance by suffocating inside another block, so long as [[Funny Setting]]s are on. === Main Menu Background === === Salmon Replacement/Null Cod === With the funny setting enabled, every salmon that the game tries to create is intercepted and replaced by a '''Null Cod''', and the swap happens at the entity-type level, so it makes no difference how the fish would have entered the world. A naturally spawning salmon, one released from a bucket, or one placed with a spawn egg or a command all come back as a Null Cod instead. Null cod do not flee or idle the way a normal cod does, but walk on the seabed and attack, and the mob they are programmed to hunt is the salmon. The funny setting makes that hunt futile, since it converts every newly created salmon into a Null Cod as well, leaving a Null Cod's chosen prey with nothing to catch. [[File:null cod origin.png|left|thumb|The Story of Null Cod]] === Splash Text === The splash text on the title screen has a rare chance of changing. Every time the title screen builds its splash, there is a 1% chance that, provided the funny setting is enabled, the normal random wording is thrown out entirely and replaced with one fixed line: ''R2 infinity and beyond!'' {{Wiki navbox}}

pages.extract:
{{Stub}} {{Version|2.0.5}} {{Player infobox |title=ghostlyAspect |nickname=Josephine |image= {{GalleryHelper |ForumAspect.png¦Profile Picture¦ghostlyAspect |MinecraftAspect.png¦Minecraft Skin¦ghostlyAspect }} |Profile=[http://localhost:2018/profile/ghostlyAspect ghostlyAspect] }} '''ghostlyAspect''' was one of the users on the Clan Forum to investigate [[Spectrum 11]]. They were a friend of both [[Revuxor]] and [[icarusgaming1998]]. == Spectrum 11 - First World == === FirstNotesOnNewPlaythrough === Found by clicking "creepypasta" in the thread [http://localhost:2018/threads/ghostlyAspect/nothing nothing], dated November 13th, 2014.
First and foremost, I would like to thank the person that uploaded the - clearly a pirated copy-version of "Spectrum_11" Minecraft. It would have not landed in my hands otherwise, so thank you again. I would accompany myself with music but sounds are important while investigating a "creepypasta". From simply opening the game, I am met with music that does not exist. It, accompanied with the black with red dots background and the inability to alter the menu, makes me believe it is a mere "edgy" attempt to a creepypasta. The music though. It disturbs me. I do not like this. I must proceed with caution.
=== The Playthrough Continues === Found by clicking "roses" in the thread [http://localhost:2018/threads/ghostlyAspect/stem stem], dated February 13th, 2015.
Date: █████, 201θ For now it has only been regular, Alpha Minecraft. I mostly sleep because I have no roof over my head often. I am looking for a place with pumpkins :>. Date: █████, 2015 I keep instinctively pressing shift to sprint. I am so glad it exists in the newer versions, I miss it. I wish to find roses. I wish to announce respect and condolences to the possible spirits of the world. The thing I feared most happened: a zombie approached me, I loathe feeling with the in-game ghouls, they disturb my research. I wish not for a Creeper to blow up as I investigate. Apart from that, it has only been normal, Alpha gameplay. I have located pumpkins, but not roses. I believe this was made to deter piracy, no?
=== Weird stuff happening? === Found by clicking "alone" in the thread [http://localhost:2018/threads/ghostlyAspect/light light], dated June 1st, 2015.
Date: █████, 2015 From the moment I woke up in my new house, my vision was blurred, the world drowned in fog as a digital sound played. I can only describe it as high pitched and digital odd. There are no such sounds in the files, which concerns me. Date: █████, 2015 Ah... I heard a eerie sound, then I turn around and see a chunk partly raised (like this) -> __□__ I fear I have disturbed something. Date: █████, 2015 I called upon some spirits, and it began raining. I told them I mean no harm. I told them I can leave. As I was waiting for another sign, I slept through the night. I feel deeply disturbed from the occurrences. Perhaps, they want me to stay? Do they feel lonely?
=== 2444244323154215333452 === Found by clicking "wrong?" in the thread [http://localhost:2018/threads/ghostlyAspect/unlucky unlucky], dated June 4th, 2015.
Date: █████, 2015 Ah...! Another chunk has been ruined! Hello again spirit, I hope I disturb you not. I really wonder why is that the only thing they do. Date: █████, 2015 It keeps raising chunks. Very often, next to each other. I believe that is too much, no? The last one... it is much larger than the other ones. Something tells me to run away, yet I approached it. I can't stop looking at it. I must know what it is. Date: █████, 2015 Is... something wrong with the moon? There is something next to it. Like a red line on a black background of sorts, I cannot tell too well. I do have a screenshot WHAT THE FUCK
=== What is iiiiit ;^; === Found by clicking "encounter" in the thread [http://localhost:2018/threads/ghostlyAspect/frustration frustration], dated June 7th, 2015.
I am terribly sorry for not posting for so long, I broke my pen. I believe I should explain what I saw, and why I cursed. I heard bells, the version of the game was replaced with ???????. I paused for a bit to ask Revuxor and Icarus, I return, I hear something.... breaking. Like twigs. I started running instinctively, I turned around and saw... I know not what. Not something that belongs in Minecraft. It was tall and darker than the night - I am describing an Enderman. Here:
=== Continuing my notes (I am not losing it am I) === Found by clicking "connection?" in the thread [http://localhost:2018/threads/ghostlyAspect/step step], dated June 7th, 2015.
It really gave me a fright. I... I had no idea that was happening, to be honest. It was so, so fast. After that spirit / (entity???) got a hold of me, the game completely crashed. I will boot it back up. I am met with Connection Lost Connection Terminated: No further information. I was not in a server. Trying again, it repeats the same message. (My house... ;^;).
=== Conclusions of First Playthrough === Found by clicking "conclusions" in the thread [http://localhost:2018/threads/ghostlyAspect/persistence persistence], dated June 8th, 2015.
Conclusions ...what just happend. I thought it was an odd, "edgy" version of Alpha Minecraft, with a potential virus, and I actually got something worth of investigation. Are the raised chunks, perhaps, related to... the being? I am... confused. It was immediately aggressive. It wanted to hurt me. What have I done to it? Have I wronged it? I ask for its forgiveness. How does it look? I am extremely mad over the fact that I did not see it, and it shall be my priority. We shall go with humanoid anatomy: We know how the arms and legs look, so proposal: I have no clue about the head. It could be headless. But, from the sounds, could it be like twigs?
== Spectrum 11 - Second World == === Returning to Spectrum_11 === Found by clicking "return" in the thread [http://localhost:2018/threads/ghostlyAspect/once_more Once More], dated November 12th, 2015.
█████, 2015 I have to. I have to clearly see what it is. What if Revuxor is right? What if the thing he showed me is real? I must be sure of what I saw. I am going to try again. And I will build on the tallest tree to see it. Anything to see it. The image must be complete.
=== Some preparations === Found by clicking "respect" in the thread [http://localhost:2018/threads/ghostlyAspect/start Start], dated November 14th, 2015.
█████, 2015 I can't risk losing my stuff to monsters when i could see that spirit again. I need everything I can get to see it clearly this time. The image isn't completely. I really, really have to see everything █████, 2015 I first went in a cave and found iron, surprisingly. Good start, I'll say! I sought the tallest tree, and I found it. Here I am, now.
=== Paying respects === Found by clicking "respect" in the thread [http://localhost:2018/threads/ghostlyAspect/shrine Shrine], dated November 20th, 2015.
█████, 2015 Something tells me I should do this. A voice in my head. It tells me, "make a shrine". This version of the game does not have much to work with, but I will try. I hope it appeases or summons the spirit, just like Herobrine. It is larger than a human, so I will make it rather large. A 6x6 frame of cobblestone, the edges removed. Next to the middle blocks, one rose and one dandelion. In the middle, a 10x4 pillar, with lit up, 3 block extensions.
=== noreason === Found by clicking "shrines" in the thread [http://localhost:2018/threads/ghostlyAspect/shrine Shrine], dated November 20th, 2015. It is related to the thread above. [[File:Forum noreason.png|border|300px]] === Respects, once more === Found by clicking "veil" in the thread [http://localhost:2018/threads/ghostlyAspect/ghosts ghosts], dated November 24th, 2015.
█████, 2015 The moment I woke up, I am greeted by the same fog and the same sound I heard in my first playthrough. Maybe, perhaps, it is caused by the spirit? I will still attempt to communicate with it. Ghosts... you must be respectful towards them. Always consider what they went through. You can never give them peace. But, for some moments, someone is there for them. And that is you.
=== Seeking the moon (why can I never have any images...) === Found by clicking "moonlight" in the thread [http://localhost:2018/threads/ghostlyAspect/errormoon errormoon], dated November 26th, 2015.
The moon is rising again, broken and odd. I think it is safe to assume the being will once more, appear, and I hope to see it this time. Ah, another raised chunk, this time in the evening. Dare I admit the sunset is beautiful in this version? I am in a quite high place, difficult to get reached by the in-game ghouls. Looking from up here, I sadly cannot locate any pumpkins. A shame, this place needs decoration. I shall actually attempt to draw the moon, since the forum seems to be glitched and does not allow me to keep screenshots.
=== Some thoughts === Found by clicking "openings" in the thread [http://localhost:2018/threads/ghostlyAspect/gates gates], dated December 3rd, 2015.
I have to mention that Revuxor, my dear friend, has also seen the entity and called it "Integrity". When he first showed it at me, I thought it was a small scribble but, looking at my notes... It is similar. What he showed me had a triangular head. However, as much as I trust and I appreciate him, I want to see for myself. █████, 2015 I heard a noise. However, I cannot locate anything from up here, so I will go look. It's... oh. Oh goodness. It is a chunk wide hole, leading ███████ It is like the entirety of it was erased, gone, forever. The depth alone unsettles me. The shadows are darker than ever.
The text "leading ███████" has a house symbol over it, likely referring to the [[Void]]. === Small update before Christmas === Found by clicking "simple" in the thread [http://localhost:2018/threads/ghostlyAspect/beforeitall beforeitall], dated December 20th, 2015.
I went to the nearest chunk and gathered some materials (it was some iron and gold, not too much). As... resourceful as those chunks can be, I can't help feel like I am insulting the entity. So I apologized to it. I finally have enough iron to have the entire armor set. I am running out of torches however, and still feel very...unsafe. Side note: It's almost Christmas! I have sent gifts to my friends and I would build a Christmas tree if it was 1.8.9, but alas. Here, that's what I can do. I think you can see this, from what I have seen.
=== I don't like this=== Found by clicking "unknown" in the thread [http://localhost:2018/threads/ghostlyAspect/paranoia paranoia], dated January 4th, 2016.
█████, 2016 I was drawn into the fog once more. It is quite odd, as in my first playthrough I encountered the fog only once. And the piercing sound... it made me throw my headphones away this time. No. Sound is important with this. Move on. █████, 2016 I was going to write that the moon was, oddly, normal tonight, but I shall take my words back. I swear I heard a "psst" sound. Maybe movement on dirt? Must have been my imagination. No, no. I heard blocks breaking too. And I am alone. I hate this. I don't like this. But I must see.
=== Trying to find sense === Found by clicking "await" in the thread [http://localhost:2018/threads/ghostlyAspect/runaway runaway], dated March 2nd, 2016. The image continues the trend of [[Spectrum 11]]'s glitched text covering over various pieces of text.
?????? I thought the letters calmed down HAHAHAHAHA. You're toying with me aren't you? Where is my- SHIT No ██ Why did I fall The moon. The moon is an eye. The moon is an eye. It sees ████ watches. It ████ too. No nono I must get my stuff. And run. I got them. No, Nononnononononono. I don't want to be left alone with it. I want it away - '''NO''' "Here I am". Conclusions of second playthrough I keep getting that message in my head. I think I heard it speak. "Beyond your imagination". Where is my friend. One more time. I have to.
== Spectrum 11 - Third World == === Ineedtorunaway === Found by clicking "skies" in the thread [http://localhost:2018/threads/ghostlyAspect/approach approach], dated sometime in 2016. The image continues the trend of [[Spectrum 11]]'s glitched text covering over various pieces of text.
Two chunks were raised at the same time. It's killing me. It's suffocating. What does it want from me? The noises are getting louder. I can't breathe. I should go hide. I should go hide. I am not supposed to be here. Where are you Icarus? Help me. Please my friend. You have been nowhere. We miss you. My hands are shaking. My vision is blurry. Is it tears? Is it fear? Have I wronged you Integrity? Can I fix this? Please, I mean no harm.
In addition, to the right side, it reads "I can't stop doodling these" with a long line of inverted triangles. === I SAW IT === Found by clicking "here I am" in the thread [http://localhost:2018/threads/ghostlyAspect/oncemore oncemore].
I SAW IT. I SAW IT. Fuck hold on, ahh fuck! The image is ruined! I saw it. You have to take my word for it, but I saw it. And Revuxor was right. It had a triangular head: ▽ It left it left it left. It teleported me to its location, letting me die in the night, it left. But I lived. And another hole leading to the void opened near me. What is happening to the letters...? They're breaking, glitching out. The openings... they are coming closer to me. It looked like this: A humanoid, made of black tendril like things, elongated arms and a triangular head.
== Forum Presence == [[File:GhostlyAspect Presence.png|border|500px|left|thumb|ghostlyAspect (2.0.5)]] {{Wiki navbox}}

pages.extract: {{Version|2.0.5}} {{Entity infobox |title=Hetzer |image=[[File:Hetzer2.0.gif|300px]] |Type=[[Entities#Souls|Soul]] |Association=__Blackout__, [[Phantom Player]] }} '''Hetzer''' is a unique, geometrically interesting [[Entities|Entity]], formerly a player named [[__Blackout__]]. He became this entity at some point after being killed by [[Circuit]], an event depicted in [[Items#Record_14|Record 14]]. It is known that Hetzer "teleports" entities for self-defence, but it is unknown why the entity of its choice is specifically Circuit. == Appearance == Hetzer appears to be a "spheroid" consisting of three rings, one on each axis, surrounding a small cube at it core. Its texture is white noise. == Stats == * '''Maximum Health''': 900 * '''Movement Speed''': 0 * '''Follow Range''': 1916 blocks * '''Attack Damage''': 13 * '''Armor''': 50 * '''Knockback Resistance / Knockback''': 50 / 0 * '''Step Height''': 0.6 blocks == Spawn == Hetzer can spawn naturally in the Overworld, using the shared entity spawn conditions. All of the following conditions must be satisfied: * '''Difficulty''': Not Peaceful * '''Biome''': Any biome (no biome restriction) * '''Dimension''': Overworld only * '''World state''': Null joined * '''Boss fight''': Does not spawn during [[Integrity|Integrity Boss Phase 1]] * '''Sky exposure''': The spawn position must be exposed to the sky; it will not spawn underground or under a roof * '''Light level''': Dark enough for a hostile mob to spawn * '''Block below''': The block below the spawn position must be a valid spawn block '''Rare spawn cooldown''': Cannot spawn while the shared rare-spawn cooldown is active; the cooldown is set to 30,000 ticks (25 minutes) whenever an entity-condition mob spawns * '''Mutual exclusion''': No other Hetzer and no [[Phantom Player]] may exist in the Overworld * '''Probability''': Depends on the moon corruption stage and the moon phase (see table below) * '''Superflat penalty''': In a superflat world, the already-low chance is further multiplied by 0.1% The spawn chance is read from the table below, where the row is the moon corruption stage (0–2, raised once per moon corruption event) and the column is the moon phase (0–7): {| class="wikitable" ! Moon phase !! 0 !! 1 !! 2 !! 3 !! 4 !! 5 !! 6 !! 7 |- ! Stage 0 | 0% || 0.001% || 0.01% || 0.05% || 0.1% || 0.3% || 0.35% || 0.35% |- ! Stage 1 | 0.1% || 0.2% || 0.2% || 0.2% || 0.25% || 0.9% || 1% || 1% |- ! Stage 2 | 0.3% || 0.3% || 0.6% || 0.6% || 0.5% || 0% || 0% || 0% |} === Phantom Player=== When the player is within 200 blocks of [[Phantom Player]], and the player is looking at it, there is a 1 in 10,000 chance per tick of a leaving a Hetzer in place. == Behaviour == Hetzer will appear and remain suspended in its place of origin, its model constantly shaking and visually teleporting around. '''Looking at Hetzer''' or coming within 10 blocks of it will cause it to vanish, give the player Blindness for {{tooltip|0.25 seconds|5 ticks}}, play false_subwoofer_lullaby.ogg'''false_subwoofer_lullaby.ogg''', and visually fake the player's time to daytime. After {{tooltip|50 seconds|1000 ticks}}, all sounds will abruptly stop and the player's time will be faked to midnight. {{tooltip|10 seconds|200 ticks}} after that, {{tooltip|1 minute|1200 ticks}} total after it vanishes, a [[Circuit]] will spawn in its place. If Hetzer is never seen or approached, it will despawn on its own after {{tooltip|2 minutes|2400 ticks}}. '''Hetzer ignores all attacks except /kill and void damage.''' == Gallery == File:Hetzer-2.gif|Hetzer（pre-2.0） in motion. File:Hetzerfixed transparent.png|Transparent Hetzer Render File:Hetzerfixed.png|Hetzer's texture File:Hetzer_scrapped_version.png|An older version of Hetzer. {{Version|2.0.5}} {{Player infobox |title=Icarus |nickname=icarusgaming1998, Abigail |image= {{GalleryHelper |ForumIcarus.png¦Profile Picture¦icarusgaming1998 |DailyWordIcarus.png¦IRL Picture¦Abigail }} |Profile=[http://localhost:2018/profile/icarusgaming1998 icarusgaming1998] |Died=2016 (age 20) }} '''icarus_1998''' was one of the users on the Clan Forum to investigate [[Spectrum 11]]. They were a friend of both [[Revuxor]] and [[ghostlyAspect]]. == Spectrum 11 - Icarus's World == Much information about Icarus's Spectrum 11 world is unknown currently. What is known is the effects of her mental state, and her eventual fate. === WEIRD MINECRAFT THINGS PART ONE === Found in the thread [http://localhost:2018/threads/icarusgaming1998/weird_minecraft_things_part_one WEIRD MINECRAFT THINGS PART ONE], dated between August 8th, 2010, through August 8th, 2011.
'''ICARUS WORLD WRITING ONE — 08/08/2010 TO 08/08/2011''' ''Hey guys, I truly did intend to post this yesterday but I got so caught up in writing it that I stayed up way longer than I should’ve. This will be the first writing study I do when it comes to my own solo dips into this weird version of Minecraft, to which I’ll be writing an overview of a year’s worth of gameplay. For compiling sake, there will be certain things that aren’t spoken about and I’d rather focus on the important things.'' Without further ado: '''08/08/2010 AT 22''' This was when I first created my own singleplayer world on this free version of Minecraft that my friends told me to download. They claimed that there were some irregularities and because, of course, I was a kid; I more than happily grabbed the file. It wasn’t like I didn’t have a copy of Minecraft, it was more so the growing fascination with the abnormal that drew me in. I’ve always been the type to be extremely skeptical of all of these horror stories you hear online, so to listen to them spout on about ‘how weird this Minecraft version is’, I took it as a personal challenge. There was nothing suspicious about the initial download of the game, it was more so what came after that caught me off guard. An inability to change the difficulty and cheats. Even though this was odd, I still assume that this particular pirated Minecraft version just didn’t come with the usual settings. Makes sense, most pirated games don’t have all features that are exclusive with games that have a legitimate key. When I spawned into the world, there was nothing in particular worthy of noting down. Just your usual world. I remember laughing when I spawned in because whatever the other two were on about was clearly not the case. '''10/08/2010 AT 08''' I played the world for around two days before anything significant happened, around possibly twelve hours of gameplay in total (it was so long ago that all I have to go on are notes that I wrote in a decrepit notebook. It’s barely legible now haha.) I noticed that the text of both my hotbar and Minecraft version began to visibly glitch out. At first, I truly did believe that it was my monitor deciding to play up because it’s had the tendency to do so. However, after tabbing out, I found this not to be the case. It’s not like it is utterly ground-shattering to see a few pixels bug out from time to time, though I remember that I thoroughly enjoyed the formation of some of them, so I sketched what I saw. Down below you will see an image illustrating a few of the patterns that these pixels bestowed. I will also be showing a picture I took from my phone¹. I remember feeling rather disappointed when this was all I experienced that day, even taking it upon myself to message the friend groupchat that all of this was a load of horseshit. Because, well, it was and quite honestly still is to an extent. ---- '''EXAMPLE IMAGE ONE''' [[File:Forum Example1.png|300px]] ---- '''27/02/2011 AT 10''' I’d say that this was the day that was the most memorable for me during this period of playtime as it was the first day that I came across a raised chunk² that protruded from the ground. With the particular version of Minecraft I was playing on, it actually makes a lot of sense as to why I had this error. Many users before me who own legitimate copies of the game and have had the exact same issue, so why would it be any different here? Well, that was until I came across a void hole³ that had conveniently taken shelter right underneath the raised chunk. As unnerving as it was at the time to experience, I now look back on the event and can chalk it up to a number of things: I was running this version on an extremely poor setup, so my computer may have potentially given out whilst generating the world. The game itself causes generation corruption. Perhaps some code was purposely messed with, thus causing a problematic experience for the user. Simply just a weird bit of terrain. It is not entirely impossible that this was just a location that was determined to be there via the seed. I actually ended up making a world to test a few things relating to this in December of that year (World: Test One, which I will write about in another post). One thing to note about this chunk error is that none of the water or lava would flow down the void hole, instead remaining in place despite there being nothing to obstruct its way. I used this as a makeshift mining area as it was rich with materials I needed, like iron, coal, etc. '''09/08/2011 AT 20''' This will be the last thing I write about this world during the span of that year as, quite frankly, not much happened other than the occasional glitches. This day in particular, however, I had realised there was a noticeable increase in these chunk errors around my world. A mixture of both void holes and raised chunks began to litter my world. Strange, but annoying honestly. Though, as time went by, I noticed that the game began to ‘spawn’ them right in front of me paired with an ambience that I couldn’t find in the game files. I can’t say I remember a lot after that, really. All my notes in this journal are extremely rushed and I was definitely up playing for quite a few hours because I noted that the sun rose before I stopped playing. I don’t know if it’s abnormal to have such a hazy memory of a gaming session that I can feel resonated with me so, so deeply. Because the other days I wrote about here, there is some form of clarity but this day, zilch. Nada. I dunno. Maybe I will have to ask Rev n’ Aspect about my behavior that night (if they even remember.) Sorry that this part was anticlimactic. I do not know why I felt so compelled to include this day, maybe as I edit this post I’ll remove it. If it’s still here, however, I either got lazy or decided that this would be good to reference back on. — Anyway, thanks for sticking around if you did. Appreciate it a bunch.
=== ICARUS WORLD - PART ELEVEN === Found in the thread [http://localhost:2018/threads/icarusgaming1998/icarus_world_part_eleven ICARUS WORLD - PART ELEVEN], dated between June 1st, 2015, through January 1st, 2016.
Sorry I haven’t updated any of you for a while. I can’t lie, my current playthrough has been an emotional rollercoaster. I decided to cut my Lily of the Valley world entirely due to the lack of events happening within it and focus solely on my main world. Because of that, anything I wrote relating to it has been scrapped. Anyway. It’s strange. Not once in the past few years has a game left me feeling this deflated. Or like, this exhausted. Maybe it’s eye strain? I spoke to a few of my IRL friends, and they said spending prolonged periods at the computer can make you feel sick because of blue light or something. I dunno. I’m not a doctor, and neither are they. I’m just hoping this fatigue lets up soon, because it’s beginning to be a hindrance. Eh, you guys aren’t here to listen to me ramble about myself, lol. Let’s get into it. I hope you enjoyed my last few posts. As always, I will only write about what I feel comfortable sharing publicly OR things that I see relevant. '''@ghostlyAspect @Revuxor''' (''I finally got around to writing this entry, like you wanted me to. Message me on disc. Got more images I just wanna show you both.'') '''ICARUS WORLD WRITING ELEVEN — 01/06/2015 - 01/01/2016''' ---- '''01/06/2015 AT 00''' The void holes in my world have continued to surround my house without a sign of stopping. Admittedly, it’s becoming harder and harder to traverse my world without accidentally falling into one. It’s strange, really. My heart pounds every single damned time I misclick and slip, my skin erupting into hives²⁵ without fail. It’s as though my body believes I am in danger, despite nothing actually being there. Never before have I reacted so viscerally to something as simple as dying in a video game. I know Revuxor and Aspect have been trying to convince me to stop playing. They think I’ve clearly been at this for far too long and that it’s time to take a break, but. I don’t know. This is the first time I’ve accepted that I might be experiencing a genuine anomaly within a video game, rather than some fictional sludge somebody has cobbled together. If I pursue this, I could write something /huge/. Something genuinely authentic instead of my usual, crappy debunking threads. Anyway, here’s a picture of one of the few void holes. [[File:Forum Icarus1.png|300px]] ---- For a few weeks, this type of generation kept following me in my steed. Bizarre, yes, but not anything that I would consider as particularly eerie. Though, I did get a bit annoyed, I will admit. After building a barrier out of fences in hopes that I wouldn’t fall, I desperately pleaded with the world to just. Stop. As if that would do anything, as if the damned game is somewhat sentient²⁷. I feel crazy, honestly because a part of me does believe that it is in fact able to listen to me. To consider my words and spit them right in my face. I dunno. Here’s a picture of the text I wrote, anyway. All glitched out. [[File:Forum Icarus2.png|300px]] ---- ** 20/12/2015 - AT 03 ** I had to call in sick to work for a week after, unfortunately, falling ill from the lack of sleep²⁶ I’d been getting. My time-management skills were all over the place and, admittedly, they still are. To say I’m shocked they haven’t outright binned me for so blatantly avoiding my responsibilities would be an understatement. Though, they’d understand if they were going through the same thing as me, right? God, I’m getting sidetracked. Anyway, something extremely bizarre happened during that week. Every time I loaded into my world, my monitor would fail to render certain text²⁸ and other parts of the game properly. You can see what I mean in the following images: '''EXAMPLE A''' [[File:Forum Icarus3.png|300px]] ---- '''EXAMPLE B''' [[File:Forum Icarus4.png|300px]] ---- It unnerved me, honestly, but compared to everything else that had been happening, this was merely a drop in the ocean. I’ve wondered whether these shapes mean anything, though I think that might be too much of a stretch. Moving on, this was the day something extremely bizarre happened. I was out exploring, following the wool markers I briefly mentioned in my previous entries, when it suddenly turned night. This was not an event that I have been privy to in the past, so, to have that paired with the sound of bells blaring in my ears; I once again felt myself sink into my chair. God, what the fuck is wrong with me? I don’t even know how to like. Properly conduct myself anymore whilst playing this damned game. It’s like every single time something ‘unsettling’ happens, a sickness begins to plague my body²⁹ and somehow I have to fight my way through it. I’m am getting tired of this. Of all of it. But, here. [[File:Forum Icarus5.png|300px]] ---- The version itself was also all screwed up. Unable to stick to its original, multiple question marks would flash as if it was struggling to read the numbers. I remember I shook my monitor a few times after taking this photo, yelling obscenities until my neighbour decided to bang against my wall. Asshole. He knows that I’ve been spending my time on this shit, that I am so close to figuring something out and he interrupted MY playtime? Right. Awesome. Cool. I suppose it was lucky that he did, however. Because as soon as I paid attention to the screen once again, I caught the glimpse of a few red eyes³⁰ before this popped up. I was booted out of my game. [[File:Forum Icarus6.png|300px]] ---- Time. What damned time? No, the game was definitely speaking to me. There is no way it wasn’t and it wished to get in the way of the investigation that myself, Revuxor and Aspect have dedicated ourselves to. I had to take a break after this, logging off at around 13 . The more I have played this game, the more you don’t realise time slipping away from you. ---- 01/01/2016 at 01 And I suppose here comes today’s log. It isn’t going to be long as I still have the game booted up in the background, but I swear the moon has eyes. I keep opening up the tab just to look at it. Why does it look like that? Is this the thing that has been causing all this shit? It made me think of the eyes I saw before getting booted off all those weeks ago. God. It is making me feel worse. Sorry, I can’t type. I just. Gotta play.

== Spectrum 11 - Icarus's Fate == === Bye. === Found in the thread [http://localhost:2018/threads/icarusgaming1998/bye_ Bye.], dated February 28th, 2016.
I want to say I am happy. Whether this is a note of my departure from this world is uncertain, but, I just want to say to all those who are reading this: It is never worth the risk. The curiosity. But, when you have led a life as unfufilling as mine, you cannot help but find solace when you know things are about to end. Who knew that I would become so content with the concept of death at such a young age. I never got married, had kids, got a job that I actually liked. Nah, I threw all my eggs into the 'creepypasta hunter' basket. Now, I'm going to address Rev and Aspect in this next section specifically: I am sorry I never believed you guys in the beginning. It was foolish of me to expect that within this world that runs on logic that it would be illogical for the whimsical and sinister to occur. It's probably my fault that people think you guys are somewhat loopy, I guess. Well. I love you guys. Sorry. I can hear it now. It wants to take me flying. . . . Is it bad to say I've always wanted wings?
=== Daily Word === [[File:DailyWord.png|300px|thumb|RIP Abigail]] By clicking "What damned time?" in the thread [[#ICARUS WORLD - PART ELEVEN|ICARUS WORLD - PART ELEVEN]], a Google Drive file can be opened, titled "dailyword.png" The image is a newspaper article reporting a dead woman named Abigail found within her apartment. === The Truth === By clicking "wings?" in the thread [[#Bye.|Bye.]], a Google Drive file can be opened, titled "The Truth.png" The image shown contains a dialogue, written below, likely between Integrity and Icarus. All text in white is encrypted with a Pigpen Cipher. [[File:TheTruth.webp|500px|thumb|The Truth.]]
There she stood, little Icarus, gazing at the sun. Warmth pooling upon her cheeks of her frail, mortal frame. "I wish for wings." A pause. It is uncertain why she lingered in silence for so long, but as swiftly as it came it passed. "I'll climb beyond the highest point this world can offer. Then I'll fly. I'll be the one to dismantle that blazing lie." The world doesn't answer to those like her. "Then, I'll simply return with the truth. Nothing but the truth." Though, I have always been fond of those who mistake silence for absolute. It takes a certain type of blind arrogance to assume you are alone in the vastness of the universe. She didn't seem fond of the reminder, though. One crack. Then another. Bone gave way with such a reluctant grace. One vertebre coaxing the next until her spine bowed beneath a shape no human was ever meant to branish. Flesh stretched thin enough to remember it had once belonged to something whole, instead of this disjointed canvas of capitulation. Yet, against all odds, she smiled. She actually smiled. Poor thing. Donning the mask of jesters and believers that those pearlescent crimson jewels that decorated her chassis was something of a gift. That pain was simply the price for the truth. She still called them wings as she rose, ignoring how parts of her began to drift from the bone. How the body she once identified with surrendered to the climb. Flying higher and higher, chasing that gentle orange glow that called to her since she looked skyward. You remember Icarus for his fall. I remember that, for one beautiful moment, she flew.

{{Stub|Phase 3 Animations are missing}} {{Entity infobox |title=Integrity |image= {{GalleryHelper |Integrity phase 1.png¦Integrity |Integrity phase 2.png¦Phase 2 |Integrity phase 3.png¦True Form (Phase 3) |Integrityghost redeyes.png¦Curious |New s11 Integrity Transparent Render w.png¦spectrum_11 }} |Role=Antagonist |Type=[[Entities#Void Creatures|Void Creature]] |Affiliations=[[Void]] |HP=1024 ([[#Phase 3|Phase 3]]) }} {{Quote |text = Want to know what happened to them? Well... It wasn't their fault. They did nothing wrong. I made them like this because I wanted to. They didn't even have time to react. They were just like you. Wandering around until I found them. And I ended it quickly. I brought them home, deep down under the bedrock. They never got the chance to see it. Their curiosity was their downfall. And yours will be just the same. I'll bring you home just like I did the others. I'll give you a new life with them. Your hope won't save you this time. Their prayers meant nothing. And neither will yours. |author = Integrity's speech when summoned. }} '''Integrity''' is the most powerful Void Creature and the main antagonist of [[The Broken Script]] and [[spectrum_11]], being ultimately responsible for everything that has occurred in the storyline. On October 13th, 2010, Integrity latched onto the Hubble Space Telescope in real life and used it to access the internet. Through the internet, Integrity found his foothold in a pirated Minecraft launcher/environment, and began waiting for players to join. As he learned more about the game and humans, Integrity grew in power, eventually being capable of manipulating game mechanics, such as removing the Players' ability to leave the game and even transforming his victims into entities. == Appearance == === Curious === A ghost that drifts like a will-o’-the-wisp; its appearance broadly resembles that of phase 1 at about 45% transparency. === Phase One === A pitch-black, slender, tendrilous entity, approximately 9 blocks tall, with an inverted equilateral triangle head and several dark red eyes. === Phase Two === Integrity's head splits in two along the central vertical axis of symmetry, similar to one of his appearances in [[spectrum_11]], with the crack extending all the way down to his waist. His upper body bristles with more spikes, while his drooping, luxuriant tentacles become fluffier and more spread out. === True Form (Phase 3) === His most common shape, the feet resemble tree roots, and the bulk of his tentacles twist back into squid-tentacle shape rather than hair-strand shape, splaying outward more prominently; the spikes on his head and his eyes radiate an even more vivid red glow. == Personality == {{Quote | text = The server will become our grave, and this world will be our catedral, no one will ever know where we are. No one will remember us, and I hope he will finaly say goodbye. Deep down under the bedrock he hides no more. | author = [[xXram2dieXx]] after going insane talking about their fates from Integrity. }} Based on current information, it's shown that Integrity is a sadistic, remorseless and malevolent monster that doesn't seem to have any real reason for his actions other than just because he can and "wanted to". He lacks any sense of empathy, openly admitting that his prey did nothing to provoke him and that he tortures them purely for his own amusement. He displays some degree of psychological manipulation, rather than simply attacking, he often mocks his victims with false comfort and cruel reassurance right before condemning them to a fate worse than death. [[DJ2trappy2skeezy]], who was religious and believed suffering had purpose, was so horrified by what Integrity did to his best friend that he lost faith in a loving God. Integrity's most notable trait however is his god-complex, specifically his claims of bringing his victims home and telling the player that he'll give them new life with them. According to [[xXram2dieXx]], the server was to become their grave and the world was to become a cathedral. It is unclear just how many victims Integrity has. == Behaviour == The Broken Script = Integrity was added to the mod in version 2.0, no longer being work-in-progress. Unlike most entities, he does not usually exhibit any haunting behaviors, though he can appear as a result of the [[Moon Glitch]] event. Instead, he serves as the mod's final boss and can be encountered after defeating [[Fractured]]. === Curious === If [[Moon Glitch]] occurs while the Player is exposed to open sky, there is a 50% chance that Integrity will spawn 35 blocks in front of the Player after {{tooltip|2.75 seconds|55 ticks}}, named '''Integrity.Curious'''. Integrity in this state is completely harmless, and will disappear if the Player either looks at Integrity or comes within 9 blocks of him. Integrity will despawn after {{tooltip|21 seconds|420 ticks}}. === Progression === To fight Integrity, the player must first acquire both [[The Polaroid]] and the [[Corrupted Command Block]]. After getting these items, the player must find the futile_efforts structure using the [[Corrupted Command Block]] and place it on the Initiator block. Upon opening the block's GUI, the Player must input the code from [[The Polaroid]] and click '''Execute'''. [[File:Futile efforts.png|thumb|none|'''Futile Efforts''' structure with a sign which reads "Their efforts lead to nothing. You won't make any difference."]] === Boss Fight === The command block removes Integrity's operator permissions making him come out of the ground. As he does, Integrity claims he did everything just because he could then explains how he lured the players into the caves to his lair where he killed them quickly before they could run away from him. After this speech, Integrity's bossfight starts. ===== Phase 1 ===== Integrity summons ten [[Chord]]s, and is immune to all forms of damage. After the Player kills all the Chord, Phase 2 begins. ===== Phase 2 ===== The player is teleported to the Clan Void ([[stage2]]) and "Necrosis" blocks appear in a trail. Integrity is again immune to all damage and chases the player to try and kill them. To progress, the player must follow the necrosis blocks and kill the Tethers, where it'll rid the necrosis around it, allowing the player to drop down to the next layer. The layers are in order of: Day A, Stone, Wood, Maze, Clan Void (layer), Null Torture, and then Nowhere. Tether.png|Tether Tether-spawn.gif|Tether spawn Tether.gif|Tether idle Tether-hurt.gif|Tether hurt Tether-death.gif|Teather death After the player kills the last void tether in Nowhere and drops down, Phase 3 begins. ===== Phase 3 ===== Similar to Phase 2, the Player and Integrity end up in another dimension, this one being similar to [[The Moon]] dimension ([[Void Shadow]]). Integrity in this phase is now able to be damaged and killed, having a health bar of 1024 health points. [[File:Integrity_Healthbar.png]] Additionally, Integrity himself will begin to directly attack the Player, using the following attacks: * '''Levitation:''' Integrity floats in the air and lifts the player into the air. If the player doesn't move or sneak and go too high up, they'll be killed with the death message "(player) is no more." * '''Area Tendril:''' When the player has enough distance, Integrity puts his arms into the ground which then leads to tentacles to come out of it from 6 sides. If the player touches these tentacles they will take damage. * '''Fireball:''' Integrity can occasionally shoot a fireball at the player. It can be parried back at Integrity to deal damage. * '''Ground Tendril:''' Integrity will shove its right arm into the ground, with the lower arm rising up from the ground where the player is. The player has a small window to avoid it. Integrity is able to be stunned by either being hit by the Void Tentacles in the arena, or by his own fireball if it has been parried. While stunned, Integrity will temporarily take increased damage. ===== Defeat ===== Integrity staggers and a void tentacle drops down from the sky and grabs him. The tentacle then lifts him up into the [[Void]] in the sky, leaving his fate is unknown. |-|spectrum_11 = === spectrum_11 === Integrity will haunt the player occasionally in-game. Eventually after some time he will spawn in his Endgame behavior. ==== Watching ==== Integrity will appear on the ground and look at the player, waving at them, while his body is split in half. A ringing bell will signal his appearance. Getting too close to him will cause one of four things to happen: # He vanishes and teleports the player in his place. # He vanishes and teleports the player in his place, randomly placing around bedrock. # He kicks the player from the world with the message, “You still have some time.” # He switches to Chase behaviour. ==== Chase ==== Integrity will chase the player and try to kill them. He's capable of destroying blocks in his chasing state and can bridge over the water with polished basalt for whoever he is chasing. ==== Endgame ==== Integrity will play the “You will become one of us” voice line and ban the player from the world with the message “Connection terminated: No further information.” == Notes == * As the source of all the suffering in [[The Broken Script]], his immediate demise could theoretically be the salvation of the [[Lore|former clan]]'s souls within [[The Broken Script]]. * Though Void Creatures canonically lack gender identities or a biological sex, Integrity is referred to as he/him pronouns by his victims and the developers. * Attempting to run the command /deop Integrity results in the text "Nothing changed. Your efforts are worthless." * Although Phase 3 is technically Integrity's 'true form', it just means it's the most common shape he takes due to Void Creatures being amorphous. * Integrity is the one and only entity in [[spectrum_11]]. * https://data.mc-anomaly-archive.org/files/spectrum_11.txt reveals the origins of [[spectrum_11]], being a first-person account by someone, which includes the following passage describing the origin of the entity's name, [[Integrity]] (excerpt below): (their native language is Russian):
"...Но самый жуткий момент случился через несколько дней ночью.
Я заблудился в лесу, у меня не было фачелов, и я почти ничего не видел из-за этого тумана.
Мой меч сломался, так что мне пришлось бежать от зомби и криперов, пока у меня было всего пару сердец и без еды.
И вот, в очередной раз оглянувшись, я заметил в тумане что-то черное.
Абсолютно черное, даже темнее самой ночи.
Оно было в тумане, на самом краю видимости.

Я никогда такого раньше не видел.
Новый редкий моб? Баг?
Оно не двигалось, просто стояло на траве среди деревьев и смотрело на меня.
Оно было выше деревьев, тонкое, с головой в виде перевернутого треугольника и множеством красных глаз…
Но стоило мне только навести на эту штуку мышь, и тут она буквально РВАНУЛАСЬ на меня.
Она была быстрее привычных монстров, настолько быстрой, что я даже не успел ударить ее или убежать.
Она просто вбежала в меня.
Не было ни звука урона, ничего.
А игра просто тут же вылетела.
Но на привычном экране краш-лога было что-то новое.
В самом конце, две строчки, которые выбивались на фоне других:

“Integrity check failed.
Here I am.”

Сначала я просто офигел.
Потом подумал, что это какое-то эпичное нововведение.
Я запустил игру снова и попытался зайти в тот же мир.
Загрузка прошла как обычно, но как только должен был появиться мой мир, вместо этого появился какой-то текст.
Я открыл переводчик, и смог понять только то, что я был ЗАБАНЕН из своего же собственного ОДИНОЧНОГО мира.
Я пробовал раз 10 зайти обратно.
Всегда одно и то же.
Мой мир был мертв.
В конце концов, я просто удалил его и оставил Майнкрафт на несколько месяцев."


Translation:
"...But the creepiest moment happened a few days later, at night.
I was lost in a forest, I had no torches, and I could barely see anything through that fog. My sword had broken, so I had to run from zombies and creepers with just a couple of hearts left and no food.
And then, glancing back yet again, I noticed something black in the fog.
Absolutely black. Even darker than the night itself.
It was in the fog, right at the very edge of vision.

I had never seen anything like that before. A new rare mob? A bug?
It didn’t move — it just stood on the grass among the trees and stared at me.
It was taller than the trees, thin, with an inverted-triangle head and many red eyes…
But the moment I pointed my cursor at the thing, it literally SPRINTED at me.
It was faster than the usual monsters — so fast that I couldn’t even swing at it or run. It just ran right through me.
There was no damage sound — nothing.
And the game simply crashed on the spot.
But on the familiar crash log screen, there was something new.
At the very end, two lines that stood out from the rest:

Integrity check failed.
Here I am.

At first I just froze. Then I figured it was some epic new feature.
I launched the game again and tried to get back into the same world. The load went as usual, but right where my world was supposed to appear, there was some text instead.
I opened a translator, and all I could make out was that I had been BANNED from my own SINGLEPLAYER world.
I tried going back about ten times. Always the same thing.
My world was dead.
In the end, I just deleted it and left Minecraft alone for a few months."
