pages.extract:
{{stub|Need to document all the items and their relevance.}} The Broken Script adds many items and blocks into the game. Most items are harmless and do not have any functionality beyond adding context to the mod's lore with audio or textual information. Most of the blocks serve some sort of function, ranging from dimensional transportation to nuisances. == Items == === Attribute Mutilation === A music disc with the song '''Attribute Mutilation''', the same as played during the [[Fractured#Boss Fight|Fractured Boss Fight]]. === A Story Fractured === A music disc with the song '''A Story Fractured''', the same as played during the ending credits. The disc shares the same texture as Music Disc 11. === Instability === 4 music discs with different versions of the song '''Instability''', the same as one played during the [[Integrity#Boss Fight|Integrity Boss Fight]]. The design of the music discs resemble the broken moon, featuring a grey base and red outline, with increasing visual corruption on the disc between each variant of the song. The music box cover of Instability shares the same visual corruption as Instability V1, but with inverted colours. Instability was originally created by L0V3M1ST as a fan-made bossfight theme for [[Integrity]], later becoming official, receiving two major updates preceding the release of 2.0. It also received a music box cover. Only Instability V2 is obtainable without cheats, requiring [[name.null]], [[name.revuxor]], and [[Disc 16]] to craft it. [[File:Instability_showcase.gif|border|241x241px]] === Lilly's Theme === 2 music discs with different versions of of the song '''Lilly's Theme''', made by L0V3M1ST. === Music Disc 14 === A music disc with the song '''14'''. The disc shares the same texture as Music Disc 13. '''14''' can only be found in [[WORLD2]], hidden away in a mineshaft under the Clan Base. The audio depicts the death of [[__Blackout__]] in the caves by [[Circuit]]. [[File:record14.ogg|frameless]] === Music Disc 15 === A music disc with the song '''15 (Betray)'''. The disc shares the same texture as Music Disc Cat. '''15 (Betray)''' can only be found in [[WORLD2]], found in the forest north of the Clan Base. The audio depicts the death of [[xXram2dieXx]] in the forest by [[The Broken End]]. [[File:disc15.betray.ogg|frameless]] === Music Disc 16 === A music disc with the song '''16 (You can't)'''. The disc shares the same texture as Music Disc 11. '''16 (You can't)''' can be obtained as a loot drop from [[Curved]], and can also be found within [[DyeXD412]]'s inventory in [[WORLD2]]. The audio depicts a crude, robotic voice reading a series of hexadecimal characters.
49 74 20 77 61 73 20 68 69 6D 2E 20 44 6F 20 6E 6F 74 20 67 6F 20 69 6E 74 6F 20 74 68 65 20 63 61 76 65 73 2E 20 50 6C 65 61 73 65 2E 20 59 6F 75 20 64 6F 6E 27 74 20 77 61 6E 74 20 74 6F 20 62 65 63 6F 6D 65 20 6F 6E 65 20 6F 66 20 74 68 65 6D 2E
When translated into ASCII characters, it reads:
It was him. Do not go into the caves. Please. You don't want to become one of them.
[[File:disc16.youcant.ogg|frameless]] It can be used to craft [[#Instability|Instability V2]] === Music Disc 17 === A music disc with the song '''17 (Silenced)'''. The disc has a unique texture, featuring many gray features that [[name.revuxor]] has, as well as some blue and yellow colours. '''17 (Silenced)''' can only be found in [[WORLD2]], found underground just north of [[Revuxor]]'s base. The audio depicts the real-life death of [[Revuxor]], after a [[Circuit]] broke through his computer and chased him through his home. [[File:disc17.silenced.ogg|frameless]] === Food === ==== Null Bread ==== A piece of bread with darkened features, mirroring the look of [[Null]]. Upon being eaten, the Player will lose 1 hunger bar. This item was originally introduced in an April Fools version. Eating it in this version removed 3 hunger bars and placed a piece of bedrock on the Player. ==== Circuit Bread ==== A piece of bread with a blackened features and a wire-like design, mirroring the look of [[Circuit]] Upon being eaten, the Player will lose 5 hunger bars. ==== Null Cod ==== A cod with darkened features, mirroring the look of [[Null]]. Upon being eaten, the Player will lose 1.5 hunger bars. ==== Faraway Salmon ==== A salmon with all white features, mirroring the look of [[Faraway]] Upon being eaten, the Player will lose 10 hunger bars and take 100 hearts of damage. Additionally, the Wither I effect will be applied for 50 seconds. This item can rarely be obtained in the [[Clan Void#Wood|Clan Void]]. ==== Revuxorfish ==== A pufferfish with grayed and darkened features, mirroring the look of [[Revuxor]] Upon being eaten, the Player will lose 10 hunger bars. Additionally, the Wither V effect will be applied for 10 seconds. ==== Dev Cod ==== A cod with various designs based off of Broken Script Developers or other easter eggs. Additionally, the names are all puns. Upon being eaten, the Player will gain 1 hunger bars. === Documents === ==== Book ==== Not to be confused with a book from Minecraft, '''Books''' are paler in texture and function similarly as a written book. A '''Book''' can be obtained within the [[Library]]. When breaking a [[Mono Library]], a '''Book''' may drop at a 16% chance (Unaffected by Fortune). Right Clicking a '''Book''' will open it, with a total of 255 different IDs. If the ID is any number between 1 and 45, then it will be one of the 45 findable indexes. If the ID is outside of this range, then the book will contain either nothing or messy, obfuscated text, based off if it is even or odd, respectively. An option labeled '''Index''' can be seen on the left-hand side of the page at all times. Clicking on this button will show the list of all 45 indexes, and will become clickable once the index unlocked. More information about the '''Book''' can be found [[Library|here]]. ==== Manuscript ==== '''Manuscripts''' are items found within the [[Library]]. When breaking a [[Mono Library]], a '''Manuscript''' may drop at a 4% chance (Unaffected by Fortune). Right Clicking a '''Manuscript''' will permanently unlock an index within the '''Book''', but will not always unlock indexes that are currently locked. More information about the '''Manuscript''' can be found [[Library|here]]. ==== so it begins ==== [[File:So it begins.png|right|200px|thumb|so it begins]] A photograph of [[XoxDairyQueen]] and [[Fever]]. Right Clicking it shows the image in higher quality. '''so it begins''' can be found in the structure of the same name in [[Limbo#so it begins|Limbo]]. ==== Torn Paper ==== '''Torn Paper''' is an item crucial to [[Progression#Polaroid Piece 3|Progression]]. The '''Torn Paper''' can be acquired as a loot drop from [[Curved]]. Right Clicking with it will open a GUI with the coordinates to [[Polaroid Piece 3]]. === Polaroid Pieces === The Polaroid pieces are major points within [[Progression#Polaroid Pieces|Progression]]. These items '''cannot''' be recovered without cheating, even with /give. * '''Polaroid Piece 1''' can be obtained in the Clan Void layer of the [[Clan Void#Clan Void (layer)|Clan Void]]. * '''Polaroid Piece 2''' can be obtained in the Maze layer of the [[Clan Void#Maze|Clan Void]]. * '''Polaroid Piece 3''' can be obtained in the Wood layer of the [[Clan Void#Wood|Clan Void]]. * '''Polaroid Piece 4''' can be obtained in the Stone layer of the [[Clan Void#Stone|Clan Void]]. * '''Polaroid Piece 5''' can be obtained in the Day A layer of the [[Clan Void#Day A|Clan Void]]. '''''Don't lose it''''' === The Polaroid === [[File:The Polaroid.png|right|200px|thumb|The Polaroid]] '''The Polaroid''' can be obtained by crafting all Polaroid Pieces together. Right Clicking with the Polaroid in hand will reveal a photo of the [[Clan Build]], featuring [[xXram2dieXx]], [[DyeXD412]], and [[WHYER4]] standing outside. The bottom right of the photo has a code that is utilized later in [[Progression#Corrupted Command Block|Progression]]. '''''Don't lose it''''' === Miscellaneous === ==== Glaggle Token ==== Gaggle Tokens can be acquired in [[Lucid]] at chance by breaking the concrete in the dimension. ==== name.null ==== A flat, full sized item with a missing texture, findable in various structures. Right Clicking '''name.null''' in either the main or off hand slot will cause it to disappear from the Player's inventory. It can be used to craft [[#Instability|Instability V2]] ==== name.revuxor ==== A flat, full sized item with a static noise texture, findable in various structures. The texture for this item is titled '''gore''', and is [[Revuxor]]'s viscera and gore after his death. Right Clicking '''name.revuxor''' in either the main or off hand slot will cause it to disappear from the Player's inventory. It can be used to craft [[#Instability|Instability V2]] == Blocks == === Moon Stone === Moon Stone is a paler version of endstone, found solely on [[The Moon]]. It can be crafted into various decorative blocks, including a corrupted variant. === Border Blocks === Between the different layers of [[Clan Void]] are Border Blocks. These are unbreakable blocks which serve as preventative measures against the Player breaking their way through the dimension. When attempting to break any variant, small white circles will appear on the block texture where it was being broken at. There are 7 variants, though most of them are self explanatory. * Border Block: A variant made of oak planks. * Dirt Border Block: A variant made of dirt. * Cobblestone Border Block: A variant made of cobblestone. * Stone Border Block: A variant made of stone. * Stone Brick Border Block: A variant made of stone bricks. * Stone Slab Border Block: A variant made of smooth stone. * Glass Border Block: A variant made of glass. The '''Glass Border Block''' is a unique variant, where it also displays various blocks in an endless loop of falling. === Void Plants === ===== Validated Subjugation ===== lang Template 15 ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.void_template_15 ==== Void Template 16 ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.void_template_16 === Protected Void === '''Protected Void''' is a set of blocks found within the [[Protected Void]] dimension. Additionally, these blocks can be found in the [[Structures#Shrapnel|shrapnel]] and [[Structures#Markermarker|markermarker]] structures. All protected variants produce an anvil sound when placed. There are a total of 5 variants: * Protected Void Block: The default block variant. * Protected Void Stairs: The stair variant, found only in the [[Protected Void]] staircase and one side room. * Protected Void Slabs: The slab variant, found only in one side room. * Void Light: A light-emitting variant found on the [[Structures#Markermarker|markermarker]] structure, as well as in [[Protected Void]]. * Void Door: A door which separate each room found in [[Protected Void]]. === Mono === ==== Mono Door ==== The Mono Door is a door found in the Library section of [[Protected Void]] that leads to the [[Library]]. It constantly has a shader based texture when the door is open or closed that makes it look like a portal. ==== Mono Library ==== Mono Libraries are black and white bookshelves that may drop books and manuscripts when broken. They can be found in the [[Library]]. ==== Mono Planks ==== Mono planks are gray planks that can be found in the [[Library]]. Despite having a slab and stair variant, Mono Planks cannot be used to craft anything. ==== Mono Slab ==== Mono slabs are gray slabs that can be found in the [[Library]]. ==== Mono Stairs ==== Mono stairs are gray stairs that can '''not''' be found in the [[Library]]. === Ceiling & Wallpaper === ==== Ceiling Light ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.ceiling_light ==== Ceiling Tile ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.ceiling_tile ==== Moist Carpet ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.moist_carpet ==== Stained Ceiling Light ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.red_ceiling_light ==== Stained Ceiling Tile ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.red_ceiling_tile ==== Stained Carpet ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.red_moist_carpet ==== Stained Wallpaper ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.red_ugly_wallpaper ==== Wallpaper ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.ugly_wallpaper === Jim Triggers === ==== Jim Trigger 1 ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.jim_trigger_1 ==== Jim Trigger 2 ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.jim_trigger_2 ==== Jim Trigger 3 ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.jim_trigger_3 ==== Jim Trigger 4 ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.jim_trigger_4 === Miscellaneous === ==== A flower ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.a_flower A Flower is an indestructable, non-solid block. It's main purpose is to spawn [[Fractured]] in, and will wilt once done. It spawns on [[The Moon]] on the Tower structure. ==== 431434 ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.all_dead 431434 is an indestructible, non-solid, shader-based block. It is replaceable and can be washed away, dropping itself. If the player enters it, they will be teleported to [[Clan Void]], [[Protected Void]], or [[Null Torture]]. This behaviour does not apply to mobs and items, and will not teleport a Player to the same dimension twice. Looking into the block shows darkness and static-like effects, as well as floating white cubes. ==== 434134 ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.all_gone ==== Block Is Missing Id ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.block_is_missing_id ==== Corrupted Command Block ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.command ==== Concrete ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.concrete ==== Cyan Rose ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.cyan_rose ==== Decomposed Semiotics ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.decomposed_semiotics ==== Deviation ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.deviation ==== Disruption ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.disruption Disruption is a non-solid block with a missing texture. It can be broken or washed away, dropping name.null. It disappears approximately 9 seconds after being placed. ==== Empty ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.empty ==== 53135Exit6436 ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.exit 53135Exit6436 is an indestructible, non-solid, light-emitting, shader-based block. It can be washed away by water, but will not drop itself. If the player enters it, they will be either transported to a different layer if in the [[Clan Void]], another tunnel if in [[Null Torture]], or they will be teleported directly into the Overworld. Mobs and items are unaffected. It seems to be the opposite of 431434 Looking into the block shows light and static-like effects, as well as floating black cubes. ==== Flesh ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.flesh ==== Hello ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.hello Hello is a semi-transparent block that can be found in one of xXram2dieXx's chests in the Clan Build. It can also spawn as a random event, or in a structure. When broken, it will spawn a 5x3 cross made of netherrack. This includes a sign on the central block. It will play a heartbeat sound for a few seconds. Its destruction is a known condition for xXram2dieXx to join the game and spawn. [[File:HelloBlock.png|alt=|none|thumb|243x243px|Hello in a inventory slot.]] File:HelloBlockCross.png|The Hello 5x3 cross. File:HelloBlockCrossSignText.png|The text that reads on the sign. ==== Initiator ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.initiator ==== Int ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.int ==== Intense Projection ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.intense_projection ==== It ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.it It can be obtained by placing water next to it, or by using the command /give @s thebrokenscript:it. It's appearance is a transparent block with scratches that use the 404 texture. The player, along with other entities such as items and mobs, can walk through it. It is also indestructible to explosions, but will break and drop when coming in contact with a water block. The block can also naturally spawn in the Clan base structure. Unlike blocks like 431434 and Shadow Bug, it can not be destroyed by placing another block on top of it, as it would just place the block off of it. [[File:It_block.png|left|thumb|400x400px|The "It" block when placed in Creative mode.]] ==== Lily Of The Abyss ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.lily_of_the_abyss ==== Limbo ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.limbo ==== name.missing ==== lang keyblock.thebrokenscript.name_missing name.missing is a non-obtainable, non-solid block, used to represent a location where a player has died. '''Jon''' is an easter egg entity that can only be spawned through commands. 

He is a reference to the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p10eX9N5DDU&t=22441s&pp=ygUaYmFyb25vZnNvbWV0aGluZyBhYmFuZG9uZWQ%3D Abandoned] ARG, where he is a side character only appearing in [https://www.youtube.com/@Barronofsomething Baron of something]'s series. His model and animations were given to the developers by [https://www.youtube.com/@bloodreaper4515 Thy Bloodreaper], the creator of the Abandoned ARG, along with permission to add it to the mod as an easter egg.

== Appearance ==
Jon is a blocky-looking roblox noob with a poorly drawn face.

== Behavior ==
[[File:Jon b4 update.png|alt=W jong|thumb|Jon (ft. baron of something)]]
Jon's spawn is accompanied with the message "Jon joined the game".

Upon spawning, Jon will walk around aimlessly. Occasionally, he can talk in a robotic text-to-speech voice, in which case he will repeatedly say either of the following:

* "Hello!"
* "Let's play Minecraft!"
Jon can be killed with survival weapons, seen as he only has 10 HP. Upon being killed, Jon will drop into the ground, and he will disappear with the message "Jon left the game".
[[File:Dead jon b4 update.png|alt=RIP Jon|thumb|Dead Jon (ft. Baron of something]]

pages.title: Library
pages.extract:
{{Version|2.0.5}}
[[File:图书馆.png|thumb|The Library.]]

The '''Library''' is an endless passage of [[Items#Mono Library|Mono Libraries]]. 

The dimension can be accessed through a passageway in [[Protected Void]], or at chance after sleeping.

== Mechanics ==
=== Ambience ===
As long as the player is in the dimension, '''library.ogg''' will play.

[[File:Library.ogg]]

=== Coordinates ===
While in this dimension, the Player's coordinate in the F3 Menu will be all marked as ???. Despite this, external tools can still show the Player's coordinates.

=== Teleportation ===
The '''Library''' can teleport the Player between different areas, dependent on their Y-Level.
* If a Player goes below Y = 44, they will be transported '''up''' 68 blocks, repeating until they reach either Y = 44 or above.
* If a Player goes above Y = 130, they will be transported '''down''' 68 blocks, repeating until they reach either Y = 130 or below.

This will happen no matter how far above or below a Player is, and will repeat continuously until either the Player is removed from the dimension or is within the correct range.

This does '''not''' happen with items or other entities, as they will stay on their respective Y level. It is not recommended to drop important items or entities within this dimension. 

=== Fall Damage ===
All fall damage is negated in the '''Library'''.

== Rooms ==
The rooms of the '''Library''' are a bit unusual, as there are only 2 generated segments within the dimension (Library & Library2. However, these are pieced together in a way which create differing exterior spaces to the rooms. 

=== Library 1 ===
Library 1 is has 8 entrances / exits, shaped into an X shape, and is solely made up of Mono Libraries.

[[File:Library Room 1.png|200px|border]]

=== Library 2 ===
Library 2 is a taller room than Library 1, and is made up of Mono Libraries as well. In addition, Mono Planks and Slabs appear, functioning as a staircase up or down a level.

[[File:Library Room 2.png|200px|border]]

=== Exterior ===
Breaking outside of any of the interior rooms will lead to the exterior of the '''Library'''. Endless pits can appear in the exterior, either as a 8x6 or 8x4 hole.
<gallery>
Library Exterior-1Odd.png
Library Exterior-1Even.png
Library Exterior-2Side.png
Library Exterior-2Up.png
Library Exterior-2Down.png
</gallery>

== Exit ==
Dying inside the dimension, or waiting inside it for a period of time, will teleport the player back to the Overworld.

== Notes ==
# Despite being teleported when going too high or low, the '''Library''' still extends upwards to Y = 203 and downwards to Y = -51. Additionally, the '''Library''' has a build limit of 255.
# This dimension may be inspired by ''Library of Babel'', which is a short story by Borges from 1941. It describes a library made up of an infinite number of hexagonal galleries: through all the permutations and combinations of a mere twenty-five symbols, it houses every book that could possibly be written, and is therefore at once the sum of all knowledge and, almost entirely, meaningless gibberish.

pages.title: Limbo
pages.extract: {{Version|2.0.5}} [[File:LimboThumbnail.png|alt=Limbo|thumb|Limbo]] '''Limbo''' is a dimension that can be accessed by sleeping. The player will have a limited time in it before getting kicked out, unless /execute is used to enter it. Limbo is also the realm of [[Fever]]. She will spawn at 0 8 0 in the [[#house|House]] structure, and will follow the player as long as they are not looking at her. Limbo is described as "cold. Blistering cold" in [[Limbo#1/6|a book]] in one of the structures. Limbo consists of a black void under the player's feet, and a mesmerizing, shader based sky, creating waves on light. == Mechanics == === Ambience === As long as the player is in the dimension, '''limbo.ogg''' will play on loop. [[File:LimboAmb.ogg]] === Coordinates === While in this dimension, the Player's coordinate in the F3 Menu will be all marked as ???. Despite this, external tools can still show the Player's coordinates. === Fall Damage === All fall damage is negated in '''Limbo'''. == Structures == === Cave Outpost === [[File:CaveOutpost.png|thumb|Cave outpost.]] Cave Outpost is a liminal base that can be found in Limbo. The front door has a sign that says " 's underground home". The base is an arrangement of random rooms and hallways, with a hallway full of reversed oak doors. Another hallway with windows starts with a regular door and reversed door, and ends on a 90° turn leading to the same hallway. When looking closer at every room, you can notice that they're all copies of the room found by entering the front door. {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible" |+Rooms !Room !Content/differences |- |Original |5x10 room. Contains a rafting table, a jukebox with Cat in it, a white bed, 3 torches, a white bed, a chest with 1033 cobblestone, 94 gravel, 9 dripstone blocks, 23 tuff blocks, 3 granite and 4 flints, and a mirror. On the roof there are 4 torches and a window leading to the sky of Limbo and several smaller copies of the window in different angles. There is also a door between the door and the chest leading to a room with a chest, an open wall, and an opening in the ceiling leading to a vertical hallway that then leads to the glass hallways. |- |Mirrored |Mirrored version of the room beyond the mirror of the original. The door is blocked off with cobblestone. The chest is empty but the jukebox isn't. There is a sign that says "LET ME OUT I CAN'T PLEASE LET ME GO" Roof has no window and 2 torches and 2 soul torches. The door that originally leaded to the empty now leads to many floating x and +'s in different orientations. |- |Broken |Broken walls, half of the room is gone, only keeping the chest and the door to the empty room with a soul torch next to the door. |- |Tripled |This version of the room is copied 3 times. It has no walls, no ceiling, and every container is empty. |- |Vertical |A vertical version of the room. Crossing the front door sets the player's eyes on windows. The door to the empty room is on the ceiling. The original ceiling is open, and leads to an odd oak structure. |} There are also a few signs in the structure. {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible" |+Signs !Sign !Location |- |LET ME OUT I CAN'T PLEASE LET ME GO |Mirrored room |- |Fall deeper. Fall deeper. Fall deeper. Fall deeper. |Below the mirrored room, can be found by breaking the cobblestone and letting yourself fall down |- |Deeper into the peace inside that weak mind of yours. |Next to the sign just above |- |Stay awake Stay awake Stay awake Stay awake Stay awake Stay awake |Glass hallways |} === Distasteful Quandary === [[File:DistastefulQuandary.png|thumb|[[XoxDairyQueen]]'s base.]] Distasteful Quandary is a base made out of brick, dark oak and deepslate bricks built by [[XoxDairyQueen]]. ==== Entrance ==== Going through the front door leads to a hallway full of doors with at some point a chest hidden under brick stairs. Opening the door and going on the right leads to an opening in the wall and a storage room. ==== Storage Room ==== The storage room has a large chest which contains: * A memorial for [[RANKorous 123]]: 14 netherrack, 5 exposed copper grates, 64 birch logs, and a poppy. * A memorial for [[DJ2trappy2skeezy]]: 64 dark oak planks, 64 oak planks, 64 mangrove planks, and an allium. * A memorial for [[uImmortal_]]: 64 cherry logs, 64 acacia planks planks, 8 rose bushes, 9 light gray glazed terracotta, 10 oxidized copper blocks, 64 stripped crimson hyphae, and a cornflower. * 576 black wool blocks * 8 light weighted pressure plates, 5 iron doors, 5 spruce fences, 7 tuff slabs, 3 exposed cut copper slabs, and 3 diorite. The chest below contains: * 52 iron ingots, 5 diamonds * A diamond pickaxe with 1517/1561 uses, a diamond axe with 1394/1561 uses * An iron sword with 204/250 uses The top chest in front of the large chests contains: * 165 raw chicken * 32 cookies * 5 raw salmon The rest of the chests are empty. ==== Furnace Wall ==== Going back to the door you came from, you can head to the left instead to find a staircase with crafting tables on the left and furnaces on the right. Two of the furnaces are filled with respectively 3 [[name.missing]] and 6 coal for the bottom one and 17 [[name.missing]] and one coal for the top one. ==== Dairy Queen's Room ==== Going up leads to Dairy_Queen's bedroom, with two green bed surrounded by spruce trapdoors, and a spruce desk with two lanterns and the same flowers that would've been used for the memorials. On the other side, a big hole in the wall and ceiling is filled with countless name.missing and viscera blocks, and Dairy_Queen's death can be found. The rooftop has fences all around the base and multiple lamp posts. There are also [[XoxDairyQueen#"Distasteful Quandary"|many signs and a book that reveal what happened to Dairy_Queen]]. === Happy Farm === [[File:HappyFarm.png|thumb|A happy farm.]] Happy Farm is a farm made out of hay bales, oak log and concrete. There many holes that let the player enter the structures. Inside the farm is a false Overworld, feeding a Player's delusions with a fake sky, a fake tree, and fake animals. There is also "barry's pen", in which a death can be found next to three hay bales. {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible" |+Signs !Sign !Location |- |tree |On the tree |- |leaves |On the leaves of the tree |- |sky |On the sky next to the tree |- |cloud |On the bottom cloud of said sky |- |so kind so benevolent |On the opposite sky |- |my farm my sheep my beautiful sheep |On the same sky |- |my home is so nice |On the same sky |- |i love this home |On the same sky |- |thank you for blessing me with something real |On the same sky |- |Why aren't they real? Why are they looking at |On barry's pen |- |i dont like this |Floating above the sign above |- |this isnt right they arent real |On top of the sign above |- |why arent they real it promised me could keep |On top of the sign just above |} The circumstances of this player's death are ambiguous. Either barry was a real animal and inhabited by Circuit, or since the structure is in Limbo, the Player became crazy because of Fever and were killed after. === House === [[File:LimboThumbnail.png|thumb|The house at 0 0 0.]] The house is a small structure where [[Fever]] spawns. It's made out of spruce logs, spruce wood slabs, end rods, three soul lanterns, a regular lantern, and floating candles. In the middle there is a spruce sign with the text "0 0 0" on each line. {{Clear}} === Humanity === [[File:Humanity.png|thumb|Humanity.]] Humanity is a water fountain made out of deepslate brick blocks, stairs, [[R 3]] replacing water, and 4 flower pots with: * An allium for [[dJ2trappy2skeezy]] * A poppy for [[RANKorous_123]] * A cornflower for [[uImmortal_]] * A fern for [[xoxDairyQueen]] There is a lectern with a book titled [[XoxDairyQueen#Log_21:_Humanity|''Humanity'']], the 21st interview log with [[Fever]]. On the other side of the fountain is a sign with the text "Dedicated to: kvt uli jhy". When {{tooltip|decyphered|Caeser Cipher -7}}, it reads as "Dedicated to: dom neb car", relating to the 3 other members of Blacklisted. Unlike most structures in Limbo, there isn't a limit to how many can spawn. {{Clear}} === Identity === [[File:Identity.png|thumb|Identity.]] Identity is a structure made out of spurce wood, fences and trapdoors, lanterns, deepslate bricks and deepslate brick stairs. There is a lectern with a book titled [[XoxDairyQueen#Log_27:_Identity|''Identity'']], the 27th interview log with [[Fever]]. Unlike most structures in Limbo, there isn't a limit to how many can spawn. {{Clear}} === Morality === [[File:Morality.png|thumb|Morality.]] Morality is a tower made out of deepslate bricks, stairs and walls, spruce wood, fences, trapdoors, and lanterns. Inside, the walls are made out of bricks, with multiple flower pots inside. There is also a staircase leading to the top of the tower. The flower pots all contain poppies, cornflowers and alliums, except the last one which has a fern. At the top there is a lectern. The book is titled [[XoxDairyQueen#Log_54:_Morality|''Morality'']], the 54th interview log with [[Fever]]. Unlike most structures in Limbo, there isn't a limit to how many can spawn. {{Clear}} === Sanctuary === [[File:Sanctuary.png|thumb|The Sanctuary.]] Sanctuary is a huge birch and oak tower, though it seems to have originally been a smaller house. It contains a total of 6 floors. ==== Floor 1 ==== The original room has a yellow bed, 2 blast furnaces, 2 smokers and two regular furnaces all with some coal left in them, a crafting table with a potted Lily of the Valley on top. Additionally, there are 3 large chests with: * 64 cobblestone, 32 dirt * 227 birch planks, 68 oak planks, 4 birch stairs, 1 birch slab, and 10 birch trapdoors * Nothing ==== Floor 2 ==== The original roof of the house, now surrounded by more walls and windows. ==== Floor 3 ==== Going on top of the original roof leads to a room lit up with 2 soul lanterns and 2 lanterns, with potted Lilies of the Valley and a potted Lily of the Abyss in each corner. The amount of Lilies may point that the victim of Fever's torment here could be [[Lilyglitch64]]. ==== Floor 4 ==== A room with 4 lines of birch slabs on the floor and ceiling connected by stairs and trapdoors. The wall on the opposite side of the front door has 6 signs. * This place brings you safety. safety. * This place brings you happiness. happiness. * This place brings you love. love. * This place brings you comfort. comfort. * This place brings you peace. peace. * This place brings you joy. joy. ==== Floor 5 ==== A distorted version of [[#Floor 1|Floor 1]]. Within this room, there are: * 8 Crafting tables * 4 yellow beds * 3 blast furnaces, one with a single coal. * 3 smokers, one with another smoker inside of it. * 3 furnaces, two attached to the wall, one with a piece of paper named ''This place is home.'' As well as 6 single chests scattered on the left side of the room. These contain: * 3 birch planks, 3 birch trapdoors, 6 oak planks, 3 birch stairs * 12 black stained glass pane, 4 white stained glass panes, and 1 green stained glass pane. * 7 raw mutton surrounded by 20 red wool, with one item per slot * 2 furnaces, 2 smokers, 2 blast furnaces, a yellow bed, a crafting table and 6 chests * 27 chests, with one chest per slot * A white carpet, an oak trapdoor, nether bricks, twisting vines, a heavy weighted pressure plate, an exposed copper grate, a spruce button, a small amethyst bud, a waxed oxidized copper trapdoor, an item frame, a thing banner pattern, a honeycomb block, an orange bed, an unpacked painting, a tripwire hook, melon seeds and an empty map. The room is lit up with 2 soul lanterns and 1 lantern. ==== Floor 6 ==== A large, empty room with a huge hole in part of the roof. Scattered along the wall are 19 signs, repeating the same message "I know this isn't.". ==== Roof ==== The rooftop is the same as in the rooms before. Additionally, 4 pillars of oak fences tower above the rest of the building. One is normal and has a lantern on top, another is taller with misplaced trapdoors, one is completely broken and has no lantern, and the last one is glitched with a lantern floating above it. === Something Old Something New === [[File:SomethingOldSomethingNew.png|thumb|Something old something new.]] Something Old Something New is a pink house with mismatched designs. Exploring the [[Forum]]s reveals that this house originally was [[mannyguy010]]'s little sister's build. The mismatched design likely comes from [[mannyguy010]]'s improvements to it merged with the old house. ==== First Floor ==== Upon entering the house, there is a staircase leading up to the second floor. Continuing past leads to an enchantment table, with bookshelves setup incorrectly, and a kitchen with both furnaces and sideways furnaces as well as chests nearby. ==== Second Floor ==== Proceeding upstairs leads immediately to [[mannyguy010]]'s death at the right, with a small bedroom and assortment of empty signs. Additionally, the large chest at the foot of the bed is completely filled with stacks of poppies. Going past this leads over to a balcony. Going left after going up the stairs leads to a small storage room, featuring a jukebox. All chests are empty, and a doorway leads out to yet another balcony, featuring potted plants and a cauldron of water. Continuing straight leads to a room filled with furnaces and crafting tables in a checker pattern, which can either continues into a 3rd balcony, or continue into an empty room then a 4th balcony. {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible" |+Signs !Sign !Location |- |why this house? |Next to the front door |- |I don't get it. |Next to the front door |- |OOOOk. I see. |In the kitchen |- |I feel as if I've been here before. |In the kitchen |- |No? |In the kitchen |- |Oh, hey. |In the kitchen |- |What? |In the kitchen |} Some signs may hint that [[mannyguy010]] was talking to Fever while he was exploring the house. === The Wrong Direction === [[File:TheWrongDirection.png|thumb|The wrong direction.]] The Wrong Direction is a house spruce and cobblestone that's in two wrong direction. Going through the front door leads to a room with: A soul lantern; a chest on the ceiling, a grindstone on the ceiling, a sideways furnace on the ceiling, and a cobblestone staircase. Going down leads to a room with a bed and a chest on the ceiling and four soul lanterns. On this floor the player stands on the roof. The final room is next to the staircase in the first room. Going through the opening in the wall leads to a sideways room with two sideways furnaces, two chests facing the wall the player came in from and two soul lanterns. {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible" |+Signs !Sign !Location !Translation |- |my be |Above the front door | |- |free. enhance life. |Below the front door | |- |let me be it my my |Below the chest in the bottom room | |- |it said would my |Next to the bed | |- |it see? hurt me |On a window in the bottom floor | |- |would oddities |Crossing to the sideways room | |- |embrace why |Crossing to the sideways room | |- |looking in the right direction |Sideways room | |- |gnikool ni eht gnorw noitcerid |Sideways room |looking in the wrong direction |- |so can't i does |Sideways room | |} === Tower Base Right === [[File:TowerBaseRight.png|thumb|The Tower.]] '''Tower Base Right''' is a huge broken tower falling apart held by gigantic void tentacle. The firs thing the player will see when ntering the structure is a typical, village-like farm. On it, multiple mushrooms are growing: 2 Slivers of Pride, 2 Validated Subjugations, And 2 Shameful Remorses. Going up the ladder leads to the kitchen, made out of black and white wool, and many furnaces, and also the meeting table. After that, going up the next ladder leads to an empty floor, and then the next one leads to a room labeled as "storag" with many chests and trapped chests placed on the floor, and also mid air. o ok!!! :D |First floor |- |idk what u mean |First floor, next to the ladder |- |oh ok can i leave cause mom said about dinner at 4 |First floor, next to the ladder |- |y not |First floor, next to the ladder |- |oh ok |First floor, next to the ladder |- |no im srry i didn want 2 upset u |First floor, next to the ladder |- |its so emptie here lol |Second floor, on the meeting table |- |u have no one 2 talk 2 :( im srry |Second floor, on the meeting table |- |ya we can be friends! tho i really do need 2 go |Second floor, on the meeting table |- |oh ok i get it i fink |Second floor, on the meeting table |- |do u like my kichen |Second floor, in the kitchen |- |yay :DDDD |Second floor, in the kitchen |- |idk y i cant get miself 2 log off i need 2 eat dinner :( |Third floor |- |oh srry no i wont i swer :((( just hungrie lol |Third floor |- |ur acting wierd pls stop :/ |Third floor, hidden in a corner |- |um... ok... |Third floor, hidden in a corner |- |its scary i dont like it i rlly dont like it |Hidden under the floor of the fourth floor |- |idk what to even say |Hidden above the fourth floor, in a corner |- |i miss my frends |Fifth floor, in a corner |- |??????????????? |Above the fifth floor |- |?? |Above the fifth floor |- |????? |Above the fifth floor, on the wall |- |wait no |Above the sideways floor |- |pls stopo ims srorry i wiobnt try ti log ogg im |Sideways floor, death room |- |ims orry pl;s st opow |Sideways floor, death room |- |noonhonb |Sideways floor, death room |- |PLDEWASE |Sideways floor, death room, on the death spot |- |dddddddddddddddd |Sideways floor, death room, on the death spot |} Judging by what we can see in the tower: # The owner of the tower was very young (possibly [[littleepic1]]) # The tower may have been one of the first builds to enter Limbo, as some old glitches like the triple chest can be found. === so it begins === [[File:Soitbegins.png|thumb|so it begins.]] '''so it begins''' appears to a tombstone-like structure made out of spruce fences and trapdoors, deepslate brick blocks, stairs, walls and slabs, lanterns and regular brick blocks. There is one sign with "You just couldn't help yourself, could you?" written on it and a chest containing 4 diamonds surrounding a photo of [[xoxDairyQueen]] and [[Fever]]. So it begins.png|/threads/Dairy_Queen/1 Unlike most structures in Limbo, there isn't a limit to how many can spawn. {{Clear}} === Tree House === [[File:TreeHouse.png|thumb|The tree house.]] '''Tree House''' is an odd structure taking the form of a tree house with multiple distorted sections. The staircase to access it is already odd. It's lifted up the ground, and it overlaps. A structure made out of crafting tables similar to the crafting tables in the glitched floor of [[#Sanctuary|Sanctuary]] can be seen next to the stairs. The structure can then be accessed through a sideways tree which has a broken vertical tree intersecting it. Upon entering the tree house, the Player is met with bookshelves, a potted mushroom, and a line of ominous banners. Notably, several blocks are displaced or completely missing. Going up the stairs, which has one stair block displaced in the air, leads up to another section with chests. One chest contains 11 books titled ''Stay.'' in a cross shape. The one next to it is filled with the same book. The large chest below both of those are filled with the same book, but in the shape of a cage. Each of these books contain 1 page with just the phrase "Stay." There are also four stacked red beds, and 4 furnaces. 2 are normal with the ''Stay.'' book inside of them, and other two are sideways. There is a floating section on the opposite side with a cauldron filled with 1 level of water, and a chest with a book titled ''Seven'' {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible" |+''Seven'' !Message |- |{{Anchor|Limbo#1/6}}'''Page 1 of 6''' It's cold. She gave me a book to write in today. That was nice of her. This place is cold. Blistering cold. So cold, I feel my skin freezing, but it never fully does. |- |{{Anchor|Limbo#2/6}}'''Page 2 of 6''' She checks on me. She's nice. She gave me somewhere to rest. To sleep, I like sleeping. She says it's good for me. |- |{{Anchor|Limbo#3/6}}'''Page 3 of 6''' It's nice not being conscious. |- |{{Anchor|Limbo#4/6}}'''Page 4 of 6''' ''The page is empty.'' |- |{{Anchor|Limbo#5/6}}'''Page 5 of 6''' She said she's looking for my friend. |- |{{Anchor|Limbo#6/6}}'''Page 6 of 6''' It's been lonely without them. Ever since those two left us down there. She tells me that they left me on purpose. That she is helping. I trust her. |} The name of the book hints that the owner of this base was [[Seven77]], but it's also possible that this is book seven out of a series of multiple books. == Entities == Even though [[Fever]] is the only entity that spawns in Limbo, [[Null]] can be summoned with the right [[chat responses]]. == Gallery == LimboSky.gif|Limbo's sky. pages.title: Lore
pages.extract:
{{Stub|This page is missing an awful lot of information, audios, screenshots, and such.}} '''The Broken Script''' is an intriguing mod that blends horror elements with [[ARG]] components and an actual '''story'''. Unlike most horror mods, which merely introduce hostile mobs, ''The Broken Script'' offers a fully developed narrative-and, more importantly, direct interaction with story characters. = Clans = Within the Broken Script, a few usernames can be found across structures, some that have leaked into the worlds currently accessed by players, and some within the recovered chunks of [[WORLD2]]. There seemed to be three notable Clans that played on the server; see the list below. = Timeline = Dated Signs and other such things provide valuable information about the position of events on the timeline. However, not all events have a known date associated with them, and so some of them, marked with an unknown date - xx.xx.xxxx - are placed on the timeline speculatively, where it makes sense. == Spectrum_11 == === October 13th, 2010 - Satellite Infection === [[Revuxor]] visits the Kennedy Space Center on a field trip. Later on the same day, [[Revuxor]] discovers an image of the Hubble Space Telescope online, [[Integrity]] is discovered to have taken over the Hubble Space Telescope, allowing himself and the [[Void]] access to the internet. The image is taken down by an unknown third party an hour after being posted [[File:Voidsatellite.png|thumb|250px|link=|alt=|The infected satellite.|none]] === October, 2010 - Void Invasion === Through the internet, [[Integrity]] found his foothold in a pirated Minecraft launcher/environment. Presumably too weak yet to corrupt the game and players in any meaningful way (compared to later events on the server), Integrity begins waiting for stray players to join. === October, 2010 - First Sightings === [[Integrity]] has begun to show activity in singleplayer worlds around the world, but still only on cracked versions. Sightings of him have been reported online, and numerous forum posts appeared, describing events directly related to Integrity. He seems to have developed a consistent pattern of action, quickly becoming an urban legend. Notably, Integrity did not corrupt players yet, simply banning them from their worlds. This explains why they lived to tell their stories. This publicity seems to have ended at some point after the appearance of the [https://data.mc-anomaly-archive.org/files/spectrum_11.txt spectrum_11 creepypasta], after which all mentions of Integrity likely disappeared from the internet, and the creepypasta itself survived only on an archive website, data.mc-anomaly-archive.org. [[File:IntegrityWiki.png|thumb|250px|link=|alt=|[[Integrity]] as seen in [[spectrum_11]].|none]] === October 21st, 2010 - Investigation begins === [[Revuxor]] discovers a forum discussing [[spectrum_11]] and officially begins his investigation. === November 17th, 2010 - Contact === [[Revuxor]] contacts Icarus and Aspect regarding [[spectrum_11]] === January, 2011 - Escalation === [[Integrity]] begins to ban players from their own worlds with some players reporting paranoia and glitches that shouldn't be possible. === March 4th, 2013 - Investigation Continues === [[Revuxor]] is accepted into the Florida Institute of Technology majoring in space robotics, continuing his investigation as occurrences continue to escalate. === July 16th, 2013 - Call of the Void === [[Revuxor]] begins to hear voices mentioning the term 'void' while playing [[spectrum_11]], leading him to investigate further. [[Revuxor]] maps out known voids in space. [[File:Voidmap.png|thumb|250px|link=|alt=|[[Revuxor]]'s map of known void.|none]] === November 13th, 2014 - Aspect's Investigation === [[GhostlyAspect]] begins their investigation of [[spectrum_11]] after acquiring it from another user. She mentions her feeling disturbed by the music from the game. === June 7th, 2015 - Aspect's Encounter === [[GhostlyAspect]] encounters [[Integrity]] for the first time. === February 9th, 2016 - Aspect's Disappearance === [[ghostlyAspect]] falls victim to [[spectrum_11]], seen in the Forum post '''I'M SORRY''' === February 28th, 2016 - Icarus's Disappearance === [[icarusgaming1998]] falls victim to [[spectrum_11]], seen in the Forum post '''Bye.''' === xx.xx.xxxx - Last Player === The last player fell victim to [[spectrum_11]], after which Integrity moved on to larger targets, namely multiplayer servers. == The Clan Server == === November 1st, 2017 - The Beginning === [[born2live555]] created the Clan Server, recruiting [[Revuxor]] and [[MikePlaysMinecra]] as admins on the server. === xx.xx.xxxx - xXram2dieXx's Clan === At an unknown point, [[0nullvoid0]], [[DyeXD412]], and [[WHYER4]] started playing together and created a clan. === February 1st, 2018 - Weird structure === [[0nullvoid0]] wrote on the [[Forum]]s that a weird thing appeared at his base, and that he would like his enchanting table back if an admin did this. The structure resembles an altar and, notably, contains [[Items#Protected_Void|Protected Void]] blocks. Forum Weird Structure.png|Weird Structure from the Forum. === February 2nd, 2018 - 0nullvoid0's Diary === [[0nullvoid0]] created a diary, and mentions the structure above, assuming it was an admin trolling. === February 3rd, 2018 - Weird Sound === [[0nullvoid0]] wrote in his diary that the structure made a weird sound and that his game started to lag a bit. He also jokingly noted that every mob that gets too close to the structure despawns, attributing it to plugins. === February 4th, 2018 -The Clan Must Grow === [[0nullvoid0]] wrote that it was time to build a base for all of them because the clan must grow. It is believed that the base he wrote about eventually came to be [[Clan Build|clan_build]]. === February 17th, 2018 - Blackout's Clan === [[Blackout]], [[OVERLORD]], and [[catfish12]] started playing together and formed a clan. === March 1st, 2018 - Blacklisted Clan === [[xoxDairyQueen]], [[uImmortal]], [[RANKorous 123]], and [[dJ2trappy2skeezy]] started playing together and formed a clan. === xx.xx.2018 - Blackout's demise === [[Blackout]] went mining, and was ambushed and killed by [[Circuit]]. It is these events that are depicted on record14.ogg[[Items#Music Disc 14|Disc 14]]. === April 8th, 2018 - Blackout's disappearance === One of the clan members noticed Blackout's disappearance and asked a question but apparently did not receive an answer. === May 15th, 2018 - Nebula's disappearance === One of the clan members noticed Nebula's disappearance. === June 16th, 2018 - Old clan base destroyed === xXRam2DieXx's old clan base was griefed using TNT, assumed to be [[Blackout]] === xx.xx.2018 - DJ2trappy2skeey's Death === [[DJ2trappy2skeezy]] finally reunites with [[RANKorous 123]] and is killed. ReunionDeadFrame.png|Reunited === September 15th, 2018 - Final Goodbyes === The remaining members of Blacklisted Clan, [[XoxDairyQueen]] and [[uImmortal_]] part ways for the last time in game. === October 1st, 2018 - Tenant in clan_build === An unknown person rented a spare room in [[Clan Build|clan_build]] and presumably moved there. === October 4th, 2018 - Name Change === [[0nullvoid0]] changed his username to '''xXram2dieXx'''. === October 14th, 2018 - Tenant moves out === The unknown person who previously rented the room in [[Clan Build|clan_build]] moved out, claiming that they think they need to build their own base. === November 1st, 2018 - The beginning of the end === [[The Broken End]] has appeared in the world, causing the chat to break due to a [[minecraft.chatengine]] failure. xXram2dieXx's Clan members noticed the chat failure and wrote about it, starting to use signs as their main means of communication. They also noted that for unknown reasons, the discord server got deleted too. That same day, they noticed that a group of people stole their old base, and complained that they couldn't report them due to the deleted discord server. === November 2nd, 2018 - Out of Wood === xXram2dieXx's Clan ran out of oak wood, and [[WHYER4]] wrote a sign, asking to get more. === November 4th, 2018 - xXram2dieXx's demise === xXram2dieXx agreed to go get oak wood, and while at it, he was ambushed and killed by [[The Broken End]]. It is these events that are depicted on disc15.betray.ogg[[Items#Music Disc 15|Disc 15]]. === xx.xx.xxxx - Noticed absence === The rest of the clan members noticed [[xXram2dieXx_(Lore)]]'s disappearance, but only assumed that he was tired of playing. === April 2nd, 2019 - Cal's disappearance === One of the clan members noticed that [[Not_It_Cal]] wasn't responding to their texts, requesting to hear from them on a sign the next time they've logged back in. === April 8th, 2019 - Weird block === One of [[Blackout]]'s Clan members found a [[Items#Protected Void|Protected Void]] block in a cave and moved it to their cave base using pistons. No one knew what block it was. === June 9th, 2019 - Deceiver returns === [[Circuit]], impersonating long-missing [[xXram2dieXx_(Lore)|xXram2dieXx]], returned to the clan under his name, claiming to have had some “troubles” with his family. === xx.xx.xxxx - DyeXD412's corruption === A chest appears with the line "listen", titled from [[Not_It_Cal]] containing Disc 13. [[DyeXD412]] started listening to Disc 13 on loop, standing still and ignoring [[WHYER4]] to the point where it looked like he was standing AFK with an autoclicker. It was this disc's influence that led to the gradual corruption of DyeXD412 and his subsequent becoming [[Curved]]. Listen_1.png|listen - [[Not_It_Cal]] ClanBuildOverhaul_Jukebox.png|Answer me! === xx.xx.xxxx - Revuxor's death === At an unknown point, [[Circuit]] entered the real world through [[Revuxor]]'s computer, invading his home and soon after ripping him apart. This event was somehow recorded on disc17.silenced.ogg[[Items#Music Disc 17|Disc 17]]. It is unknown how Revuxor ended up trapped on the server world in Minecraft after being killed in the real world. CircuitMonitor.png|[[Circuit]] climbing out of [[Revuxor]]'s monitor. CircuitInHallway.png|[[Circuit]] chasing [[Revuxor]] in the hallway. === xx.xx.xxxx - uImmortal_'s death === At an unknown point, [[Not_It_Cal]] appeared in front of the Blacklisted Clan base, resulting in [[uImmortal]]'s death. Blacklisted_Base_Death.png|[[uImmortal]]'s death. === xx.xx.2024 - Dairy Queen's death === At an unknown point, [[Fever]] entered the real world through [[xoxDairyQueen]]'s computer, killing her. ThePartyIsntOver.webp|[[Fever]] and [[xoxDairyQueen]] == The Broken Script == === xx.xx.xxxx - Server World recovered === Somehow, the Server World that the previous players were playing on, which was thought to be lost, was restored. However, it appears to be heavily corrupted and is therefore generated as a new world, with only [[Structures|fragmented remnants]] of the original world being randomly restored. === xx.xx.xxxx - The End...? === After following exploration clues and killing [[Curved]], the Player has recovered all 5 polaroid pieces and restored the photo of [[XXram2dieXx_(Lore)|xXram2dieXx]]'s clan. The code was found. Following [[the Moon]]'s corruption, the Player has jumped into the void and found themselves on the [[Moon]]. There they found the flower and challenged [[Fractured]], subsequently defeating it with the help of a swarm of [[Sub Anomaly 2]]s and obtaining the Corrupted Command Block from its chest. Using the Corrupted Command Block, the Player has discovered the Initiator. They've placed down CCB and input the code from the polaroid into it, revoking [[Integrity]]'s operator and at last facing him directly. Following the fight and after defeating Integrity, the [[Void]] sends one of its tendrils down to take him and the Player into itself, implying the Player’s death. [[Category:Lore]]
{{Wiki navbox}}

pages.title: Lucid
pages.extract:
[[File:Lucid_terrain.png|thumb|360px|The terrain generation of '''Lucid'''.]]

'''Lucid''' is an easter egg dimension that can be accessed with the [[chat responses|chat response]] "'''Lucy B. Locks'''". It is one of the few chat reponses that can be ran before [[Null]] joins the server.

Entering the dimension through the chat will teleport you there for {{tooltip|3 minutes and 30 seconds|4200 ticks}}.

When the player first teleports into '''Lucid''', they will spawn hgh up and fall down into a colored concrete ground, reminiscent of [https://minecraft.wiki/w/Cave_game_tech_test Cave game tech test]'s terrain generation.

The screen will also be covered in a pixelation effect that ill cause every on-screen pixel to be scaled up 6 times. The effect scales up with screen resolution, thus the lower the resolution the more pixelated.

When the player teleports to the dimension, <ab>lucid_fever.ogg</ab>'''lucid_fever.ogg''' will play, a song directly from [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fnKoeKaWaFU Lucid Blocks' OST].

== Generation ==

[[File:Lucid_tower.png|thumb|right|200px|One of the rare towers of the dimension. Hard to miss.]]
The terrain generation of '''Lucid''' involves placing massive amounts of '''randomly colored concrete''', where the Y position will be '''randomized''' for each block between y=1 and y=6. There will always be a ground on y=0 except for ''rough ground''.

Every new chunk, there is a {{tooltip|~0.5%|1 in 201}} chance for the chunk to instead be a massive '''pillar''', stretching from a whopping '''y=-1040 to y=1040''', this dimension's build height limit, somehow reaching '''much further''' than Minecraft's build limit.

[[File:Lucid_rough.png|thumb|left|200px|Rough ground chunk.]]

There can also be '''rough ground''' chunks with a {{tooltip|~0.66%|1 in 151}} chance, where the only difference is that the blocks will only span up from '''y=0 to y=4''', also including '''holes''' in the terrain. 

{{Clear}}

== Notes ==
* This dimension was added as an easter egg and does not have any known lore significance.
* This dimension is seemingly loosely based on the dreamcore sandbox game [https://lucidblocks.com/ Lucid Blocks].
* The name "'''Lucy B. Locks'''" is a direct reference to the creator of Lucid Blocks' alias.
* Breaking the blocks in this dimension may drop an item named "Gaggle Token" instead of concrete.

Even though Maze Shadows cannot be directly hit under normal circumstances, they can take damage and they can be killed. They only have 5 hearts. pages.title: Mechanics
pages.extract:
{{Stub|Requires rework}} == World Changes == While the mod works on modern versions of Minecraft, it actively attempts to forcefully downgrade the game to older versions, which seems to mix them together and lead to strange effects like certain mobs missing, or Lush Caves in seemingly old caves. Most of these changes can be disabled in the configs. === The Sun === The sun is now '''blotted out'''. This '''does not''' seem to have any effect on gameplay. [[File:TheSun.png|border|200px|none]] === The Moon === {{For|more information|The Moon}} At the start of the game, the moon looks and behaves as normal. However, as part of a related [[Random_Events#Moon_Phase|random event]], the moon may become '''Corrupted'''. The '''Corruption''' is visually represented by different moon textures for each stage, depicting it being slowly consumed by the '''Void''' more and more with each passing night. Regardless of Corruption, during '''moon phases 5-8''' (New Moon - Waxing Gibbous) some hostile night mobs '''cannot spawn''', making the nights quieter in this regard, but ultimately just giving more space for [[entities]] to spawn. There is also a 1 in 4 chance of receiving 'err.themoon' when trying to sleep during these phases. {{Collapsible list |title=Despawnable mobs: |bullets=true |1=Skeleton |2=Skeleton Horse |3=Zombie |4=Zombie Horse |5=Zombie Villager |6=Creeper |7=Bat |8=Cave Spider |9=Spider |10=Enderman |11=Witch }}
[[File:moon_1.png|border|200px|none]]
[[File:CorruptionStage2Phase1.png|border|200px|none]]
=== No Deepslate === All Deepslate in a 9x9x9 cube around the player is '''replaced with Stone''' with a 1% chance each tick if the player's y-level is less than 10. Mining Deepslate at a sufficiently large range will cause Cobbled Deepslate to drop as normal, allowing it to be collected despite the replacement. === Old World Generation === The mod brings back old cave generation before the Caves and Cliffs (1.17) update. This makes the caves more enclosed rather than vast and spacious like in the new versions, bringing back the claustrophobic feeling of the older versions. === Nostalgia Helper === All textures have been reverted to their '''pre-1.14''' versions. All block and item textures that existed later have been artificially aged to match. Raw Iron and Raw Gold textures are 2D duplicates of their block textures. Endermen and Ender Dragon have green eyes. Sounds that were replaced in any versions of the game have been returned to their '''old form''' to match older versions. This can be disabled by unloading the '''Nostalgia Helper''' resource pack. === Void Fog === When the camera height is below -50, in the immediate vicinity of the bedrock, a thick black fog will surround the player. [[File:VoidFog.png|border|400px|none]] === Seed Changer === The world seed, at random, will change, making newly generated terrain different from previously loaded chunks. === Mobs Removal === Mobs from modern versions of Minecraft are '''no longer present''' in the game, and attempts to spawn them are unsuccessful. Some mobs from more modern versions are '''not present''' in the game, and attempts to spawn them by any means are simply not successful. {{Collapsible list |title=These mobs include: |bullets=true |1=Bat |2=Drowned |3=Glow Squid |4=Phantom |5=Bee |6=Allay |7=Fox |8=Cat |9=Goat |10=Tropical Fish |11=Panda |12=Pufferfish |13=Dolphin |14=Trader Llama |15=Wandering Trader |16=Turtle |17=Hoglin |18=Piglin |19=Piglin Brute |20=Sniffer |21=Frog |22=Armadillo |23=Axolotl |24=Bogged |25=Breeze |26=Camel |27=Tadpole }} The bees are prevented from leaving naturally spawning Bee Nests, although they constantly try to do so, resulting in a violent spam of '''Bee leaves hive''' sound. This is enabled by default, but can be disabled in the Common Config. === Villagers === When a villager spawns, there is a 50% chance that they will be named '''TESTIFICATE''', which is a reference to how they were all named in the version they were added in ''Beta 1.9 Pre-release 1''. === Bedrock Changes === Bedrock is now '''breakable''', and can be broken after 6 seconds of mining, regardless of the tool used. This has huge implications for the lore and gameplay, as it gives the player access to the '''Void''' and allows them to enter [[Nowhere]]. === No Peaceful Difficulty === The mod removes the ability to switch the game to "Peaceful" difficulty, setting it back to "Easy" on the next tick after the game is unpaused, However, it will still despawn hostile mobs. === Deop === The '''/deop''' command, used to '''revoke operator status''' from a player, is accessible to the player at all times. Eerily enough, [[Integrity]] is available as a valid selection. However, attempting to do so will fail.
[[File:IntegrityDeopSelection.png|border|200px|none]]
[[File:IntegrityDeopFailure.png|border|400px|none]]
=== Game Profiles === There are GameProfiles for two entities: [[Null]] and [[Integrity]]. {| class="wikitable" |- ! Name !! UUID |- | Null || 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 |- | Integrity || 01001001-0100-1110-0101-010001000101 |} Fittingly, Null's UUID is all zeros, while Integrity's UUID translates from binary to '''INTE'''. === Join Message === A message indicating that the player has joined the game will be sent in chat every time they join, even in a newly created world, hinting from the start that they are '''not alone'''. === Language File Changes === The Minecraft language file for English (US) has been changed, causing various usual game elements to now have completely different text. On the world creation screen, Survival mode will instead be named '''Go away''', with its tooltip saying '''This place is not for you.''' Whenever a sheep dies, the subtitles will instead say '''303 dies'''. In Minecraft window's title bar Singleplayer will be replaced with '''[SINGLEPLAYER.force_activate]'''. In Music & Sounds options Master Volume slider will instead be titled '''ERROR.you_cant'''. {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" |+Comparison !Variable !Vanilla !TBS |- |selectWorld.gameMode.survival |Survival |Go away |- |selectWorld.gameMode.survival.info |Explore a mysterious world where you build, collect, craft, and fight monsters. |This place is not for you. |- |selectWorld.gameMode.survival.line1 |Search for resources, craft, gain |There is nothing to look for |- |selectWorld.gameMode.survival.line2 |levels, health and hunger |Here I am. |- |subtitles.entity.sheep.death |Sheep dies |303 dies |- |title.singleplayer |Singleplayer |[SINGLEPLAYER.force_activate] |- |soundCategory.master |Master Volume |ERROR.you_cant |- |} == Gameplay Changes == === No Attack Cooldown === Attack cooldown is disabled, restoring the pre-1.9 combat system. The Player will attack at '''full strength''' no matter how fast they attack. An option in the Danger settings can turn this off. === Entering the Void === Dropping into the void while in the Overworld will no longer kill the Player, and will instead transport the player to either [[Nowhere]] or the [[Moon]] === Keep Inventory === While within any of The Broken Script's [[dimensions]], dying '''will not''' drop the Player's inventory. === Totem of Undying Changes === The mod alters the '''Totem of Undying''', making it fail to protect the Player under specific circumstances. Additionally, it will change its appearance if the Player is considered to be in a '''chased''' or '''danger''' state. Voided Totem of Undying.png|Voided totem Voided Totem of Undying Nostalgia.png|Ditto, with Nostalgic Helper Totems of Undying will '''never''' activate if fatally attacked by any of the following damage types: {{Collapsible list |title=Damage Types: |bullets=true |1=bad_sun |2=bite |3=fever_attack |4=circuit_attack |5=integrity_ball |6=null_maze |7=jimmy_rise |8=sa1 |9=jimmy_stomp |10=void_mass |11=integ_bypass |12=tbe_damage |13=tbe_funny_damage |14=sub_anom_2 }} All of them belong to the '''thebrokenscript''' damage type namespace; most of them additionally bypass armor, status effects, and the invulnerability window. === Time of Day === Certain [[entities]] and [[Random Events|events]] can cause changes in the time of day. However, the time of day can be '''fake''', and will only last for a set amount of time. Mobs and entities that can only spawn in at night can spawn if the time is faked to night, and the same for a faked day. Time will normally only be faked to night, midnight, day, or noon, although alternate times are supported through [[commands]]. == Menu Changes == === Main Menu === Minecraft's Main Menu has been '''modified'''. The modern panorama has been replaced by the '''classic''' version, which appears to be severely glitching. The '''Quit Game''' button has been '''disabled''', appearing darkened. This has lore significance, as it is known that all [[entities]] also cannot leave the game, and [[Integrity]] can manipulate the game's mechanics, including doing just that. Occasionally, the text "Leave" can appear where "Quit Game" is written, with the addition of "" appearing at the bottom. Optionally, Main Menu appearance can be changed in the Client Config, with the options to either use fanart background, or completely disable changes.
[[File:TBSMainMenuGlitchyPanorama.png|border|300px|none]]
[[File:TBSMainMenuArtBackground.png|border|300px|none]]

He always knew. |30=It's me |31=We hate you, xXram2dieXx |32=Also try [[wgg:voicesofthevoid:Voices of the Void Wiki:Voices of the Void Wiki|Voices Of The Void]]! |33=His life worth nothing. |34=Also try ! |35=[redacted][redacted][redacted] |36=[obfuscated] |37=%APPDATA%SPECTRUM_11% |38=Also try no_moon.jar! }} === Player List === After [[Null]] joins the game, a player list will become available, always displaying himself and the Player online. [[File:NullPlayerList.png|border|200px|none]] === Broken Pause Menu === If the Player is nearby certain entities, the pause menu will appear to be glitching. The game '''will not be paused'''. Entities that can break pausing: * [[Circuit#Chase|Circuit - Chase]] * [[He#Chase|He - Chase]] * [[Null#Chase|Null - Chase]] * [[Null#Maze|Null - Maze]] * [[Null#Flying|Null - Flying]] * [[Obliteration#1|Obliteration - The Star]] * [[R2#Chase|R2 - Chase]] * [[The Broken End#Chase|The Broken End - Chase]] Attempting to '''Save and Quit''' will result in the button no longer functioning as intended. With certain entities, the Save and Quit button will be replaced with [[File:Glitched Quit Button.png|NoSuchMethodError disconnect()]], then it will completely disappear shortly after. * [[He#Chase|He - Chase]] * [[Null#Flying|Null - Flying]] * [[Null#Chase|Null - Chase]] * [[Null#Maze|Null - Maze]] * [[Obliteration#1|Obliteration - The Star]] * [[R2#Chase|R2 - Chase]] With certain entities, the Save and Quit button will be replaced with one of three buttons on loop, then it will hinge off of the Pause Menu and break off. * [[Circuit#Chase|Circuit - Chase]] * [[The Broken End#Chase|The Broken End - Chase]] Re-pausing the game results in the Save and Quit button returning, although the button will still break so long as the effect, '''Meta Paranoia''', persists. === LWJGL Alerts === Various reasons, including but not limited to certain active entities or events, will cause a ([https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/LWJGL Lightweight Java Game Library]) '''LWJGL Alert''' pop-up to appear on top of the Minecraft window on the player's computer, displaying various error texts. Every time the player sends a message in chat, there is a 1% chance that an LWJGL Alert will appear saying '''Here I am.''' All crashes seem to be accompanied by an LWJGL Alert saying '''UNHANDLED EXCEPTION -1''' '''err.sleep''' is a generalised term that describes the player's inability to sleep due to an active anomaly or encounter. It is characterised by instant interruption of sleep due to minuscule damage, followed by an LWJGL Alert. Types of err.sleep: * '''err.null''' - Indicates [[Null]]'s presence. * '''err.soul''' - Indicates [[r2]]’s presence. * '''err.texture''' - Indicates [[Notexture]]'s presence. * '''err.endisnear''' - Indicates [[The Broken End]]'s presence. * '''err.player''' - Indicates [[Obliteration]]'s VHS effect is over. * '''err.themoon''' - Occurs randomly during 5-8 stages of [[the Moon]].

[[File:err.themoon.png|border|300px|none]]
=== Version Number === A version number is now located in the top left-hand corner of the screen, defaulted to Minecraft 1.12.2. * '''''' - Indicates [[Null]]'s presence. * '''Here I am.''' - Indicates [[r2]]’s presence. * '''err.themoon''' - The Player is on the [[Moon]]. * '''?''' - The Player is in a certain location within [[Protected Void]]. * '''Clan_Void X 231 Z''' - See [[Random Events#Coord|Coord]] Event. * '''Clancraft 2018''' - See [[Random Events#Port|Port]] Event. === Window Title Changes === The game's title is changed to Minecraft 1.12.2 and sometimes change into the titles listed below. {| class="wikitable" ! These black particles are presumably related to or even are the direct influence of the '''Void''', based on what Disc 13 did to [[Curved|DyeXD412]]. [[File:Disc13Played.png|border|400px|none]] == Entity Spawning == The mod adds a variety of entities to the game, and while some of them can spawn naturally through Minecraft's mob spawning, other entities require [[Entity Spawner]] to spawn first before they have a chance to be picked, which acts as a limiter on rarer entities. == Herobrine Shrine == This is the Herobrine 3×3 altar: a horizontal ring of gold blocks surrounding mossy cobblestone at the center, with a block of netherrack placed on top, and 4 redstone torches stuck directly into the gold ring. Kick message |- | null || Player is already playing on this server. |- | xXram2dieXx || Player is already playing on this server. |- | DyeXD412 || Player is already playing on this server. |- | Integrity || I am watching you. |- | Modrome || I am right behind you |} == minecraft.chatengine == Certain entity encounters cause Minecraft's chat engine to fail, '''preventing chat messages''' from being sent and causing the following error messages to appear above the player's hotbar: IMPORT minecraft.chatengine Unexpected_error.returnedvalue=-1 What is understood about this error is that it has occurred on the [[lore|server]] before, as the previous players left a sign in the [[Clan_Build]], commenting then, "Why chat won't work?". The following entities are able to cause this error: * [[The Broken End#Chase|The Broken End - Chase]] * [[The Broken End#Stalk|The Broken End - Stalk]] * [[r2#Chase|r2 - Chase]]
[[File:ChatEngineError1.png|border|300px|none]]

== Multiplayer Warning == Every time a player joins a multiplayer world, a message will be sent in the chat from Integrity warning them about bugs. So kind of him. It seems that you are playing in a multiplayer world. You will encounter lots of bugs. This warning can be disabled in the mod config. == Server Properties == Every time the player logs into any world, a file called '''serverproperties.txt''' will be written on their '''computer desktop''', with the following text inside: K̸̜̦̀͋̋̑́̌Ĩ̷̘͎̑̽̅̕L̷̛͉̉̊́̌̒ͅL̴̫̩̓̈̍̕͝ ̶̡̣͕̠̮̑̊͑̍̈́H̸̢̻͉̗͈̃̾̆̂̈́Ì̵̯̕M̵͙̞͌̐̊͆ == Unique Names == When one of a the mobs in a certain list appears, there is a 1% chance that it will be get a unique name. With a 70% chance, this name will be '''01001000 01100101 00100000 01110111 01101001 01101100 01101100 00100000 01100110 01101001 01101110 01100100 00100000 01111001 01101111 01110101''', which translates from binary to '''He will find you'''. With a 30% chance, this name will be '''01001000 01100101 01101100 01101100 01101111''', which translates from binary to '''Hello'''. {{Collapsible list |title=Mobs that can get a name: |bullets=true |1=Skeleton |2=Skeleton Horse |3=Zombie |4=Zombie Horse |5=Zombie Villager |6=Creeper |7=Bat |8=Cave Spider |9=Spider |10=Enderman |11=Witch }} == Amplified Wasteland == The mod seemingly alters the generation of worlds that are generated using the Amplified option. Instead of different biome blocks and terrain, it has been replaced with stone and other minerals. Trees and dirt are scarce, and seldom do they generate. == Uwu Entities(April Fool's Day Easter Egg) == When the device's date is April 1st, all entity on the main title screen will have 'uwu' faces, and certain in-game entities with 'uwu' textures will also have an 'uwu' face. At other times, there is a very small chance for this kind of easter egg to appear. [[Category:Mechanics]]

'''Murderfur''' is an Easter Egg entity. It was added in '''The Broken Script''' 2.0 as a reference to the boss enemy Abandoned Kerfur (also known as Murderfur) from the indie horror game Voices of the Void.

== Spawn Conditions ==
It cannot spawn naturally and can only be summoned with commands.

== Appearance and Behavior ==

Murderfur looks like a mechanical cat standing on its hind legs, featuring a cracked monitor for a face and a bleeding design. When hurt, it will meow. Its kill sound however is unchanged from the default hurt sound. It has {{Tooltip|500 hearts|1000 HP}}} and does not drop anything on death.

Murderfur has three different phases, each with their own OST. Each phase increases its attack damage and movement speed:
* '''Phase 1''': {{Tooltip|0.5 hearts|1 HP}} of damage, and a movement speed of {{Tooltip|~9.675 blocks/sec|0.225}}.
* '''Phase 2''': {{Tooltip|1 heart|2 HP}} of damage, and a movement speed of {{Tooltip|~12.9 blocks/sec|0.3}}.
* '''Phase 3''': {{Tooltip|2.5 hearts|5 HP}} of damage, and a movement speed of {{Tooltip|~19.35 blocks/sec|0.45}}.

Phase 1 is from {{Tooltip|500 hearts|1000 HP}} to {{Tooltip|333.5 hearts|667 HP}}, phase 2 from {{Tooltip|333 hearts|666 HP}} to {{Tooltip|167 hearts|334 HP}}, and phase 3 from {{Tooltip|166.5 hearts|333 HP}} to 0.

{{Version|2.0.5|major}} {{Entity infobox |title=Nametag |image=[[File:nametag.png]] |Type=[[Entities#Anomalies|Anomaly]] |HP=10 }} '''Nametag''' is an an [[Entities#Anomaly|Anomaly]]. It appears as a floating, playerless name tag, with a shadow cast beneath it and no visible body. The username shown is procedurally generated.
== Spawn == Nametags can spawn naturally in the Overworld, especially in caves. All of the following conditions must be satisfied: * '''Difficulty''': Not Peaceful * '''World state''': Null joined * '''Biome''': Any Overworld biome * '''Position''': Must be underground (sky light level 0, and not on the surface) * '''Player distance''': At least one SURVIVAL player within 512 blocks * '''Boss fight''': Does not spawn during [[Integrity|Integrity Boss Phase 1]] * '''Probability''': Approximately 1 in 2000 ( 1 in 1000 in superflat worlds) == Stats == * '''Maximum Health''': 10(5 hearts) * '''Movement Speed''': 0.3 * '''Follow Range''': 16 blocks * '''Attack Damage''': 3 * '''Armor''': 0 * '''Step Height''': 0.6 blocks * '''Hitbox''': 0.6 × 1.8 blocks (player-sized) * '''Fire''': Immune Nametags give no XP when killed. == Appearance == A Nametag has no visible body. The entity uses an empty renderer, so the player only sees a floating username label with a shadow on the ground beneath it. The label is always visible. == Behaviour == Nametags walk around aimlessly and do not attack the player. A Nametag cannot be approached, since it disappears on its own as soon as a survival player comes within 15 blocks, or simply has line of sight to it. Because of this, it is very rarely ever seen up close. It can be killed with ranged weapons, as it only has 10 HP. == Names == The displayed username is generated from two word pools, plus an optional number: * '''Prefix pool (42)''': Super, Ultra, Dark, Evil, Shadow, Crimson, Frozen, Ancient, Cursed, Blessed, Mighty, Chaos, Storm, Void, Blazing, Corrupt, Divine, Wicked, Silent, Nether, Hollow, Savage, Mystic, Eternal, Armored, BaneOf, Sinister, Scary, Coal, Emerald, Diamond, Copper, Iron, Gold, Obsidian, Netherite, Lapis, Doom, Cool, Lame, Boring, Fun * '''Suffix pool (37)''': Unicorn, Blade, Crusher, Walker, Stalker, Reaper, Slayer, Phantom, Titan, Wraith, Seeker, Bringer, Warden, Caller, Breaker, Strider, Hunter, Lord, Rabbit, Kitty, Dawg, Loser, Winner, Wizard, Magician, Muggle, Zombie, Skeleton, Creeper, Enderman, Silverfish, Endermite, Witch, Ravager, Villager, Pillager, Ghost * '''Number''': A random value in 0–2100 is appended to the name; if it rolls 0, no number is shown. Examples: DarkWalker, CursedReaper1337, BaneOfUnicorn, CoolKitty42, NetheriteWarden2100. == Notes== # Nametag is likely a reworked version of the scrapped entity [[Cut_and_unused_content#Cave_Nickname|Cave Nickname]]. # There is approximately 3.2 million combinations [[Category:Entities]] {{Wiki navbox}}
