pages.title: Notexture
pages.extract:
{{Version|2.0.5}} {{Entity infobox |title=Notexture |image= {{GalleryHelper |Follow2.0.png¦Notexture |File:Notexture漫步林中.webp¦Pre-2.0 Design }} |Nicknames= |Role= |Type=[[Entities#Souls|Soul]] |Affiliations= |HP= }} '''Notexture''' is an [[Entities|entity]] with the ability to teleport the player to [[Clan Void]] or [[Null Torture]], or to lower the player's health to as little as half a heart. It is seemingly intentionally hostile to a certain degree. There is little more information on it other than what is known of its behaviour. == Appearance == Notexture is a player-sized entity with a fractured head - one quarter of it is missing, and half of it is grown into a branching, antler-like structure. Its entire body is missing textures, with the usual pink and black pattern, hence its name. It will slightly jitter at all times, as well as emitting a cloud of {{particle icon|Follows_particle}}particles if the Player is within 32 blocks of Notexture. == Spawn == Notexture can spawn naturally in the Overworld. All of the following conditions must be satisfied: * '''Difficulty''': Not Peaceful * '''Biome''': Any biome * '''Dimension''': Overworld only * '''World state''': Null joined * '''Boss fight''': Does not spawn during [[Integrity|Integrity Boss Phase 1]] * '''Sky exposure''': The spawn position must be exposed to the sky; it will not spawn underground or under a roof * '''Block below''': The block below the spawn position must be a valid spawn block * '''Rare spawn cooldown''': Cannot spawn while the shared rare-spawn cooldown is active; the cooldown is set to 30,000 ticks (25 minutes) whenever an entity-condition mob spawns * '''Probability''': Depends on the moon corruption stage and the moon phase (see table below) * '''Superflat penalty''': In a superflat world, the already-low chance is further multiplied by 0.1% The spawn chance is read from the table below, where the row is the moon corruption stage (0–2, raised once per moon corruption event) and the column is the moon phase (0–7): {| class="wikitable" ! Moon phase !! 0 !! 1 !! 2 !! 3 !! 4 !! 5 !! 6 !! 7 |- ! Stage 0 | 0% || 0.001% || 0.01% || 0.05% || 0.1% || 0.3% || 0.35% || 0.35% |- ! Stage 1 | 0.1% || 0.2% || 0.2% || 0.2% || 0.25% || 0.9% || 1% || 1% |- ! Stage 2 | 0.3% || 0.3% || 0.6% || 0.6% || 0.5% || 0% || 0% || 0% |} == Stats == * '''Maximum Health''': 510 * '''Movement Speed''': 0.2 * '''Follow Range''': 516 blocks * '''Attack Damage''': 13 * '''Armor''': 0 * '''Knockback Resistance / Knockback''': 0 / 0 * '''Step Height''': 10.6 blocks == Behaviour == Notexture will spawn on the surface and start wandering around. If the player is within 100 blocks of it when it spawns, their screen will go black for half a second. It disappears during the day, and when present, it also prevents the player from sleeping via [[err.sleep|err.texture]]. Every second, a [[Items#Disruption|Disruption]] will spawn in a random location within 5 blocks of Notexture. These blocks will only appear in empty air, and will not replace existing blocks. If Notexture spots the Player, it will chase them at a speed slower than walking speed. If the Player comes within 20 blocks of it and Notexture has line of sight to them, Notexture will disappear in a cloud of {{particle icon|null_particle}}null particles and one of the following will happen with equal probability: * It will play textmadness1.ogg'''textmadness1.ogg''', give the Player Darkness for 3 seconds, set their health to 1-9, and teleport them to [[Clan Void]] or [[Null Torture]], chosen at random. * It will give the player [[Items#name.null|name.null]] and teleport them to the spot it was in when it disappeared. == Mechanics == === err.sleep === When a Notexture is within the world, the Player will be '''unable to sleep''', and will receive an [[err.texture]] alert == Gallery == File:Notexture transparent.png|Transparent Notexture Render (pre-2.0) == Notes == * There is a structure titled [[Structures#notexturehouse|notexturehouse]]. It is unclear whether or not this is Notexture's house from before it became an entity. [[Category:Entities]]
{{Wiki navbox}}

pages.title: Nothing
pages.extract:
{{Version|2.0.5}}
[[File:Nothing Dimension.png|thumb|The Nothing.]]
'''Nothing''', true to its name, is a dimension consisting of nothing other than one block and one type of [[Nothing Watcher|entity]]. 

The dimension can only be accessed through sleeping, at which point ambient music will begin to play.

[[File:Nothing.ogg]]

After a few minutes of being within the dimension, or if the Player somehow dies, the Player will transported back into the Overworld.

== Layout ==
Nothing has no layout and is a thin yet infinite plane of unbreakable '''Nothing''' blocks. Breaking through the '''Nothing''' via creative or cheats leads to the void.

All blocks placed will stay in place when re-entering the dimension, and will be the only source of something within the nothing.

[[Nothing Watcher]]s are the only entities that spawn here, adding 2 red eyes that will only ever stare at the player.

[[Category:Dimensions]]
[[Category:Nightmares]]
{{Wiki navbox}}

'''Nothing Watcher'''s are entities that spawn exclusively in the [[Nothing]] dimension. There can be multiple of them at once.

== Appearance ==
Nothing Watchers are floating pairs of 2-pixel-tall red eyes.

== Behavior ==
Upon spawning in, Nothing Watchers will simply watch the player from a distance, always facing them.

Nothing Watchers don't seem to despawn when the player comes close, and the player can approach, push, and even hit them without them despawning. Nothing Watchers can also blink at random.

pages.extract:
{{Version|2.0.5}} {{Entity infobox |title=Nothingiswatching |image=[[File:Nothingwatches.png|300px]] |Nicknames= |Role= |Type=[[Entities#Entities|Entity]] |Affiliations= |HP= }} Nothingiswatching is a entity that can appear in the overworld. Not much is known about it. It is presumably a reference to a similar event entity from Voices of the Void. == Appearance == Nothingiswatching is unable to be visually seen. Instead it is obscured by a black censor bar projected by the player's screen, the bar changes size depending on the player's distance from Nothingiswatching. Before 2.0, Nothingiswatching is a pitch-black rectangle reminiscent of a censor bar, standing at about 5 blocks tall. It is a 2D sprite that always faces the player. == Behaviour == === Stalk === Nothingiswatching will appear on the ground and begin slowly approaching the player, always facing them. When it just appears, it will play an eerie noise and whitenoise.ogg'''whitenoise.ogg'''. If the player comes within a '''20 block radius''' of Nothingiswatching '''while looking at it''', one of the following will happen: * With a 70% chance it will switch to its [[#Chase|Chase]] behaviour. * With a 30% chance it will disappear and lightning will strike in its place. === Chase === Nothingiswatching will chase the player and play nullchase.ogg'''nullchase.ogg'''. During this, the player's camera will be locked on it. Nothingiswatching will '''break most blocks''' it runs into, with the exception of some natural blocks such as dirt and stone. Every tick there is a {{tooltip|0.01%|1 in 10,000}} chance that Nothingiswatching will '''teleport''' right next to the player. The player's screen will be covered by flashing black artifacts, significantly '''obscuring''' the player's vision. Getting within a '''5 block radius''' of Nothingiswatching will result in it playing nullchase.ogg'''nullchase.ogg''' and instantly kill the player. It will disappear after {{tooltip|40 seconds|800 ticks}}. == Gallery == File:NothingChasing.png|Nothingiswatching chasing a player File:Nothingiswatching Trailer 1.png|Nothingiswatching teased in the 2.0 Trailer. File:Nothingiswatching Trailer 2.png|Nothingiswatching teased in the 2.0 Gameplay Trailer. [[Category:Entities]]

pages.title: Null
pages.extract:
{{Version|2.0.5}} {{Entity infobox |title=Null |image=[[File:Null.png|300px]] |Nicknames=MobIsmissingID, [] |Role= |Type=[[Entities#Souls|Soul]] |Association=[[XXram2dieXX_(Lore)|xXram2dieXx]] |Affiliations= |HP= }} '''Null''' is a player-like entity and one of the parts of [[xXram2dieXx_(Lore)|xXram2dieXx]]'s soul. At the time of his death, Null was 14 years old, and after becoming an entity, he ceased to age both physically and mentally, remaining 14 years old for an indefinite amount of time. Depending on the player's actions, Null either becomes a unpredictable threat or an ally that assists the player. == Appearance == Null is a humanoid entity that possesses the same model as the player, with a homogeneous pitch-black skin. == Behaviour == Null will join the game at the first midnight, {{tooltip|15 minutes|18000 ticks}} after the world is created. After that, he will always appear online in the player list and can start appearing in the player's world as an entity — usually indicated by an eerie sound. Additionally, Null joining the world also serves as the "beginning" of the mod as most entities as well as structures require him to have joined the world as a required condition for spawning NullJoinedTheGame.png|Null has arrived. NullPlayerList.png|Null in the Player List. [[File:Err.null.png|thumb|LWJGL Error given when attempting to sleep with Null present.]] Whenever Null is present in the world somewhere, the Minecraft version text will change to "" and the [[err.null]] alert will occur if the Player attempts to sleep in his presence. Null can get specific advancements such like: "Monster Hunter", "Stone Age", "We Need to Go Deeper", "Diamonds!" etc. Null can be killed in certain behaviors, but it's not recommend nor practical, as he has a lot of health, and killing him lowers the [[reputation]]. === Chase === Null will chase the player and play nulljumpscareloud.ogg'''nulljumpscareloud.ogg''' and instance.ogg'''instance.ogg''', and will be surrounded by {{particle icon|null_particle}}null particles. The player's gamemode will be set to '''Survival'''. The Player will be unable to sleep with [[err.null]], and unable to [[Mechanics#Broken Pause Menu|pause the game]] While Null is chasing the player, he can break blocks and pursue the player by swimming in water, also changing the time of day to day or night with a {{tooltip|1%|1 in 100}} chance each tick. Null deals {{tooltip|10 hearts|20 hp}} of damage per hit, and getting killed by him will play nullkillsplayer.ogg'''nullkillsplayer.ogg''' and disconnect the player with a "'''null'''"" error message. When Null appears in this behavior, the player's [[Reputation]] decreases by 1. {{tooltip|22.5 seconds|450 ticks}} after spawning, one of the following will happen: * With a {{tooltip|15%|3 in 20}} chance, Null will switch to his '''Null Is Here''' behavior. * Otherwise, Null will disappear. === Endgame === [[File:NullEndgameText.png|border|200px|right]] Null will teleport in front of the player, play theendisnear.ogg'''theendisnear.ogg''', and spam in the chat dark red messages each tick he is there:
HERE I AM VOIDNULLSILUETTANOMALY (obfuscated)
Additionally, the Player will receive an [[Mechanics#LWJGL Alerts|UNHANDLED EXCEPTION -1]] alert. Shortly after, he will kill the player and crash the game. === Flying === Null, named '''MobIsmissingID''', will spawn floating in the sky, observing the player. When he spawns in this behavior, nullsad.ogg'''nullsad.ogg''' will begin playing. The Player will be unable to sleep with [[err.null]], and unable to [[Mechanics#Broken Pause Menu|pause the game]]. Looking at Null in this behavior has two differing affects: * If the Player crouches at Null, he will disappear, and increase the Player's reputation by 10. * If the Player stares at Null, he will disappear playing a distorted version of you_know_nothing.ogg'''you_know_nothing.ogg''', and decrease the Player's reputation by 10. If the player gets within 20 blocks of Null, one of the following will happen: * With a {{tooltip|70%|7 in 10}} chance Null will disappear, and the player will take from 1 to 10 damage. * With a {{tooltip|30%|3 in 10}} chance Null will switch to his '''Null Is Here''' behavior. {{tooltip|160 seconds|3200 ticks}} after spawning, Null will despawn. === Invade Base === [[File:Wecanhearyou.png|border|200px|right]] Null will appear in the player's base and stand in place. The Player will be unable to sleep with [[err.null]] If the player gets within 20 blocks of Null, one of the following will happen: * With a {{tooltip|50%|1 in 2}} chance, he will disappear. * With a {{tooltip|50%|1 in 2}} chance, either '''[{}]''' or '''{[> null]}''' will be sent in the chat. If the player then gets within 7.5 blocks of Null, one of the following will happen: * With a {{tooltip|70%|7 in 10}} chance Null will disappear with a textmadness1.ogg'''textmadness1.ogg''' sound, lightning will strike where he was standing, and a static image with hard-to-read words "'''WE CAN HEAR YOU'''" will briefly appear on the player's screen. * With a {{tooltip|30%|3 in 10}} chance, Null will switch to his [[#Chase|Chase]] behaviour. He will disappear {{tooltip|160 seconds|3200 ticks}} after spawning. === Null Is Here === Null will begin rapidly closing distance with the player, teleporting short distances towards them. During this nullishereloopslowed.ogg'''nullishereloop.ogg (50% slower)''' will play, and white text lines will rapidly flash in the middle of the player's screen. {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" |+Text Lines !Line |- |You know nothing |- |Worship me |- |Follow me |- |Join us |- |Corrupted |- |Go away |- |Null |- |We can hear you |- |Can you see me? |- |0 |- |Behind you |- |Help me |- |Nothing can be changed |- |Close your eyes |- |One of us |} Coming into contact with Null will result in the player being [[Revuxor|banned]] from the world. He will disappear {{tooltip|25 seconds|500 ticks}} after spawning. [[File:NullIsHereLine.png|border|300px|none]] === Mining === [[File:Null mining.png|border|219x219px|right]] Null will appear somewhere underground, wearing a full set of iron armor and carrying an iron pickaxe. His spawn will be accompanied by an eerie noise. Upon spotting the player, he will begin to mine and bridge towards them, intending to attack them. Getting hit by Null will deal 6 damage. Hitting Null will cause him to disappear and play oneofus.ogg'''oneofus.ogg'''. He will disappear {{tooltip|60 seconds|1200 ticks}} after spawning. === Scare === Null, named '''[]''', will appear near the player, instantly jumpscaring them and locking the Player's camera at him, playing nullkillsplayer.ogg'''nullkillsplayer.ogg'''. He will deal either 5 or no damage, then disappear after {{tooltip|0.5 seconds|10 ticks}}, even with the game frozen. There is a {{tooltip|10%|1 in 10}} chance Null will appear in his '''Endgame''' behavior instead. === Unbeatable Bossfight === Null, named '''[]''', will appear with a white health bar that appears at the top of the player's screen. Otherwise, his behavior is identical to '''Null Is Here'''. [[File:NullUnbeatableBossfightBossbar.png|border|300px|none]] === Watching === [[File:He is nigh..png|thumb|Null observing the player.]] Null will appear on the ground, accompanied by an eerie noise. He will stand in place, always facing the player and watching them. Iron Golems approaching Null in this state will take huge amounts of damage repeatedly until death. When the player gets within 20 blocks of him, one of the following 10 things will randomly happen with equal probability: * Null will disappear, give the player Blindness II for {{Tooltip|4 seconds|80 ticks}}, and play nullflee.ogg'''nullflee.ogg'''. * If '''Reputation''' is not '''Good''' then Null will '''Chase''' the player and give them Darkness II for {{Tooltip|2.5 seconds|50 ticks}}. * if '''Reputation''' is '''Bad''' then Null will initiate '''Unbeatable Bossfight''', else he will '''Chase''' the player. * Null will disappear in a cloud of {{particle icon|null_particle}}null particles. * Null will disappear in a cloud of {{particle icon|eye}}eye particles. * Null will disappear in a cloud of {{particle icon|null_particle}}null particles and send the player to [[Null Torture]]. * Null will disappear in a cloud of {{particle icon|null_particle}}null particles and send the player to the [[Moon]] with a 35% chance, otherwise disappear. * Null will disappear in a cloud of {{particle icon|null_particle}}null particles and teleport the player to a random room of their base. A reroll happens if the player has no base (possibly due to a coding mistake). * Null will disappear in a cloud of {{particle icon|null_particle}}null particles and teleport the player to a random room in their base, or disappear if the player has none. * Null will disappear and lightning will strike where he stood. Triggering any of the above causes reputation to drop by 15 points. Trying to hit Null with an arrow will anger him, prompting him to '''Chase''' the player. He can only appear at night in this behavior, disappearing during the day. He will disappear after {{Tooltip|400 seconds|8000 ticks}}. === Maze === [[File:Null got lit.png|thumb|Null Maze Chaser]] Null is main threat in the [[Clan Void]] dimension. He will wander around within the dimension until he spots the Player. Upon seeing the Player will give chase to them, playing maze_chase.ogg'''maze_chase.ogg''' in the background. If enough distance is made between the Player and Null, he will give up the chase. Null, when spawned in the Clan Void, gives off light starting at a light level of fifteen, making it good indicator of where he is located. Additionally, the Player will be unable to [[Mechanics#Broken Pause Menu|pause the game]] while Null is spawned in. Attempting to '''Save and Quit''' will result in the button failing. If the Player were to be killed by Null, they will be given the death message of, (player) was found. If the Player were to kill Null instead, they would lose 50 [[Reputation]]. == Reputation System == '''Main article: [[Reputation]]''' Null is the entity that interacts '''the most''' with reputation and has the most reputation related changes. == Dialogue == The only requirement is that Null has already joined the game. The following interactions are capable of taking place, and are arranged in a table. Expand the table at your own risk, as it contains heavy spoilers. {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" |+Null Interactions !Prompt !Response |- |Hello | err.type=null.hello |- |Who are you? | err.type=null |- |What do you want? | err.type=null.freedom |- |Null | The end is nigh The end is null ''Null spawns in his '''Chase''' behaviour.'' |- |Can you see me? | Yes. Hello. ''Lightning strikes the player alongside with the last moon phase screamer.'' |- |Friend? | ? (NEUTRAL and GOOD reputation) ''Null spawns in his '''Scare''' behaviour.'' (BAD reputation) |- |Fuck you, Asshole, Ass hole, Fucker, Piece of shit |''[[Nothingiswatching]] spawns.'' :( (Funny Mode) |- |How can I help you? |[?][?][?] |- |Herobrine | |- |Entity 303, Entity303 | Ended his own life. |- |Integrity | Deep down under the bedrock. |- |clan_build | Home. |- |xXram2dieXx | Rot in hell. ''Null spawns in his '''Null Is Here''' behaviour.'' |- |DyeXD412, DyeXD | Obsessed with answers. |- |WHYER4 | ... |- |__blackout__, blackout | Asshole. |- |OVERLORD | He was wrong. |- |catfish12 | Should've left it alone. |- |Not_It_Cal | Innocent. |- |Revuxor | Poor soul. |- |Follow | Is behind you. |- |Nothingiswatching, Nothing is Watching | A broken promise. |- |Circuit | It was all his fault. |- |The Broken End, TheBrokenEnd | Administration. |- |Steve | [0.1] |} Null's name reminds him of whom he has become, which he hates. Notably, he reacts with the same amount of vitriol at the mention of xXram2dieXx. == Notes == * There is a popular creepypasta of the same name, [https://minecraftcreepypasta.fandom.com/wiki/Null Null] However, the one from the Broken Script seems to be only related in name. * Much like [[Faraway]], Null has an icon when holding Tab with the Xaero's Map/Minimap mod (pre-2.0). It is worth nothing that the only entities with icons normally are players and vanilla mobs. The icon may be hard to spot due to Null's icon being pitch black. Post-2.0, he does not appear on the map at all. * [https://minecraftcreepypasta.fandom.com/wiki/Entity_303 Entity303], referenced in Null's dialogues, is another popular creepypasta. Interestingly, when a sheep dies and the player has subtitles on, it says "303 dies" instead of "Sheep dies". There is no lore relevance and only serves as an easter egg. * Attempting to kick Null from the game results in the response "Cannot kick someone trying to assist." == Gallery == |-|Gallery= File:Null sneaky.png|dude thinks he's slick File:Null closeup.png|hey pal! pages.title: Null Torture
pages.extract:
{{Version|2.0.5}} '''Null Torture''' is an infinite horizontal array of 9x7 bedrock tunnels. These tunnel has no intersections or ways beyond its boundaries, so the player can only go forward or backward. It can be accessed through [[431434]], interacting with [[Notexture]] at a 25% chance, interacting with [[Null#Watching|Null]] at a 10% chance. == Mechanics == === Ambience === As long as the Player is in the dimension, ambient audio will play on loop. [[File:Null Dimension Ambient V2.ogg]] === Teleportation === '''Null Torture''' can teleport the Player between different areas, dependent on their actions. * At chance, when entering [[53135Exit6436]], the Player can be transported into another tunnel. This does '''not''' happen with items or other entities, as they will stay at the intended positions. It is not recommended to drop important items or entities within this dimension. == Tunnels == [[File:NullTortureWiki.png|thumb|300px|Tunnels]] On the interior, each side of the tunnel contains lava channels that are 2 blocks wide and 1 block deep. The walkable path sits at Y = 66. === Signs === Occasionally, signs can appear along the center of the tunnel: * I am sorry. * I am scared. * Let me out. * I just want to go home. * I am tired. * How many years have passed? * {}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{} (Both sides) * I am still here. I know they are looking for me. I hope they are. === Dead End === [[File:NullTortureDeadEndWiki.png|thumb|300px|Dead End]] Eventually, a dead end will appear at an end of a bedrock tunnel, blocking the way forwards. On the wall a sign with the text "Wrong way =)" can be seen, as well as redstone torches by the wall. In the middle is a jukebox with a chest in front of it. The chest is filled with [[name.revuxor]], with Music Disc [https://minecraft.wiki/w/Music_Disc_chirp chirp] in the centre. All of this seems to be left by [[Revuxor]] himself. The exact purpose is unknown, but if he only wanted to mock the player, then leaving both the jukebox and the disc with it was not necessary. This inclines towards the option, with a probable attempt at emotional support for the player. {{Clear}} === An Exit === [[File:NullTortureExitWiki.png|thumb|300px|An Exit]] On the opposite side of the dead end is an exit. The exit in Null Torture consists of a wall of 64 [[53135Exit6436]]. {{Clear}} == Outside == The outside of Null Torture is a dark, lifeless terrain, inhabited solely by [[Maze Shadow]]s. The world generation is similar to the Overworld, with exception of structures and other extra features. Additionally, all blocks are replaced with dirt, and water is replaced with cobblestone instead. NullTortureOverworldCompare.png|Overworld generation NullTortureOutside.png|Null Torture generation == Exit == Dying within '''Null Torture''' will send the Player back into the Overworld. Additionally, entering a room with [[53135Exit6436]] can result in the same. Additionally, there is a chance the Player is teleported back after some time. == Notes == * Prior to the ''2.0 Update'', the ambient audio for Null Torture was nulldementionambient.ogg'''nulldementionambient.ogg''' * Prior to the ''2.0 Update'', [[#Tunnels|tunnels]] would generate at Y = 197. pages.title: Phantom Player
pages.extract: {{Version|2.0.5}} {{Entity infobox |title=Phantom Player |image=[[File:Phantom_player.png]] |Type=[[Entities#Souls|Soul]] |Association=Blackout, [[Hetzer]] }} Phantom Player is a player-like entity. It appears to be a manifestation of [[__Blackout__]], similar to [[Hetzer]]. == Appearance == Phantom Player uses the base Minecraft player model, with a white noise texture (shared with the older version of [[Hetzer]]'s textures/entities/hetzer.png). Its nametag is fixed to __blackout__ and is always visible. It carries no hostility, instead feeling ethereal, both real and unreal. == Stats == * '''Max Health''': 10 (5 hearts) * '''Movement Speed''': 0.3 (theoretical) * '''Follow Range''': 16 blocks * '''Attack Damage''': 3 (theoretical) * '''Armor''': 0 * '''Knockback Resistance / Knockback''': 0 / 0 * '''Step Height''': default / 0.6 (theoretical) == Spawning == Phantom Player can naturally spawn in the overworld during daytime. The following conditions must all be met: * '''Difficulty''': not Peaceful * '''World State''': [[Null|Null has joined]] * '''Boss Fight''': does not spawn while [[Integrity|Integrity Phase 1]] is active * '''Player Position''': sky visible from above the player's head * '''Probability''': ~1/222 spawn attempts trigger (each attempt has a 0.45% success rate); superflat worlds are 1/1000 * '''Uniqueness''': at most 1 Phantom Player can exist in the same overworld at a time * '''Mutual Exclusion''': no [[Hetzer]] can be present in the Overworld, otherwise Phantom Player will never spawn Once spawned, it is immediately teleported 25 blocks above the nearest player's head within 100 blocks (or 25 blocks above its own position if no player is within 100 blocks). == Behavior == Phantom Player has no movement behavior after spawning. It just floats silently in place, with its head always facing the nearest player within 256 blocks. It does not wander, chase, or attack. When the player is within 200 blocks of it, there is a 1 in 10,000 chance per tick of triggering once: * If the player is looking at it, a [[Hetzer]] is left in place; * If the player and it can see each other through transparent blocks (leaves, glass, etc.), a [[Circuit#Stalk|Circuit]] is left; * If neither condition is met, it simply vanishes. When the player steps within 25 blocks of it, it actively sends the player a noisy jumpscare image (lasting 1 second), broadcasts a phantom_disappear sound at volume 10.0 / pitch 0.0 across a 30-block range, instantly deducts 5 reputation points from the player, and disappears. After {{tooltip|360 seconds|7200 ticks}}, if no player approached, it disappears naturally. '''Phantom Player ignores all attacks except /kill and void damage.''' == Notes == * Its behavior is similar to that of [[Faraway]] to some extent. * Its unknown why [[__Blackout__]] has 2 entity forms, its possible however, that just like [[Null]], his soul was splintered into separate pieces with each becoming their own entity or he has a shapeshifting capability. * Phantom Player had actually been in the mod since version 0.7 but it was left unused and went through a couple of iterations, its now able to spawn naturally as of 2.0. == Gallery == Phantom Player Trailer 1.png|Phantom Player teased in the 2.0 Gameplay Trailer. {{Wiki navbox}} [[Category:Entities]]

{{Stub|reason=impact on player gameplay (need information)}}{{Spoiler warning}}{{Version|2.0.5}}

== Description ==
In [[The Broken Script|TBS]], '''Player Сorruption''' manifests directly within the inventory interface. It appears as a shifting black mass, with particles of varying density and size visible along its edges. The corruption originates at the far right of the inventory slots and progresses as it advances to subsequent stages. It does not reduce inventory capacity and does not remain visible when using containers or while in Creative mode.

The corruption doesn't appear to have any negative effects other than visually making it harder to manage your inventory

== Stages of Сorruption ==

=== Stage 1 ===
Its first manifestation appears. It consists of a small black mass with very sparse particles.
[[File:Inventory Corruption.gif|left|thumb|218x218px|Stage 1 demonstration]]
{{Clear}}

=== Stage 2 ===
The area of coverage has roughly doubled. The number of particles has increased and the inventory background in the affected area is now darkened.
[[File:Inventory Corruption (Stage 2).gif|left|thumb|218x218px|Stage 2 demonstration]]
{{Clear}}

=== Stage 3 ===
The area of coverage has roughly tripled. The main mass became dominant, and the particles themselves took on a characteristic red hue. The darkening of the inventory background in the affected area is less pronounced.
[[File:Inventory Сorruption (Stage 3).gif|left|thumb|218x218px|Stage 3 demonstration]]
{{Clear}}

=== Stage 4 ===
The area of coverage has roughly tripled. The main mass is no longer concentrated at a single point, the number of red particles has increased, and the black particles have grown in size. The corruption now affects the crafting area and the recipe book button.
[[File:Inventory Corruption (Stage 4).gif|left|thumb|218x218px|Stage 4 demonstration]]
{{Clear}}

=== Stage 5 ===
At this stage, the coverage area occupies half of the Player's inventory. Particles fill only a small portion of it and, in addition, take on a glitch effect.
[[File:Inventory Corruption (Stage 5).gif|left|thumb|218x218px|Stage 5 demonstration]]
{{Clear}}

=== Stage 6 (Cut) ===
Old textures for all six stages could previously be found in the mod's files, but the textures were later updated and '''Stage 6 was cut'''. It covered practically the entire Player inventory, including the armor slots. You can find more details [[Cut and unused content#Inventory Corruption|here]].

== Obtaining ==

* The random event "[[Random Events#Inventory Corruption|Inventory Corruption]]" increases the current stage of corruption by 1. The effect triggers only once.
* Crafting a "[[Progression#The Polaroid|The Polaroid]]" at the crafting table increases the current stage of corruption by 1. This effect does not trigger if the achievement for crafting "[[Progression#The Polaroid|The Polaroid]]" is granted manually.
* Completing the battle against the [[Fractured]] increases the current stage of corruption by 1. Picking up a [[Progression#Corrupted Command Block|Corrupted Command Block]] does not affect this.
* Using the unique code from "[[Progression#The Polaroid|The Polaroid]]" in the command block interface increases the current stage of corruption by 1.
* Completing the battle against the boss, [[Integrity]], increases the current stage of corruption by 1.

<!-- == Gameplay changes == -->
== Related Pages ==

# [[Random Events]].
# [[Progression]].
# [[Cut and unused content]].
# [[Integrity]].
# [[Fractured]].

== Notes ==

# You can quickly reach corruption stage by repeatedly crafting "The Polaroid" item in '''Creative Mode''', as this method bypasses the restrictions associated with the random event. '''Applicable to mod version 2.0.5.'''
# The first three stages of corruption can be obtained in any order, as the random event "Inventory Corruption", crafting "The Polaroid", and obtaining the Corrupted Command Block occur independently of one another.

{{stub}} {{Spoiler warning}} {{Version|2.0.5}} == Polaroid Pieces == All 5 polaroid pieces are located in the Clan Void dimension. It can be accessed through by using a [[431434]] block or [[Notexture]] to teleport there, though neither option will be fully consistent. An online decoder made by the community for pieces 1 and 2 [https://jsbin.com/gutewus/edit?output can be found here]. === Polaroid Piece 1 === '''Polaroid Piece 1''' can be found on the [[Clan Void#Clan Void (layer)|lowest layer]] of the Clan Void in the '''clanvoidpredetermined''' room. When the [[Random_Events#Null_Book|Null Book]] random event occurs, there is a '''50% chance''' the book will contain a second page with the coordinates for the polaroid piece, encoded using Binary. '''Decoding''' You will need a decoder that can convert a binary input to a number (and not to text!). === Polaroid Piece 2 === '''Polaroid Piece 2''' can be found in the [[Clan Void#Maze|Maze layer]] in the '''mazepredetermined''' structure. The coordinates are found within the Player's C drive, as a file in the "Unknown" folder. This file is encoded using hexadecimal. '''Decoding''' All you need for this is a simple hexadecimal to number converter. === Polaroid Piece 3 === '''Polaroid Piece 3''' can be found in the [[Clan Void#Wood|Wood layer]] in the lower half of the '''woodpredetermined''' room. The coordinates are obtained from the '''Torn Paper''', a loot drop from killing [[Curved]]. Right-clicking the item will show the coordinates without any encryption. === Polaroid Piece 4 === '''Polaroid Piece 4''' can be found in the [[Clan Void#Stone|Stone layer]] in the '''stonepredetermined''' structure. The coordinates are obtained from the '''coords''' event, changing the version number into "Clan_Void " followed by a set of coordinates. === Polaroid Piece 5 === '''Polaroid Piece 5''' can be found on the [[Clan Void#Day_A|Day A layer]] in the '''fieldpredetermined''' structure. The coordinates can be found inside the structure '''(structure name)''' from the same layer. Inside is a chest with a written book from an Unknown Author with the coordinates. == The Polaroid == Once all 5 fragments are collected, they can be crafted into '''The Polaroid'''. Once crafted, the Player will receive the advancement (advancement name), and increase their reputation by (reputation number). Right clicking '''The Polaroid''' will reveal an image, shown below (add image below), as well as a code in the bottom right of the image. This code is randomized per world, and is utilized later in progression. It is very important that the code is saved, as if '''The Polaroid''' is lost without the code being saved, progression can become soft-locked. == The Moon == By jumping into the Void during a corrupt moon phase, or at chance by approaching [[Null#Watching|Null]], the Player will enter [[The Moon]] dimension. === The Tower === '''The Tower''' is a structure that can generate on [[The Moon]]. Climbing to the very top will decrease the ambient audio, and eventually lead to silence at the peak of the tower. At this point, the Player is presented with '''A Flower'''. Right clicking this flower will cause the flower to decay, as [[Fractured#Roam|Fractured]] spawns in. == Fractured == If the player dies and respawns back in the overworld before the boss fight is finished, it may cause a progression softlock that prevents further progress. It's recommended to backup the world before the boss fight. If the Player shoots [[Fractured]]'s head using a bow enchanted with Flame, the boss fight will begin once his healthbar appears. (Image of default hitbox here) Once the fight begins, [[Fractured]] will do a variety of attacks: * '''Stomp''' — Fractured lifts it's foot and slams the ground, dealing a large area-of-effect damage. * '''Slam''' — Fractured slams the player with its front claws, dealing melee damage. * '''Rock Toss''' — Fractured pulls a piece of the Moon from the ground beneath it, hurling it at the player. * '''Leg Stomp''' — each of Fractured's four legs independently seeks the nearest player and stomps toward them. [[Sub Anomaly 2]] will also have spawned from [[Fractured]], 30 in total, and are the only way to deal damage to it. Each time [[Fractured]]'s health bar has illuminated eyes, he is able to be shot with a Flame arrow. If the eyes on the health bar are not illuminated, the Player will not be able to get [[Sub Anomaly 2]] to attack [[Fractured]]. After being swarmed by [[Sub Anomaly 2]] 6 total times, the health bar will be depleted, meaning [[Fractured]]'s defeat. The remaining [[Sub Anomaly 2]] will still be around. == Corrupted Command Block == After [[Fractured]] is defeated, a block will be seen poking out of the Moon's surface nearby. Right clicking this block will give the Player the '''Corrupted Command Block''' On it's own, it cannot be used for anything. If it's placed, it will immediately break and drop itself. == Futile Efforts == Based on the signal pulse strength indicated by the Corrupted Command Block, the futile_efforts structure can be found. It has the appearance of a further ruined and corrupt version of the top layer of the [[#Clan Build Overhaul|Clan Build]], and will only ever generate when the Corrupted Command Block is obtained. [[File:Futile efforts.png|thumb|none|'''Futile Efforts''' structure with a sign which reads "Their efforts lead to nothing. You won't make any difference."]] File:Futile_Efforts 1.png|Futile Efforts(in-game) File:Futile_Efforts 2.png|Futile Efforts bottom view File:Futile_Efforts_Sign.png|Futile Efforts sign. Placing the Corrupted Command Block on the Initiator block at the center of the altar, enter the code from the bottom-right corner of the Polaroid that was obtained, and confirm Yes to trigger the boss fight.
== Integrity Boss Fight == Once the boss fight triggers, [[Integrity]] will dig up from the Void, and begin his dialogue. Once it ends, 10 [[Chord|Chords]] will spawn (it flies and fires lasers and bullets; can be killed with a bow/crossbow). Kill all Chords to complete phase one.
After phase one ends, the player is teleported to the [[Stage2]] dimension to begin phase two. Follow the red blocks on the ground (Necrosis) to find the main body Tether and kill it. After it's destroyed, the ground Necrosis gradually disappears, leaving a gap; jump down to enter the next layer.
In total you need to destroy the Tether 7 times (corresponding to CV's five layers, the Null Torture, and the Nowhere dimensions). During this, Integrity will pursuit the player, so you must act quickly.
In phase three the player is teleported to the [[Void Shadow]] dimension. In this phase the player can directly damage Integrity (1,024 HP). During it, harmful liquids or blocks may spawn, and Integrity may also pull the player up high and drop them, so be careful to dodge. Using a bow/crossbow for ranged attacks is recommended. ==Notes== #Coordinates differ for every save, and the data in the following images is only for demonstrating the process. #Do not name different saves identical or the CV codes may be messed up and softlock your progress. #If you really don't want to hunt for the fragments to get the code, you can just use the /tbs cv code get command to get the code for the current save.
#If the player dies and returns to the overworld during phases two or three, it may cause a progression softlock (even if you return to the death point and kill Integrity, you still can't progress), and you'll have to restart the boss fight. {{Wiki navbox}}

'''r2''' is an interesting [[Entity]], unique due to its rather distinctive appearance as a ghostly human silhouette.

Little is known about it at this moment.

== Appearance ==
r2 is a wispy, human-like silhouette, standing at about 5 blocks tall. It seems to be a shape of a human, but there are no discernible legs or arms, with a body seemingly made of smoke.

'''He''' is a rare variant of r2, featuring a glowing RGB static texture in replace of the ghostly look r2 has.

Both variants shake erratically regardless of movement.

== Spawn ==
Only one r2 can spawn at once. It has a {{tooltip|10%|1 in 10}} chance to give the Player the advancement {{tooltip|Here I am.|Can you see me?}}

The [[Mechanics#Version Number|Version Number]] will glitch between the current version and "Here I am." once spawned.

The Player will be unable to sleep, receiving an [[err.soul]] message.

While spawned, <ab>siluet_breathe.ogg</ab>'''siluet_breathe.ogg''' will play in the direction of r2.

r2 will spawn accompanied by an eerie noise.

'''His''' appearance will be accompanied by a sudden start of rain and a '''lightning strike''' at the place of '''his''' spawn.

== Behavior ==
All variants of r2 will disappear either {{tooltip|15 minutes|18000 ticks}} after spawning, or in a cloud of {{particle icon|null_particle}}null particles if the sun is visible.

=== Chase ===
r2 will set the Player's game mode to Survival and begin to rapidly approaches the Player, able to scale upwards 10 blocks.

<ab>siluet_chase.ogg</ab>'''siluet_chase.ogg''' will begin to play during the chase, commonly looping twice.

r2 will '''break most blocks''' it runs into, with the exception of some natural blocks such as dirt and stone.

r2 '''cannot be killed or harmed''', and will deal 13 damage to the Player on hit.

Every tick there is a 1% chance that the time of the day will change to day or midnight.

r2 will disappear {{tooltip|40 seconds|800 ticks}} after spawning.

=== Stalk ===
r2 will begin to approach the Player, being able to scale upwards 10 blocks.

When the Player comes within 10 blocks of r2, or look at r2 while within 20 blocks, the Player's screen will forced to look at r2, then one of the following will happen:
* r2 will enter it's [[#Chase|Chase]] behavior, striking the Player with lightning if r2 is on the surface.
* r2 will disappear, forcing the screen [[#/media/File:Cantyousee.png|cantyousee.png]] to appear over the Player's screen and playing the sound <ab>textmadness1.ogg</ab>'''textmadness1.ogg'''

r2 will disappear in a cloud of {{particle icon|null_particle}}null particles during the day.

=== Stare ===
r2 will remain standing in place, watching the Player.

If the Player looks at r2 while within 45 blocks, the Player's screen will forced to look at r2, then one of the following will happen:
* r2 will enter it's [[#Chase|Chase]] behavior, striking the Player with lightning if r2 is on the surface.
* r2 will disappear, forcing the screen [[#/media/File:Cantyousee.png|cantyousee.png]] to appear over the Player's screen and playing the sound <ab>textmadness1.ogg</ab>'''textmadness1.ogg'''

If the Player comes within 15 blocks of r2, the Player's screen will forced to look at r2, then one of the following will happen:
* r2 will enter it's [[#Chase|Chase]] behavior, striking the Player with lightning if r2 is on the surface.
* r2 will disappear, giving the Player '''Blindness II''' for 2 seconds, and playing the sound <ab>nullishereloopslowed.ogg</ab>'''null_is_here_loop.ogg''' (50% slower) for one tick.

=== He ===
'''He''' will remain standing in place, watching the player.

When the Player comes within 10 blocks of '''him''', or look at '''him''' while within 19 blocks, the Player's screen will forced to look at '''him''', then one of the following will happen:
* '''He''' will enter '''his''' [[#Chase|Chase]] behavior, striking the Player with lightning if '''he''' is on the surface.
* '''He''' will disappear, forcing the screen [[#/media/File:Cantyousee.png|cantyousee.png]] to appear over the Player's screen and playing the sound <ab>textmadness1.ogg</ab>'''textmadness1.ogg'''

=== Hallucination ===
From a [[Random Events#Hallucination|random event]], either variant of r2 can appear as a hallucination. It will always appear with it's r2 spawn behaviors, never '''His'''.

Unlike it's real counterpart, the version number '''will not change''' while the hallucination is near, though things such as sleep still will not work.

r2 will appear somewhere behind the Player, standing idly up until the Player either looks at r2 or approaches it.

The Player's screen will go dark as r2 disappears.

== Notes ==
* r2 is a great subject of interest to content creators, often appearing in video thumbnails or edited versions of the mod with a face added to its texture. r2 does not have a face.
* Before the ''2.0 Update'', there was no limit to how many r2's could exist at a time.
* Before the ''2.0 Update'', '''He''' entering into [[#Chase|Chase]] behavior would result in '''him''' turning into r2. This was most likely a bug, as it was later fixed.

{{Stub|List needs documentation, as well as influences from [[Reputation]] and [[Funny Setting]]s.}} {{Version|2.0.5}} In [[The Broken Script]], '''Random Events''' may occur to the player or the world around the player. These events have no discernible pattern to their appearance. Most of them are innocuous and some are even helpful, meanwhile others are openly malicious. == Aberration == Chromatic aberration filter will be applied to the player's screen for 1 minute. [[File:Chromatic Abberation Event.png|border|300px]] == Bad Sun == The sound bad_sun_siren.ogg'''bad_sun_siren.ogg''' will play, and after {{Tooltip|63 seconds|1260 ticks}}, the sun will be censored with a black square. Once the sun is censored, the player's camera will automatically rotate towards it until line of sight from it to the player is broken. It will also cause the player to take {{tooltip|1.5 hearts|3 damage}} of damage and get set on fire for the duration of the line of sight plus {{tooltip|6 seconds|120 ticks}}. File:BadSun_Video.mp4|Video of the full event File:BadSun.png|Censored sun. Requires the Funny Mode setting to be enabled in the mod configuration. This event is a direct recreation of the [https://voicesofthevoid.wiki.gg/wiki/Events/Time-Related#Bad_Sun event of the same name] from Voices of the Void == Behind You == The text "Behind You" will flicker on the Player's screen. == Breathe == An unused minecraft sound, '''player.breath''', will play. == BSOD == A distorted Windows 10/11 Blue Screen of Death overlays the player's screen for 9 seconds and bsod.ogg'''bsod.ogg''' starts playing. The colon symbol eyes of the face of the Blue Screen of Death seem to contain its own set of eyes, with both having white for the iris of the eye, and a black colored sclera. The right eye (the eye at the bottom) seems to be raised up. With a 70% chance, the weather is set to rain. [[File:FakeBSOD.png|border|300px]] == Can Someone Hear Me == The player will make the advancement '''{{tooltip|Go away|This place is not for you.}}''' [[File:GoAwayAdvancement.png|border|300px]] [[File:Go away advancement.png|none|thumb|Go away advancement]] == Cave == == Ceiling Circuit Event == {{For|more information|Circuit}} Somewhere near the Player, [[Circuit]] will spawn in their [[Circuit#Ceiling|Ceiling]] behavior. == Close Menu == The container the player currently has open suddenly closes. == Collinlock == ''This event requires [[Funny Settings|Funny Mode]] to be '''ON'''''. The following messages will appear with a {{tooltip|2 second|40 ticks}} delay between each: collinlock16 joined the game <collinlock16> oh shit wrong door collinlock16 left the game == Coord == {{For|more information|Progression#Polaroid_Piece_4}} Changing the version number into "Clan_Void " (coordinates are unique to each game world). == Cursed Book == When opening a written book or a writable book, the book interface changes as shown in the image below, and '''drone.ogg''' starts playing'''.''' [[File:Cursed book event.png|left|thumb|133x133px|Cursed book GUI]] {{Clear}} == Damage == The player takes 1 damage. == Door == == Doors == All wooden doors in a 6x6x6 area around the player will open on their own. == Entity Discard == During an active event, the entity disappears after the player strikes it. Only one entity disappears per event. It does not work with entities added by The Broken Script mod. == Experience == The player will either gain or lose between 1 and 10 experience points. == Explode Base == An explosion will occur in the player's base. == Eyes == Multiple {{particle icon|eyes}}eye particles appear around the player. [[File:Eye particles.png|border|150x150px]] == Fake Disconnect == A fake disconnect screen will appear for 4 seconds with the Kick reason as "Timed Out". This screen is obvious when JEI or similar mods are installed. == False Villager == {{For|more information|Circuit#Inhabited_Mob}} If the player is in a village, somewhere within its boundaries, [[Circuit]] will spawn disguised as a [[Circuit#False_Villager|False Villager]]. == Gamma == Resets gamma settings to the default value (default 50%). == Giift == A chest with 10 diamonds inside will appear in the player's base. == Give Disc 11 == The player will be given Music Disc 11. == Hallucination == The "[[R2#r2-1|r2]]" entity spawns out of the player's line of sight, accompanied by a random cave sound. If the player looks at "r2," the entity will rapidly move toward them but will not deal damage upon contact. There is a chance that "[[R2#He-1|He]]" will appear instead of "r2." == Heartbeat == The time of the day is set to night. With a 50% chance eerie noise and heartbeat.ogg '''heartbeat.ogg''' will play. == Hungry == The player's food level will be set to a random amount between 1 and 10. == Inventory Corruption == Progresses the inventory corruption animated by 1 stage to a maximum of 5. == Isolation == In multiplayer, a player may become isolated. An isolated player cannot be seen by other players, and the messages they type are hidden from them as well. If the ''Simple Voice Chat'' mod is installed, the isolated player cannot be heard by other players either. The isolation lasts for {{Tooltip|3.5 minutes|4200 ticks}}. == JFrame == A small black box will appear that obscures a part of the screen. The box can appear in 1 of 5 positions. It disappears after {{Tooltip|1 second|20 ticks}}. JFrame1.png|1/5, on top of chat JFrame2.png|2/5, center right as a vertical box JFrame3.png|3/5, screen center JFrame4.png|4/5, on top of version watermark JFrame5.png|5/5, on top of hotbar The environment around the picture was chosen for scenery, and null is not related to this event. Multiple boxes can be visible at the same time. == Keep Playing == The text "KEEP PLAYING" will appear on the player's screen. == Lavacast == If the '''Reputation''' with [[Null]] is '''Bad''', a lavacast will appear at the player's base. When it spawns, it replaces the blocks around itself and thus is likely to cause serious damage to the base. [[File:Lavacast grief.gif|border|400px]] == Look and Damage == The player's camera will be forced to point down, up, left, and forward relative to the world at intervals of 0.25 seconds. Each time the camera's direction changes, the player will take 1 damage. Interestingly, due to the temporary invulnerability, the damage will only go through the first and third time, dealing a total of 2 damage. [[File:Look and damage event2.mp4|border|400px]] == Madness 1` == The player's camera will be forced in the opposite direction, textmadness1.ogg'''textmadness1.ogg''' will play, and '''=)''' text will appear briefly above the player's hotbar. [[File:Madness1Event.png|border|300px]] == Moon Glitch == moonglitch.ogg'''moonglitch.ogg''', titled '''thebrokenscript:integrity.curious''' in the subtitles, will play, and fog will condense around the player within a radius equal to a render distance of 2 chunks for a duration of 5 minutes. If Moon Glitch occurs while the Player is exposed to open sky, there is a 50% chance that [[Integrity]] will spawn 35 blocks in front of the Player after {{tooltip|2.75 seconds|55 ticks}}, named '''Integrity.Curious'''. As part of [[progression]], this event is guaranteed to occur sometime after world creation, signifying the start of the mod Despite this event's name it seems to have no relation to the moon. == Moon Phase == If the current lunar phase is 2 - '''Waning Gibbous''', then [[the Moon]] moves to the next stage of Corruption. As part of [[progression]], this event is guaranteed to occur at some point, typically on day 24, though this can vary wildly depending if time was edited some way like the /time command. == Noop == Noop is an event that does nothing, its name comes from [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Null_function Null functions], and means "no operation". == Null Book == The player is given a Written Book titled '''null''', signed by [[null]], and containing a single page with the following text: null.err.object.err.null.object.alone.3.not.behind.entitytype:player.receiveddata.invalid.reboot.failed.reset.playerdata:00F9219492D94210F812 Occasionally, a second page can generate with the coordinates to [[Polaroid Piece 1]]. == Null Getting Advancement == Null is able to make advancements, related to various points of player progression, including the mod's own achievements. However, he can receive the same achievement multiple times. [[File:Null Progression.png|none|thumb|Null's Progression]] == Null Interface Trigger == An empty inventory container appears with the text "help" or "behind you" displayed, though there is a chance for neither to appear. [[File:HelpFrame.png|border|150px|]] == Null Invade Base == {{For|more information|Null#Invade_Base}} [[Null]] will spawn in the player's base in his [[Null#Invade_Base|Invade Base]] behaviour. == Null is Near == The Player will recieve the blindness effect for 5 seconds. == Null Particle == Null Particle will appear near the player for a brief moment. == Null Scare == {{For|more information|Null#Scare}} [[Null]] in his [[Null#Scare|Scare]] behaviour will spawn at a position randomly offset by -5 to 5 blocks in the X and Z directions and 0 to 5 blocks in the Y direction from the player's position. == Null Title == A white text line will briefly appear in the center of the player's screen, saying '''null null null null null null null null''' [[File:NullTitle.png|border|300px]] == Null Whisper == [[Null]] will whisper to the Player one of the following texts: * Nothing can be done * They are coming * err.type=null.messageNotFound * Why are you doing this * There is nothing left * I hear you * I see you == Nulled GUI == The time of the day is set to midnight, glithcsound1.ogg'''glithcsound1.ogg''' plays, and a GUI window appears on the player's screen with the text "Good luck. =)". [[File:Good Luck.png|border|150px]] == nullnullnull Advancement == The player will make the advancement '''{{tooltip|nullnullnull|nullnullnull}}''' [[File:NullnullnullAdvancement.png|border|frameless]] [[File:Nullnullnull advancement.png|none|thumb|nullnullnull advancement]] == Obfuscated Sign == A sign with obfuscated text '''aBecauseofyou''' will appear in the player's base. [[File:Place obfuscated sign.png|border|200px]] [[File:Place obfuscated sign text.png|border|130px]] == OpenGL Error ==
OpenGL Error: 1282 (Invalid Operation)
will be sent to the chat 4 times, 1 second apart, before 5 seconds later
OpenGL Error: 0 (Here I am.)
will also be sent, accompanied by an eerie noise. [[File:OpenGL Error.png|border|300px]] == Paranoia == 4 sounds of walking on grass will be played at 1 second intervals. == Place All Dead == A [[Items#431434|431434]] block will appear in the player's base. == Place Bedrock == A lone block of bedrock will appear from 50 to 60 blocks up in the air. [[File:Bedrock Event.png|border|150px]] == Place Cave Air == A block of Cave Air will appear in the player's base. == Place Empty == A block named Empty will be placed in the player's base; the block explodes immediately upon placement. == Place Flowing Water == A water source block will be placed in the player's base. == Place Hello == A [[Items#Hello|Hello]] block will appear in the player's base. [[File:Place Hello Event.png|border|150px]] == Place Lava == If the '''Reputation''' with [[Null]] is '''Bad''', a lava source block will be placed in the player's base. == Place Netherrack == A netherrack block will appear in the player's base. == Place Oak Sign == An empty oak sign will appear in the player's base. == Place Redstone Torch == A single redstone torch will be placed in the player's base. == Place Water == A water source block will appear from 50 to 60 blocks above the player. [[File:WaterPlaced.png|border|150px]] == Play Sound == Either an eerie noise, Disc 13, or Disc 11 will play, coming seemingly from nothing in particular. The pitch varies from 0 to 1. == Port == == Psst Event == The player will hear a faint "psst". == Push == The player is flung in a left-up-forward direction. == Random Song == randomsong.ogg '''randomsong.ogg''' will start playing, the time of the day will be set to midnight, and the player will be given Blindness II, Slowness II, and Slow Falling II for 16 seconds. After 16 seconds, if the sky is visible above the player, there is a 50% chance that a lightning bolt will strike them. The origin of the song is from [https://youtu.be/gPIN2Q-PBQs?t=237|CHRISTMAS EVE PARTY — GEMINI HOME ENTERTAINMENT] == Rejoin == The message " joined the game" will appear in the chat. [[File:Rejoin event.png|left|434x434px]] {{Clear}} == Reset Rotation == Resets the player's rotation to the default position (the standard player position is the one held after world creation). == Run == The word "Run" will appear on the player`s screen. == Screen Dupe == Overlays the player`s screen image onto the player`s screen image. [[File:Screen dupe event.png|border|left|311x311px|dupe event screen]] {{Clear}} == Set doDaylightCycle == doDaylightCycle gamerule, which is responsible for the passage of game time, is set to either true with a 70% chance or false with a 30% chance. == Set On Fire == The player is set on fire for 3 seconds. == Set Random Time Of Day == A random amount from 1 to 10000 ticks is added to the time of day. == Set Time == The time of day is set to either midnight with a 70% chance or day with a 30% chance. == Shadow Bug == A 19x10x19 block area around the player, starting at their feet, is replaced by Shadow Bug - transparent, non-solid blocks that can cast shadows. == Sky Blue == Changes the shade of the sky to a monotonous one. [[File:Blue sky event.png|border|left|329x329px|blue sky event]] {{Clear}} == Stare at Player == The entities begin to stare intently at the player. [[File:Entities look at the player..png|border|left|327x327px|Entities look at the player.]] {{Clear}} == Stick == Gives the player one stick. == Strike Lightning == Lightning strikes at a position randomly offset by 1 to 10 blocks in the X and Z directions from the player's position. == The Broken End Curious == {{For|more information|The Broken End#Curious}} == Text == A random message is sent in the chat. [[File:Joined the game.png|thumb|one of the random messages.]] * I see you. * Can you see me? * It was your fault. * Help us. * I am right behind you * I am right behind you. * null * null.err * 000 * AAAAAAAAA (obfuscated) * Null joined the game * Null left the game * joined the game * * Internal Error: IllegalStateException - '<>' is not a valid player name! * Internal Error: IllegalStateException - '' is not a valid player name! == Title Event == {{For|more information|Mechanics#Window_Title_Changes}} Changes the game window title. Examples: *entity.thebrokenscript.null.title.number (number 0-15) * general.thebrokenscript.eye * gui.thebrokenscript.msg.become_void * back to the default == Txt == == Why Can't You Leave == "Why can't you just leave?" potion effect with {{particle icon|eyes}}eye particles as bubbles is given to the player for {{Tooltip|50 seconds|1000 ticks}}. [[File:WhyCantYouJustLeaveEffect.png|border|300px]] == Wrong Overlay == The player's screen will be covered by a black overlay for 0.5 seconds, they will be teleported 50 blocks up and ignore any fall damage. This event can fail if the target block contains lava or an existing block, it also cannot happen in one of the [[Dimensions]]. [[Category:Mechanics]]
{{Wiki navbox}}

[[File:Reunion.gif|left|thumb|06 06 2008 - Nebula & Dominic - Primary School]]
The photo is actually a gif. There is one frame that, instead of having Neb and Dom as kids hugging, has them both dead, with Dom being ripped in half with his head also ripped off according to the lines on his body, while Neb seems to have gotten her chest pierced and possibly ripped open vertically too. [[File:ReunionDeadFrame.png|left|thumb|Reunited.]]
The cipher on the left of the photo gives us a link after a few corrections made by Dom, giving us more information about what happened to Nebula. http://localhost:2018/threads/DJ2trappy2skeezy/reunion
reunion 00/00/00 at 00:00:00 I thought I had lost her. Well, perhaps I still have. What remains of her truly holds no weight; only a stumbling congregation of shadow, gathered vaguely into the shape of what used to be her. At times, she turns towards me with something almost like recognition. Hollowed out eyes settled upon my face and for once merciful instant, I believe she is still there. That she knows me. Then her jaw hangs loose and the illusion rots. She is imprisoned within a carcass assembled all wrong. Every movement resembles a blasphemous imitation of life. Body twitching beneath ruined skin, each tremor a reminder that her body bestows a burial shroud filled with flies. Whatever found her must have been brutal. There is so little left that I recognise, save for the tufts of frizzy hair clinging stubbornly around her disfigured face. A tarnished ''halo''. I once thought I was a religious man. Truly, I did. I believed that there was intention behind suffering, that every wound was another line of scripture. But there is no scripture for this. What loving God would permit such a thing to kneel at the altar of His creation and feed? What divinity could watch something hollow her out, wear her likeness and drag her back to me like a cruel answer to a prayer. Maybe this is resurrection and we had misunderstood the promise. I think I am losing myself too. My thoughts no longer arrive in my own voice, something speaks for them. Something ravenous, deranged. It roots itself between my ribs, turning over each organ as if choosing from a banquet. '''My innards are it’s feast.''' '''My blood is it’s wine.''' '''My flesh is it’s bread.''' Yet, no communion is being held. Nothing is shared. Nothing is sanctified. It takes and takes, swallowing every sacred part of me without gratitude or reverence. Only greed. Incessant, fucking greed. ''I am not ready to forget her.'' I am not ready to lose her again. So, I remain before her and she before me. Two abandoned offerings at the foot of an empty altar, waiting for the other to remember what we once were. A melancholic reunion, or something cruel enough to resemble one.
It's possible that, after killing Nebula, Circuit wore her body and met up with Dominic to kill him too. == Forum presence == NebulaForumProfile.png|LucozadeFan123's forum profile. {{Version|2.0.4}} The Broken Script contains a reputation system that adapts to how the player interacts with the mod. Reputation almost exclusively affects [[Null]], but can also change what [[structures]] spawn and allows certain [[Random Events]] to happen. Reputation is split in tiers, which are '''BAD''' (< 25), '''NORMAL''' (26-75), or '''GOOD''' (> 75). Reputation cannot go below ''0''. The default value for reputation is 50. If cheats are enabled, or the player is an operator, they can run the command /tbs reputation to get their reputation value and tier. Users with such permissions can also modify their own reputation using /tbs dev reputation add. [[File:REPNORMAL.png|none|thumb|554x554px|alt=Reputation 50; "Null and you are neutral between each other. Null can sometimes hurt the player."|Running ''/tbs reputation'' on a fresh world with 50 reputation]] [[File:REPGOOD.png|none|thumb|554x554px|alt=Reputation 76; "Null is cool and doesn't care about you being here. Null will rarely hurt the player."|Running ''/tbs reputation'' on after setting reputation to 76]] [[File:REPBAD.png|none|thumb|554x554px|alt=Reputation 0; "Null is pissed and his hatred for you is at maximum. Expect hell from null. Null will now more often attack the player."|Running ''/tbs reputation'' with 0 reputation on [[WORLD2]]]] In multiplayer servers, reputation is separate for each player, meaning a nice player can have a '''GOOD''' reputation while a bad player has a '''BAD''' reputation. = Changing Reputation = Reputation gain/loss is categorized with these names: {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible" |+Reputation values !Name !Change |- |Teeny Tiny |1 |- |Baby |5 |- |Minor |10 |- |Small |15 |- |Rare |20 |- |Medium |25 |- |Well Done |30 |- |Huge |35 |- |Congratulations |50 |- |Regain Half |special; lets you regain half
of your most recent loss |} == Positive == === Chat Responses === If the current reputation is '''BAD''', the following chat responses will give you some reputation, with a cooldown of {{tooltip|8 seconds|160 ticks}} each. Only the main phrases were put in this table for brevity. Main wiki page: [[Chat Responses]] {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" |+Chat Responses !Response !Gain |- |Sorry |Regain Half |- |What do you want? |25 |- |Hello |15 |- |Who are you? |15 |- |Follow |15 |- |Entity303 |15 |- |[[Revuxor]] |15 |- |[[Curved|DyeXD412]] |15 |- |[[Clan Build|clan_build]] |15 |- |[[Circuit]] |15 |- |[[catfish12]] |15 |- |[[Not_It_Cal]] |15 |- |[[__Blackout__]] |15 |- |[[OVERLORD]] |10 |- |[[Integrity]] |10 |- |} The last chat-related reputation increase is from saying Nice next to a [[Structures|structure]] created by the mod, which grants 15 reputation. === Entity Interactions === Specific entity interactions can increase your reputation. {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible" |+Chat Responses !Response !Gain |- |Killing [[Curved]] |25 |- |Surviving [[The Broken End]] |25 |- |Surviving [[Circuit]] |15 |- |Surviving [[Null#Invade_Base|Null (Invade Base)]] |15 |- |Surviving [[R2#Chase|R2 (Chase)]] or [[R2#He-1|He (Chase)]] |10 |- |Sneaking within {{tooltip|1 second|20 ticks}} of looking at [[Null#Flying|Null (Flying)]] |10There is a {{tooltip|20 minute|24000 tick}} cooldown to this interaction |- |} === Lore === '''WARNING: This page contains lore spoilers. Open at your own risk.'''

|+Entity Interactions !Response !Loss |- |Killing any form of [[Null]] |-50 |- |Hurting [[Null#Flying|Null (Flying)]] |-25 |- |Getting within 20 blocks of [[Null#Watching|Null (Watching)]] |-15 |- |Failing to sneak within {{tooltip|1 second|20 ticks}} of looking at [[Null#Flying|Null (Flying)]] |-15 |- |Getting within 15 blocks of [[Null#Invade_Base|Null (Invade Base)]] |-10 |- |Causing [[Null#Invade_Base|Null (Invade Base)]] to enter [[Null#Chase|Null (Chase)]] |-10 |- |Looking at [[Hetzer]] |-5 |- |Getting within 25 blocks of [[Phantom Player]] |-5 |- |Making [[Null#Chase|Null (Chase)]] appear with > 5 reputation |-1 |- |} = Reputation Changes = == Good == === Disabled Events === '''GOOD''' reputation disables the following events: * [[Random Events#Madness_1|Madness 1]] === Disabled Entities === '''GOOD''' reputation disables the following entities: * [[Null#Mining|Null (Mining)]] * One of the triggers for [[Null#Chase|Null (Chase)]] from [[Null#Watching|Null (Watching)]] === Enabled Structures === '''GOOD''' reputation enables certain structures that are not otherwise spawnable: * [[Structures#Giift|Giift]] == Bad == === Chat Responses === '''BAD''' reputation allows [[Reputation#Chat Responses|positive chat responses]] to give reputation. === Enabled Events === Having '''BAD''' reputation enables the following events to occur: * [[Random Events#Place_Flowing Water|Place Flowing Water]] * [[Random Events#Place_Water|Place Water]] * [[Random Events#Place_Lava|Place Lava]] * [[Random Events#Place_Empty|Place Empty]] * [[Random (Endgame)]] instead. * The "'''Friend?'''" response will cause [[Null#Scare|Null (Scare)]] instead of the normal response. It is currently the only way to self-check reputation without commands. {{Wiki navbox}}

pages.extract:
{{Version|2.0.4}} {{Distinguish|text = [[Revuxor (Lore)|Revuxor]], a player}} {{Entity infobox |title=Revuxor |image={{GalleryHelper |Revuxor2.0.5.png¦Front¦Front |Revuxor2.0.5back.png¦Back¦Back |RevuxorWiki.png¦Pre-2.0.5 Design }} |Role= |Type=[[Entities#Souls|Soul]] |Affiliations= |HP= }} '''Revuxor''' is an [[Entity]], and not much is known about him outside of the [[Clancraft Forums]]. He is rarely seen, and he's only been observed on very rare occasions. He was brutally murdered in real life by [[Circuit]] after he entered Revuxor's house from his computer. A pixelated image of Revuxor's dead body, or parts of it, exists in The Broken Script as an item named [[name.revuxor]]. It can be found in chests in places where Revuxor was present and left something behind, such as the [[Structures#Gore_Structure|Gore Structure]] or [[Null_Torture#Dead_End|Dead End]]. == Appearance == Revuxor, with its monochrome skin and seemingly missing eyes, shares the same model as the Player entity. It appears to be badly injured and covered in dried blood. == Behaviour == Revuxor, in any instance where the player is going to be [[Banning|banned]], appears behind them for just 1 tick (around 50ms). When the player attempts to reconnect to a world there banned from, Revuxor will warn the player in hopes to prevent them from succumbing from a similar fate he experienced (see [[Banning]]) == Notes == * Asking [[Null]] about him leads to him saying, "Poor soul." * Revuxor is titled '''thebrokenscript:ban.''' Despite his name in the code, "thebrokenscript:ban", he doesn't actually ban players, but kicks them with the message that they are not whitelisted in the server on the first tick that he spawns in. There's a very likely chance that every single time a player's been kicked from their world, it's actually because Revuxor banned people to protect them from the Void. * While searching for information on this entity, the wiki staff came across a small Russian horror SMP called SiimpAlone. It features a character in it named "[https://minecraft-siimpalone.fandom.com/ru/wiki/Revuxor Revuxor (Ревуксор)]It has no relation to the Broken Script; however, this is a fun Easter egg from where Revuxor's name came from. * Despite his brief appearance, Revuxor ''can'' be killed by the Player, and has the same amount of health. He will only drop 5 experience points on death. == Gallery == |-|Gallery= CircuitMonitor.png|[[Circuit]] climbing out of [[Revuxor]]'s monitor. CircuitInHallway.png|[[Circuit]] chasing [[Revuxor]] in the hallway. File:Namerevuxor.png|Originally a pixelated red mess, name.revuxor otherwise known as "gore" is now static. File:Revuxor transparent.png|Transparent Revuxor Render (pre 2.0.5) File:RevuxorTbsRender.png|Artistic Render (pre 2.0.5) |-|Menu Fanart= Depressuxor.jpg|Menu Fanart John_ban.jpg|Menu Fanart [[Category:Entities]]

Revuxor is an administrator of the clan server and one of the first people to explore [[spectrum_11]].

== Appearance ==
Revuxor's forum profile picture is a cat on a bed with a frog hat on its head.

== Personality ==
Revuxor's main interests are space, fiction, and Minecraft. He visited the Kennedy Space Center, and at the time his English was a bit "spotty" so he mainly kept to himself and other students. Revuxor is more aware of things than other players, knowing about the fate of Hubble. Revuxor is a very smart person. He closely investigates everything related to Spectrum_11, including the side effects such as people missing for weeks, strange messages, and a feeling of being watched, noting that Spectrum_11 might be more dangerous than people realize. While the [[Void]] tries to whisper secrets into his head, he thinks of even scarier questions, while also trying to not go crazy. Just like us, he's trying to figure out everything.

Revuxor was also possibly the first person to notice the weirdness within the clan server as well. Taken from this book in his player inventory: 
 Started mining. Weird cave noises I don't recognize.
 It sounds like a repetitive, glitchy drumming. Almost like a heartbeat.  I can hear it even with my volume muted.
 I think I found where the noises are coming from.
 raw: Its a tall, shadowy figure. Like the images I saw in the forums of that old, pirated minecraft "creepypasta".
 It doesn't look minecraft at all. It's standing still, staring right at me. I know for sure that it

 Spectrum 11 may be more dangerous than people realize. Users who actively play the jar have posted some strange messages, mentioning their friends being missing for weeks after the last thing they did was play this game. Some users express a strange “feeling” of being watched or judged.

 I keep hearing mentions of the “Void” in my head. Whenever I play this game, it’s like something is whispering secrets I shouldn’t know. Trying to scare me. But as someone who is in college focusing on space, I have to think of a much scarier question. What is the void. Is it an entity? An object? An idea?

 Astronomers usually refer to the “void” as little spots of nothingness in space. Areas where the universe is dark. I’ve mapped out all locations of where “voids” are located. But I don’t even know if that’s what the voices are even referring to. It could just mean “the absence of something” and not a physical place. Another connection to the void I maybe could see is the entity itself. It’s mostly black. The void usually means nothing. Black is associated with the absence of light, despite technically containing all colors of the visible light spectrum. Void also means zero in other languages. A lot of signs keep pointing to the fact that the void simply just means “the unknown”. I don’t think whatever this entity is wants us to know where it comes from. I am grasping at ideas but I feel if I don’t make sense of it now, I will go crazy in the end.

Revuxor also hates that despite everything he posted, no one listened to him. He knew about Spectrum_11, the Void, the disappearance of Icarus, the despair of Aspect, and yet nobody listened to him.
 I am sick and tired of nobody listening to me
 Nobody ever fucking listened to me
 look where it got them
 well fuck em
 their stars have grown dim
 pointed blits of light punched out of the night's oily paper mache dome
 snuffed out little things hollow tipped with toxic waste
 they're fucked
 you aren't
 I can show you
 There is time to stop this key from turning
 Lower the case; Time is the key
 The key is time; the case is lowered.

== Fate ==

Revuxor got killed by [[Circuit]] in real life. In [[Items#Record 17|(17) Silenced]] we can hear [[Circuit]] come out of Revuxor's PC, before chasing him in his house, and finally killing him violently in the end. Revuxor got silenced for getting too close to the truth. After that, his body was shoved into the game and he became an [[Revuxor|entity]].

pages.extract:
== '''General Conduct''' ==
'''Respectful Interaction:'''
* Avoid personal attacks. Focus critiques on content, not individuals - especially regarding any situations about the mod's deletion.

'''Consensus Building:''' 
* If there are any disagreements regarding page content, discuss them on the relevant Discussion sub-pages or in the official Discord server to reach a consensus rather than engaging in edit wars.

'''Voice''' 
* This wiki is manned by a group of anonymous archivists who've come across this fantastic ARG. We operate this site on the budget of a shoestring and a packet of gum. For the sake of maintaining the wiki's voice, keep it in mind that while professionalism is code, approachability is key. Let's try to keep things accessible, casual, and tonally consistent. 

== '''Vandalism''' ==
'''Vandalism''' includes actions like adding nonsense/blatantly fake information to a page, uploading offensive/unrelated images, blanking pages, or spamming unrelated external links. '''Such behavior is not allowed, and wiki staff will take action immediately.'''

== '''Media and File Usage''' ==
'''Appropriate Content:'''
* Ensure that all media files, such as images and videos, are relevant to the wiki's content and do not contain offensive material.
'''Reuploads:''' 
* Don’t reupload existing images on the wiki for the sake of having an edit in your name - this makes file management confusing and takes up unnecessary space.

== '''Content Guidelines''' ==
When creating or editing a page, please follow the guidelines in this section to make this wiki easier to read and more consistent.

=== Information ===
When writing content, before adding any information, consider the following questions:

* Is this addition speculative, such as assumptions or unconfirmed theories?
* Is there no official source for the information?

If the answer to any of these questions is "yes", then the content should not be on the wiki, since even the slightest error can lead to misinterpretation. To avoid misinformation being taken as fact, ensure that all information about lore, entities, and etc. is confirmed either through testing in the mod itself or through statements from '''wendigodrip'''.

Please be sure to provide evidence on the appropriate Discussion sub-pages for all information added to avoid wasting time on fact-checking. Information added without evidence may be reverted at the discretion of the wiki staff.

XqLrLO504GEXqLrLO504GEXqLrLO504GEXqLrLO504GEXqLrLO504GEXqLrLO504GEXqLrLO504GEXqLrLO504GEXqLrLO504GEXqLrLO504GE
